49#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
50enum SpectralBasisPlan {
51    ChannelLocal,
52    Polynomial(BlockNormalPlan),
53    TaylorViaChannelMajor(BlockNormalPlan),
54    Joint {
55        continuum: BlockNormalPlan,
56        line_terms: usize,
57    },
58}
59
60impl SpectralBasisPlan {
61    const fn coefficient_terms(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
62        match self {
63            Self::ChannelLocal => slab.core_depth(),
64            Self::Polynomial(plan) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
65                plan.coefficient_term_count()
66            }
67            Self::Joint {
68                continuum,
69                line_terms,
70            } => continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms,
71        }
72    }
73
74    const fn resident_terms(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
75        match self {
76            Self::ChannelLocal => slab.resident_depth(),
77            Self::Polynomial(plan) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
78                plan.coefficient_term_count()
79            }
80            Self::Joint {
81                continuum,
82                line_terms,
83            } => continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms,
84        }
85    }
86
87    const fn total_model_terms(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
88        match self {
89            Self::ChannelLocal => slab.total_channels(),
90            Self::Polynomial(plan) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
91                plan.coefficient_term_count()
92            }
93            Self::Joint {
94                continuum,
95                line_terms,
96            } => continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms,
97        }
98    }
99
100    const fn normal_moments(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
101        match self {
102            Self::ChannelLocal => slab.core_depth(),
103            Self::Polynomial(plan) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
104                plan.normal_moment_count()
105            }
106            Self::Joint {
107                continuum,
108                line_terms,
109            } => {
110                let terms = continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms;
111                terms * terms
112            }
113        }
114    }
115
116    const fn validity_entries(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
117        match self {
118            Self::ChannelLocal => slab.core_depth(),
119            Self::Polynomial(_) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => 1,
120            Self::Joint { .. } => slab.total_channels(),
121        }
122    }
123
124    const fn polynomial(self) -> Option<BlockNormalPlan> {
125        match self {
126            Self::ChannelLocal => None,
127            Self::Polynomial(plan) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => Some(plan),
128            Self::Joint { .. } => None,
129        }
130    }
131
132    const fn channel_major_taylor(self) -> Option<BlockNormalPlan> {
133        match self {
134            Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => Some(plan),
135            Self::ChannelLocal | Self::Polynomial(_) | Self::Joint { .. } => None,
136        }
137    }
138
139    const fn major_coefficient_planes(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
140        if self.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
141            slab.core_depth()
142        } else {
143            self.coefficient_terms(slab)
144        }
145    }
146
147    const fn major_normal_planes(self, slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> usize {
148        if self.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
149            slab.core_depth()
150        } else {
151            self.normal_moments(slab)
152        }
153    }
154
155    fn normal_moment_index(self, row: usize, column: usize) -> Option<usize> {
156        match self {
157            Self::Polynomial(plan) | Self::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
158                plan.normal_moment_index(row, column)
159            }
160            Self::Joint {
161                continuum,
162                line_terms,
163            } => {
164                let terms = continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms;
165                if row < terms && column < terms {
166                    row.checked_mul(terms)?.checked_add(column)
167                } else {
168                    None
169                }
170            }
171            Self::ChannelLocal => None,
172        }
173    }
174}

204// The pinned RustFFT mixed-radix planner stores at most one length-sized table
205// per decomposition level. There are fewer than usize::BITS levels, two
206// directions, and small node headers. Charging four complex values per level
207// gives a hard, architecture-independent upper bound while the library keeps
208// its plan internals opaque.
209const FFT_PLAN_COMPLEX_BOUND_PER_AXIS: usize = 4 * usize::BITS as usize;
210// One recipe plus both direction-specific cache entries per decomposition
211// point, including hash-table control storage and Arc metadata.
212pub(crate) const FFT_PLANNING_WORD_BOUND_PER_POINT: usize = 16;

214/// One already-weighted spectral contribution accepted by the T19 algorithm.
215///
216/// This value contains no weighting policy, density, taper, generation, or
217/// numerics fields. Runtime supplies it only after unwrapping a T18-branded
218/// weighted block; the terminal runtime completion remains the authority that
219/// proves exhaustive coverage.
220#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]

222    output_channel: usize,
223    uvw_m: [f64; 3],

229    spectral_factor: f64,

231    mosaic_response: Option<MosaicResponse>,
232    parallactic_angle_deg: f64,
233    pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell: [f64; 2],
234    mueller_element: u32,
235    aw_prediction_w_m: Option<f64>,
236}

276impl MosaicResponse {
277    fn canonical_responses(self) -> SelectedAntennaResponses {
278        SelectedAntennaResponses {
279            antenna1: self.key.antenna1,
280            antenna2: self.key.antenna2,
281            family_envelope: self.key.family_envelope,
282        }
283    }
284
285    fn canonical_pointings(
286        self,
287        pointings: SelectedPointingDirections,
288    ) -> SelectedPointingDirections {
289        if self.antenna_responses.antenna1 <= self.antenna_responses.antenna2 {
290            pointings
291        } else {
292            SelectedPointingDirections {
293                antenna1: pointings.antenna2,
294                antenna2: pointings.antenna1,
295            }
296        }
297    }
298}

309impl SpectralOperatorSample {
310    /// Construct one numerical contribution after the runtime capability check.
311    pub(crate) fn new(
312        output_channel: usize,
313        uvw_m: [f64; 3],
314        frequency_hz: f64,
315        phase_shift_m: f64,
316        visibility: [f64; 2],
317        imaging_weight: f64,
318        spectral_factor: f64,
319    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
320        if uvw_m.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
321            || !frequency_hz.is_finite()
322            || frequency_hz <= 0.0
323            || !phase_shift_m.is_finite()
324            || visibility.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
325            || !imaging_weight.is_finite()
326            || imaging_weight < 0.0
327            || !spectral_factor.is_finite()
328            || spectral_factor == 0.0
329        {
330            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
331        }
332        Ok(Self {
333            output_channel,
334            uvw_m,
335            frequency_hz,
336            phase_shift_m,
337            visibility: Complex64::new(visibility[0], visibility[1]),
338            imaging_weight,
339            published_weight: imaging_weight,
340            spectral_factor,
341            mosaic_route: None,
342            mosaic_response: None,
343            parallactic_angle_deg: 0.0,
344            pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell: [0.0; 2],
345            mueller_element: 0,
346            aw_prediction_w_m: None,
347        })
348    }
349
350    fn with_mosaic_route(mut self, field_id: i32, pointings: SelectedPointingDirections) -> Self {
351        self.mosaic_route = Some((field_id, pointings));
352        self
353    }
354
355    fn with_mosaic_response(mut self, response: Option<MosaicResponse>) -> Self {
356        self.mosaic_response = response;
357        self
358    }
359
360    fn with_aw_coordinates(
361        mut self,
362        parallactic_angles_rad: [f64; 2],
363        pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell: [f64; 2],
364        mueller_element: u32,
365        prediction_w_m: f64,
366    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
367        let pa = 0.5 * (parallactic_angles_rad[0] + parallactic_angles_rad[1]);
368        if !pa.is_finite()
369            || !prediction_w_m.is_finite()
370            || pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell
371                .iter()
372                .any(|value| !value.is_finite())
373        {
374            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
375        }
376        self.parallactic_angle_deg = pa.to_degrees();
377        self.pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell = pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell;
378        self.mueller_element = mueller_element;
379        self.aw_prediction_w_m = Some(prediction_w_m);
380        Ok(self)
381    }
382
383    fn with_published_weight(
384        mut self,
385        published_weight: f64,
386    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
387        if !published_weight.is_finite() || published_weight < 0.0 {
388            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
389        }
390        self.published_weight = published_weight;
391        Ok(self)
392    }
393
394    fn uv_lambda(self) -> [f64; 2] {
395        let scale = self.frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S;
396        [self.uvw_m[0] * scale, self.uvw_m[1] * scale]
397    }
398
399    fn uvw_lambda(self) -> [f64; 3] {
400        let scale = self.frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S;
401        [
402            self.uvw_m[0] * scale,
403            self.uvw_m[1] * scale,
404            self.uvw_m[2] * scale,
405        ]
406    }
407
408    fn phase(self) -> Complex64 {
409        let angle =
410            std::f64::consts::TAU * self.phase_shift_m * self.frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S;
411        Complex64::from_polar(1.0, angle)
412    }
413}

415/// One bounded output-channel slab and its sampler-required model halo.
416///
417/// Core channels own dirty, PSF, sum-weight, validity, and normal-state output.
418/// Resident halo channels exist only so the paired forward operator can
419/// evaluate every sparse stencil that contributes to a core channel. Slab
420/// boundaries therefore cannot change the scientific result.
421#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
422pub struct SpectralSlabPlan {
423    total_channels: usize,
424    core_start: usize,
425    core_end: usize,
426    resident_start: usize,
427    resident_end: usize,
428}
429
430impl SpectralSlabPlan {
431    fn compile(
432        total_channels: usize,
433        core_start: usize,
434        core_depth: usize,
435        kernel: SpectralKernel,
436    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
437        let core_end = core_start
438            .checked_add(core_depth)
439            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
440        if total_channels == 0
441            || core_depth == 0
442            || core_start >= total_channels
443            || core_end > total_channels
444        {
445            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab);
446        }
447        let halo = match kernel {
448            SpectralKernel::Identity | SpectralKernel::Nearest => 0,
449            SpectralKernel::Linear => 1,
450            SpectralKernel::Cubic => 3,
451            SpectralKernel::ChannelIntegration { maximum_terms } => maximum_terms
452                .checked_sub(1)
453                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab)?,
454        };
455        Ok(Self {
456            total_channels,
457            core_start,
458            core_end,
459            resident_start: core_start.saturating_sub(halo),
460            resident_end: core_end.saturating_add(halo).min(total_channels),
461        })
462    }
463
464    /// Return the total compiled output-channel count.
465    #[must_use]
466    pub const fn total_channels(self) -> usize {
467        self.total_channels
468    }
469
470    /// Return the half-open output-channel range owned by this slab.
471    #[must_use]
472    pub const fn core_range(self) -> std::ops::Range<usize> {
473        self.core_start..self.core_end
474    }
475
476    /// Return the half-open model-channel range resident for paired prediction.
477    #[must_use]
478    pub const fn resident_range(self) -> std::ops::Range<usize> {
479        self.resident_start..self.resident_end
480    }
481
482    /// Return the number of output channels owned by this slab.
483    #[must_use]
484    pub const fn core_depth(self) -> usize {
485        self.core_end - self.core_start
486    }
487
488    /// Return the number of model planes resident including sampler halo.
489    #[must_use]
490    pub const fn resident_depth(self) -> usize {
491        self.resident_end - self.resident_start
492    }
493
494    fn owns(self, channel: usize) -> bool {
495        self.core_range().contains(&channel)
496    }
497
498    fn resident_index(self, channel: usize) -> Option<usize> {
499        self.resident_range()
500            .contains(&channel)
501            .then(|| channel - self.resident_start)
502    }
503
504    fn core_index(self, channel: usize) -> Option<usize> {
505        self.owns(channel).then(|| channel - self.core_start)
506    }
507}

509/// Immutable scientific specification for the serial CPU standard operator.
510///
511/// This value validates the supported geometry, polarization, reconstruction,

513/// `casa-imaging-runtime` and are deliberately absent here.

515pub struct SpectralOperatorSpecification {
516    problem: CompiledProblemId,

526    mosaic_response_selections: Box<[MosaicResponseSelection]>,
527    mosaic_field_capacity: usize,
528    mosaic_normal_entry_capacity: usize,
529    selected_spectral_channel_counts: BTreeMap<(MeasurementSetIdentity, u32), usize>,
530    primary_beam_cutoff: f32,
531    polarization_coordinates: Box<[PolarizationCoordinate]>,
532    image_shape: [usize; 2],
533    grid_shape: [usize; 2],
534    image_blc: [usize; 2],
535    increment_rad: [f64; 2],
536    domains: Box<[SpectralOperatorDomainSpecification]>,
537    charts: Box<[SpectralOperatorChartSpecification]>,
538    slab: SpectralSlabPlan,
539    spectral_kernel: SpectralKernel,

551#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
552struct MosaicResponseSelection {

559#[derive(Debug)]
560struct MosaicResponsePlan {
561    responses: BTreeMap<
562        (
563            MeasurementSetIdentity,
564            u32,
565            u32,
566            casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass,
567            casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass,
568            casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass,
569        ),
570        MosaicResponse,
571    >,
572    route_capacity: usize,
573}
574
575impl MosaicResponsePlan {
576    const fn with_capacity(route_capacity: usize) -> Self {
577        Self {
578            responses: BTreeMap::new(),
579            route_capacity,
580        }
581    }
582
583    fn response(
584        &mut self,
585        selections: &[MosaicResponseSelection],
586        address: casa_imaging_model::SelectedSampleAddress,
587        evaluation_frequency_hz: f64,
588        antenna_responses: Option<SelectedAntennaResponses>,
589    ) -> Result<Option<MosaicResponse>, SpectralOperatorError> {
590        if self.route_capacity == 0 {
591            return Ok(None);
592        }
593        let antenna_responses =
594            antenna_responses.ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?;
595        let route = (
596            address.measurement_set,
597            address.spectral_window_id,
598            address.channel_index,
599            antenna_responses.antenna1,
600            antenna_responses.antenna2,
601            antenna_responses.family_envelope,
602        );
603        if let Some(response) = self.responses.get(&route) {
604            return Ok(Some(*response));
605        }
606        let selection = selections
607            .iter()
608            .find(|selection| {
609                selection.measurement_set == address.measurement_set
610                    && selection.spectral_window_id == address.spectral_window_id
611                    && selection.channel_indices.contains(&address.channel_index)
612            })
613            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
614        if !evaluation_frequency_hz.is_finite()
615            || evaluation_frequency_hz <= 0.0
616            || !address.frequency_centre_hz.is_finite()
617            || address.frequency_centre_hz <= 0.0
618        {
619            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
620        }
621        let native_frequency_hz = selection
622            .coordinate_catalog
623            .channel_frequency_hz(
624                usize::try_from(address.channel_index)
625                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
626            )
627            .filter(|frequency_hz| frequency_hz.to_bits() == address.frequency_centre_hz.to_bits())
628            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
629        let frame_scale = evaluation_frequency_hz / native_frequency_hz;
630        let evaluation_frequencies = selection
631            .channel_indices
632            .iter()
633            .map(|channel| {
634                selection
635                    .coordinate_catalog
636                    .channel_frequency_hz(
637                        usize::try_from(*channel)
638                            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
639                    )
640                    .map(|frequency_hz| frequency_hz * frame_scale)
641                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)
642            })
643            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
644        let (mapping, response_frequencies) = casa_useful_mosaic_channels(
645            selection.coordinate_catalog.channel_frequencies_hz(),
646            selection.coordinate_catalog.first_channel_width_hz().abs(),
647            &selection.channel_indices,
648            &evaluation_frequencies,
649        )?;
650        let support_frequency_hz = response_frequencies
651            .iter()
652            .copied()
653            .reduce(f64::max)
654            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
655        if self
656            .responses
657            .len()
658            .checked_add(selection.channel_indices.len())
659            .is_none_or(|needed| needed > self.route_capacity)
660        {
661            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow);
662        }
663        for (channel, response_index) in selection.channel_indices.iter().zip(mapping) {
664            let frequency_hz = response_frequencies[response_index];
665            self.responses.insert(
666                (
667                    selection.measurement_set,
668                    selection.spectral_window_id,
669                    *channel,
670                    antenna_responses.antenna1,
671                    antenna_responses.antenna2,
672                    antenna_responses.family_envelope,
673                ),
674                MosaicResponse {
675                    key: mosaic_response_key(frequency_hz, support_frequency_hz, antenna_responses),
676                    frequency_hz,
677                    support_frequency_hz,
678                    antenna_responses,
679                },
680            );
681        }
682        self.responses
683            .get(&route)
684            .copied()
685            .map(Some)
686            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)
687    }
688}
689
690pub(crate) fn mosaic_response_key(
691    frequency_hz: f64,
692    support_frequency_hz: f64,
693    responses: SelectedAntennaResponses,
694) -> MosaicProjectorKey {
695    let (antenna1, antenna2) = if responses.antenna1 <= responses.antenna2 {
696        (responses.antenna1, responses.antenna2)
697    } else {
698        (responses.antenna2, responses.antenna1)
699    };
700    MosaicProjectorKey {
701        frequency_bits: frequency_hz.to_bits(),
702        support_frequency_bits: support_frequency_hz.to_bits(),
703        antenna1,
704        antenna2,
705        family_envelope: responses.family_envelope,
706    }
707}
708
709fn casa_useful_mosaic_channels(
710    full_spw_frequencies_hz: &[f64],
711    first_native_width_hz: f64,
712    selected_channel_indices: &[u32],
713    evaluation_frequencies_hz: &[f64],
714) -> Result<(Vec<usize>, Vec<f64>), SpectralOperatorError> {
715    if full_spw_frequencies_hz.is_empty()
716        || selected_channel_indices.is_empty()
717        || selected_channel_indices.len() != evaluation_frequencies_hz.len()
718        || full_spw_frequencies_hz
719            .iter()
720            .chain(evaluation_frequencies_hz)
721            .any(|frequency| !frequency.is_finite() || *frequency <= 0.0)
722        || !first_native_width_hz.is_finite()
723        || first_native_width_hz <= 0.0
724        || selected_channel_indices.iter().any(|channel| {
725            usize::try_from(*channel)
726                .ok()
727                .is_none_or(|channel| channel >= full_spw_frequencies_hz.len())
728        })
729    {
730        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
731    }
732    let min_frequency = evaluation_frequencies_hz
733        .iter()
734        .copied()
735        .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
736    let max_frequency = evaluation_frequencies_hz
737        .iter()
738        .copied()
739        .fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);
740    let original_width = if evaluation_frequencies_hz.len() == 1 {
741        1.0e12
742    } else {
743        (max_frequency - min_frequency) / (evaluation_frequencies_hz.len() - 1) as f64
744    };
745    let native_max = full_spw_frequencies_hz
746        .iter()
747        .copied()
748        .fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);
749    let mut tolerance = (native_max * 0.005).max(original_width / 2.0);
750    let mut top_frequency = native_max;
751    while top_frequency > max_frequency {
752        top_frequency -= tolerance;
753    }
754    if top_frequency < min_frequency {
755        top_frequency += tolerance;
756    }
757    let mut bottom_frequency = top_frequency;
758    let mut response_count = 0usize;
759    while bottom_frequency > min_frequency {
760        response_count += 1;
761        bottom_frequency -= tolerance;
762    }
763    if response_count > 1 {
764        response_count -= 1;
765        bottom_frequency += tolerance;
766    }
767    if response_count > evaluation_frequencies_hz.len() {
768        response_count = evaluation_frequencies_hz.len();
769        tolerance = first_native_width_hz;
770        bottom_frequency = selected_channel_indices
771            .iter()
772            .map(|channel| full_spw_frequencies_hz[*channel as usize])
773            .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
774    }
775    if response_count >= evaluation_frequencies_hz.len().saturating_sub(1) {
776        return Ok((
777            (0..evaluation_frequencies_hz.len()).collect(),
778            evaluation_frequencies_hz.to_vec(),
779        ));
780    }
781    if response_count == 0 || evaluation_frequencies_hz.len() == 1 {
782        return Ok((
783            vec![0; evaluation_frequencies_hz.len()],
784            vec![bottom_frequency],
785        ));
786    }
787    let response_frequencies = (0..response_count)
788        .map(|index| index as f64 * tolerance + bottom_frequency)
789        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
790    let mapping = evaluation_frequencies_hz
791        .iter()
792        .map(|frequency| {
793            response_frequencies
794                .iter()
795                .enumerate()
796                .min_by(|(_, left), (_, right)| {
797                    (*frequency - **left)
798                        .abs()
799                        .total_cmp(&(*frequency - **right).abs())
800                })
801                .map(|(index, _)| index)
802                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)
803        })
804        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
805    Ok((mapping, response_frequencies))
806}

829fn pixel_has_later_domain_owner(
830    specification: Option<&SpectralOperatorSpecification>,
831    domain_ordinal: usize,
832    pixel: [usize; 2],
833) -> Result<bool, SpectralOperatorError> {
834    let Some(specification) = specification else {
835        return Ok(false);
836    };
837    let domain = specification
838        .domains
839        .get(domain_ordinal)
840        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ModelShape)?;
841    for later in specification.domains.iter().skip(domain_ordinal + 1) {
842        if crate::mask::reprojected_pixel(
843            later.direction,
844            later.image_shape,
845            domain.direction,
846            pixel,
847        )
848        .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedMultiDomainProblem)?
849        .is_some()
850        {
851            return Ok(true);
852        }
853    }
854    Ok(false)
855}

899impl SpectralOperatorSpecification {
900    /// Whether this pass is certified to start from the compiler's empty model.
901    ///
902    /// A later residual refresh always evaluates its named model, even when the
903    /// original compiled input was empty. Seeded initial models are also evaluated.
904    #[must_use]
905    pub const fn is_initial_certified_zero(&self, pass: SpectralOperatorPass) -> bool {
906        matches!(
907            (pass, self.initial_model),
908            (
909                SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor,
910                InitialModelClassification::Empty
911            )
912        )
913    }
914
915    /// Compile one full-depth spectral specification.
916    pub fn new(problem: &CompiledProblem) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
917        let channels = output_channel_count(problem)?;
918        Self::for_slab(problem, 0, channels)
919    }
920
921    /// Compile one bounded output-channel slab.
922    pub fn for_slab(
923        problem: &CompiledProblem,
924        core_start: usize,
925        core_depth: usize,
926    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
927        let basis = spectral_basis_plan(problem)?;
928        let channels = output_channel_count(problem)?;
929        if problem.geometry().domains().is_empty()
930            || problem
931                .reconstruction()
932                .polarization()
933                .coordinates()
934                .is_empty()
935        {
936            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
937        }
938        let instrument_response = problem
939            .science()
940            .measurement_equation()
941            .instrument_response();
942        let instrument_model = problem.science().instrument_model();
943        let w_projection = problem.science().measurement_equation().w_projection();
944        let aw_projection = problem.science().measurement_equation().aw_projection();
945        let mosaic = matches!(
946            problem.geometry().uvw(),
947            UvwCoordinateLaw::MosaicPhaseTrackingCentre
948        ) && aw_projection.is_none();
949        if mosaic
950            && !matches!(
951                problem.geometry().centres().pointing(),
952                PointingCentreLaw::Observation(_)
953            )
954        {
955            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
956        }
957        if mosaic && w_projection.is_some() {
958            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
959        }
960        match (instrument_response, instrument_model, basis, mosaic) {
961            (InstrumentResponse::Scalar, None, _, false) => {}
962            (
963                InstrumentResponse::PrimaryBeam,
964                Some(InstrumentModel::CasaAca7mInterferometricDirectPbV1),
965                SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_),
966                false,
967            ) => {}
968            (
969                InstrumentResponse::PrimaryBeam,
970                Some(InstrumentModel::CasaAlmaAcaHeterogeneousInterferometricResponseV1),
971                SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal | SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_),
972                true,
973            ) => {}
974            (
975                InstrumentResponse::PrimaryBeam,
976                Some(InstrumentModel::CasaEvlaWidebandAwV1),
977                _,
978                false,
979            ) if aw_projection.is_some() => {}
980            _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem),
981        }
982        if aw_projection.is_some()
983            && problem.reconstruction().polarization().coordinates()
984                != [PolarizationCoordinate::StokesI]
985        {
986            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
987        }
988        let multi_domain_basis_supported = match basis {
989            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) => {
990                plan.coefficient_term_count() == 1 && core_start == 0 && core_depth == 1
991            }
992            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => true,
993            SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) | SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => false,
994        };
995        if problem.geometry().domains().len() > 1 && !multi_domain_basis_supported {
996            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedMultiDomainProblem);
997        }
998        if matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_)) && (core_start != 0 || core_depth != 1)
999        {
1000            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab);
1001        }
1002        if matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. })
1003            && (core_start != 0 || core_depth != channels)
1004        {
1005            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab);
1006        }
1007        let slab = SpectralSlabPlan::compile(
1008            channels,
1009            core_start,
1010            core_depth,
1011            if matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_)) {
1012                SpectralKernel::Identity
1013            } else {
1014                problem.science().spectral().sampling().kernel()
1015            },
1016        )?;
1017        let mut domains = Vec::with_capacity(problem.geometry().domains().len());
1018        let mut charts = Vec::new();
1019        for (ordinal, domain) in problem.geometry().domains().iter().enumerate() {
1020            if domain.psf_phase_centre() != domain.model_phase_centre() {
1021                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedMultiDomainProblem);
1022            }
1023            let chart_start = charts.len();
1024            for (facet_ordinal, window) in domain.facets().iter().copied().enumerate() {
1025                let origin = window.origin();
1026                let end = window.end_exclusive();
1027                let image_shape = [end[0] - origin[0], end[1] - origin[1]];
1028                let direction = if domain.facets().len() == 1 {
1029                    domain.direction()
1030                } else {
1031                    let local_centre = window.local_centre_pixel();
1032                    window
1033                        .direction()
1034                        .with_reference_pixel([local_centre[0] as f64, local_centre[1] as f64])
1035                };
1036                let grid_geometry = if aw_projection.is_some() {
1037                    OperatorGridGeometry::AwProjection
1038                } else if mosaic {
1039                    OperatorGridGeometry::Mosaic
1040                } else {
1041                    OperatorGridGeometry::Standard
1042                };
1043                charts.push(SpectralOperatorChartSpecification {
1044                    ordinal: charts.len(),
1045                    domain_ordinal: ordinal,
1046                    facet_ordinal,
1047                    window,
1048                    geometry: compile_operator_geometry(image_shape, direction, grid_geometry)?,
1049                });
1050            }
1051            domains.push(SpectralOperatorDomainSpecification {
1052                ordinal,
1053                role: domain.role().clone(),
1054                image_shape: domain.shape().pixels(),
1055                direction: domain.direction(),
1056                chart_start,
1057                chart_end: charts.len(),
1058            });
1059        }
1060        let domains = domains.into_boxed_slice();
1061        let charts = charts.into_boxed_slice();
1062        let primary = charts
1063            .first()
1064            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?
1065            .geometry;
1066        let mut selected_spectral_channel_counts = BTreeMap::new();
1067        for source in problem.inputs().observation_snapshot().sources() {
1068            for spectral_window in source.selection().spectral_windows() {
1069                selected_spectral_channel_counts.insert(
1070                    (source.identity(), spectral_window.spectral_window_id()),
1071                    spectral_window.channel_indices().len(),
1072                );
1073            }
1074        }
1075        let (mosaic_response_selections, mosaic_field_capacity, mosaic_normal_entry_capacity) =
1076            if mosaic {
1077                let mut selections = Vec::new();
1078                let mut field_capacity = 0usize;
1079                let mut normal_entry_capacity = 0usize;
1080                for source in problem.inputs().observation_snapshot().sources() {
1081                    let selection = source.selection();
1082                    let mut selected_channels = 0usize;
1083                    for spectral_window in selection.spectral_windows() {
1084                        selected_channels = selected_channels
1085                            .checked_add(spectral_window.channel_indices().len())
1086                            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1087                        selections.push(MosaicResponseSelection {
1088                            measurement_set: source.identity(),
1089                            spectral_window_id: spectral_window.spectral_window_id(),
1090                            channel_indices: spectral_window.channel_indices().into(),
1091                            coordinate_catalog: spectral_window
1092                                .coordinate_catalog()
1093                                .cloned()
1094                                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?,
1095                        });
1096                    }
1097                    let source_fields = selection
1098                        .rows_filter()
1099                        .fields()
1100                        .ids()
1101                        .map_or_else(
1102                            || usize::try_from(selection.rows().selected_row_count()),
1103                            |fields| Ok(fields.len()),
1104                        )
1105                        .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1106                    field_capacity = field_capacity
1107                        .checked_add(source_fields)
1108                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1109                    normal_entry_capacity = normal_entry_capacity
1110                        .checked_add(
1111                            usize::try_from(selection.rows().selected_row_count())
1112                                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?
1113                                .checked_mul(selected_channels)
1114                                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
1115                        )
1116                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1117                }
1118                (
1119                    selections.into_boxed_slice(),
1120                    field_capacity,
1121                    normal_entry_capacity,
1122                )
1123            } else {
1124                (Box::default(), 0, 0)
1125            };
1126        if !problem
1127            .numerics()
1128            .permitted_precisions()
1129            .contains(&NumericPrecision::F64)
1130            || problem.numerics().reduction() != ReductionPolicy::Compensated
1131            || !matches!(
1132                problem.numerics().finite_values(),
1133                FiniteValuePolicy::RejectAll | FiniteValuePolicy::FlagInputRejectGenerated
1134            )
1135        {
1136            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedNumerics);
1137        }
1138        Ok(Self {
1139            problem: problem.problem_id(),
1140            initial_model: match problem.model_lifecycle().input() {
1141                ModelInputCommitment::Empty => InitialModelClassification::Empty,
1142                _ => InitialModelClassification::Evaluated,
1143            },
1144            geometry: problem.geometry().geometry_id(),
1145            numerics: problem.numerics_id(),
1146            weighting_commitment: problem.weighting().commitment_id(),
1147            finite_values: problem.numerics().finite_values(),
1148            instrument_model,
1149            w_projection,
1150            aw_projection,
1151            mosaic,
1152            mosaic_response_selections,
1153            mosaic_field_capacity,
1154            mosaic_normal_entry_capacity,
1155            selected_spectral_channel_counts,
1156            primary_beam_cutoff: problem.products().validity().primary_beam().cutoff(),
1157            polarization_coordinates: problem.reconstruction().polarization().coordinates().into(),
1158            image_shape: domains[0].image_shape,
1159            grid_shape: primary.grid_shape,
1160            image_blc: primary.image_blc,
1161            increment_rad: primary.increment_rad,
1162            domains,
1163            charts,
1164            slab,
1165            spectral_kernel: problem.science().spectral().sampling().kernel(),
1166            basis,
1167            joint_line_term_by_channel: joint_line_term_by_channel(problem, basis)?,
1168            output_channel_frequencies_hz: (0..problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels())
1169                .map(|channel| {
1170                    problem
1171                        .geometry()
1172                        .spectral()
1173                        .channel_centre_hz(channel)
1174                        .expect("compiled channel has a finite centre")
1175                })
1176                .collect(),
1177        })
1178    }

1274    /// Conservative W-kernel halo known before physical execution.
1275    #[must_use]
1276    pub fn maximum_convolution_support(&self) -> usize {
1277        self.w_projection.map_or(SUPPORT, |_| {
1278            self.charts
1279                .iter()
1280                .map(|chart| {
1281                    let conv_size = chart.geometry.grid_shape.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
1282                    let contract = self.w_projection.expect("W contract is present");
1283                    let half_field_angle = ((chart.geometry.image_shape[0] as f64
1284                        * chart.geometry.increment_rad[0].abs())
1285                    .max(
1286                        chart.geometry.image_shape[1] as f64
1287                            * chart.geometry.increment_rad[1].abs(),
1288                    )) / 2.0;
1289                    let automatic =
1290                        (1.05 * contract.maximum_abs_w_lambda() * half_field_angle.sin().abs())
1291                            as usize;
1292                    let planes = contract
1293                        .planes()
1294                        .map(std::num::NonZeroUsize::get)
1295                        .unwrap_or(automatic.max(1));
1296                    let sampling = if planes > 1 { 4 } else { 1 };
1297                    ((conv_size / 2).saturating_sub(2) as f64 / sampling as f64 - 0.5)
1298                        .ceil()
1299                        .max(1.0) as usize
1300                })
1301                .max()
1302                .unwrap_or(SUPPORT)
1303        })
1304    }
1305
1306    /// Return reconstruction polarization coordinates in canonical plane order.
1307    #[must_use]
1308    pub const fn polarization_coordinates(&self) -> &[PolarizationCoordinate] {
1309        &self.polarization_coordinates
1310    }
1311
1312    pub(crate) const fn polarization_count(&self) -> usize {
1313        self.polarization_coordinates.len()
1314    }

1316    /// Return the exact bounded slab compiled into this operator.
1317    #[must_use]
1318    pub const fn slab(&self) -> SpectralSlabPlan {
1319        self.slab
1320    }
1321
1322    pub(crate) const fn coefficient_terms(&self) -> usize {
1323        self.basis.coefficient_terms(self.slab)
1324    }
1325
1326    pub(crate) const fn normal_moments(&self) -> usize {
1327        self.basis.normal_moments(self.slab)
1328    }
1329
1330    pub(crate) const fn forward_terms(&self) -> usize {
1331        if self.instrument_model.is_some() && self.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
1332            self.slab.resident_depth()
1333        } else {
1334            self.basis.resident_terms(self.slab)
1335        }
1336    }
1337
1338    pub(crate) const fn resident_model_terms(&self) -> usize {
1339        self.basis.resident_terms(self.slab)
1340    }

1342    pub(crate) const fn block_normal_plan(&self) -> Option<BlockNormalPlan> {
1343        self.basis.polynomial()
1344    }

1346    pub(crate) const fn channel_major_taylor_plan(&self) -> Option<BlockNormalPlan> {
1347        self.basis.channel_major_taylor()
1348    }

1350    pub(crate) const fn joint_continuum_term_count(&self) -> Option<usize> {
1351        match self.basis {
1352            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { continuum, .. } => Some(continuum.coefficient_term_count()),
1353            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal
1354            | SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_)
1355            | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => None,
1356        }
1357    }
1358}

1360#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
1361enum OperatorGridGeometry {
1362    Standard,
1363    Mosaic,
1364    AwProjection,
1365}
1366
1367fn compile_operator_geometry(
1368    image_shape: [usize; 2],
1369    direction: casa_imaging_model::DirectionCoordinateSpec,
1370    operator: OperatorGridGeometry,
1371) -> Result<SpectralOperatorGeometry, SpectralOperatorError> {
1372    let unpadded = matches!(
1373        operator,
1374        OperatorGridGeometry::Mosaic | OperatorGridGeometry::AwProjection
1375    );
1376    let grid_shape = if unpadded {
1377        image_shape
1378    } else {
1379        [
1380            casa_composite_padded_len(image_shape[0], 1.2),
1381            casa_composite_padded_len(image_shape[1], 1.2),
1382        ]
1383    };
1384    let reference_pixel = direction.reference_pixel();
1385    if direction.projection() != Projection::Sin
1386        || direction.pc() != [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]]
1387        || direction.pole_deg() != [180.0, 0.0]
1388        || reference_pixel
1389            .iter()
1390            .any(|value| !value.is_finite() || *value < 0.0 || value.fract() != 0.0)
1391    {
1392        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGeometry);
1393    }
1394    let reference_pixel = [reference_pixel[0] as usize, reference_pixel[1] as usize];
1395    let image_blc = if unpadded {
1396        [0, 0]
1397    } else {
1398        [
1399            grid_shape[0]
1400                .checked_div(2)
1401                .and_then(|centre| centre.checked_sub(reference_pixel[0]))
1402                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGeometry)?,
1403            grid_shape[1]
1404                .checked_div(2)
1405                .and_then(|centre| centre.checked_sub(reference_pixel[1]))
1406                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGeometry)?,
1407        ]
1408    };
1409    if image_blc[0]
1410        .checked_add(image_shape[0])
1411        .is_none_or(|end| end > grid_shape[0])
1412        || image_blc[1]
1413            .checked_add(image_shape[1])
1414            .is_none_or(|end| end > grid_shape[1])
1415    {
1416        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGeometry);
1417    }
1418    Ok(SpectralOperatorGeometry {
1419        image_shape,
1420        grid_shape,
1421        image_blc,
1422        reference_pixel: direction.reference_pixel(),
1423        increment_rad: direction.increment_rad(),
1424        direction,
1425    })
1426}
1427
1428fn output_channel_count(problem: &CompiledProblem) -> Result<usize, SpectralOperatorError> {
1429    match problem.reconstruction().basis() {
1430        ReconstructionBasis::Constant => Ok(1),
1431        ReconstructionBasis::Taylor { terms } if terms >= 2 => Ok(1),
1432        ReconstructionBasis::TaylorViaChannelMajor { terms, channels }
1433            if terms >= 2
1434                && channels >= terms
1435                && channels == problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels() =>
1436        {
1437            Ok(channels)
1438        }
1439        ReconstructionBasis::ChannelLocal { channels }
1440            if channels == problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels() && channels > 0 =>
1441        {
1442            Ok(channels)
1443        }
1444        ReconstructionBasis::Taylor { .. }
1445        | ReconstructionBasis::TaylorViaChannelMajor { .. }
1446        | ReconstructionBasis::ChannelLocal { .. } => {
1447            Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)
1448        }
1449        ReconstructionBasis::JointContinuumLine { .. } => {
1450            Ok(problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels())
1451        }
1452    }
1453}
1454
1455fn spectral_basis_plan(
1456    problem: &CompiledProblem,
1457) -> Result<SpectralBasisPlan, SpectralOperatorError> {
1458    match problem.reconstruction().basis() {
1459        ReconstructionBasis::ChannelLocal { channels }
1460            if channels == problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels() && channels > 0 =>
1461        {
1462            Ok(SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal)
1463        }
1464        ReconstructionBasis::Constant => {
1465            let reference_frequency_hz = problem
1466                .geometry()
1467                .spectral()
1468                .channel_centre_hz(0)
1469                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?;
1470            BlockNormalPlan::constant(reference_frequency_hz)
1471                .map(SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial)
1472                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)
1473        }
1474        ReconstructionBasis::Taylor { terms } => {
1475            let SpectralWcs::Linear {
1476                reference_frequency_hz,
1477                ..
1478            } = problem.geometry().spectral().wcs()
1479            else {
1480                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
1481            };
1482            if problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels() != 1 {
1483                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
1484            }
1485            BlockNormalPlan::taylor(*reference_frequency_hz, terms)
1486                .map(SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial)
1487                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)
1488        }
1489        ReconstructionBasis::TaylorViaChannelMajor { terms, channels } => {
1490            let SpectralWcs::Linear {
1491                reference_frequency_hz,
1492                ..
1493            } = problem.geometry().spectral().wcs()
1494            else {
1495                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
1496            };
1497            if channels != problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels() || channels < terms {
1498                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
1499            }
1500            BlockNormalPlan::taylor(*reference_frequency_hz, terms)
1501                .map(SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor)
1502                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)
1503        }
1504        ReconstructionBasis::ChannelLocal { .. } => Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem),
1505        ReconstructionBasis::JointContinuumLine {
1506            continuum_terms,
1507            line_terms,
1508        } => {
1509            let SpectralWcs::Linear {
1510                reference_frequency_hz,
1511                ..
1512            } = problem.geometry().spectral().wcs()
1513            else {
1514                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
1515            };
1516            BlockNormalPlan::compile(*reference_frequency_hz, continuum_terms)
1517                .map(|continuum| SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
1518                    continuum,
1519                    line_terms,
1520                })
1521                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)
1522        }
1523    }
1524}
1525
1526fn joint_line_term_by_channel(
1527    problem: &CompiledProblem,
1528    basis: SpectralBasisPlan,
1529) -> Result<Box<[Option<usize>]>, SpectralOperatorError> {
1530    let channels = problem.geometry().spectral().output_channels();
1531    if !matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
1532        return Ok(vec![None; channels].into_boxed_slice());
1533    }
1534    let contract = problem
1535        .reconstruction()
1536        .joint_continuum_line()
1537        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?;
1538    let mut mapping = vec![None; channels];
1539    for (term, channel) in contract.line_channels().iter().copied().enumerate() {
1540        *mapping
1541            .get_mut(channel)
1542            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)? = Some(term);
1543    }
1544    Ok(mapping.into_boxed_slice())
1545}

1547/// Runtime-facing workload dimensions for one serial operator instance.
1548///
1549/// The runtime converts these implementation counts into physical byte
1550/// allocations; reconstruction does not own that projection.
1551#[doc(hidden)]
1552#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
1553pub enum SpectralOperatorPass {
1554    /// Produce dirty, PSF, and exact residual state without prior invariants.
1555    InitialMajor,
1556    /// Reuse invariant normal state and produce only the model-dependent residual.
1557    ResidualRefresh,
1558}

1560#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
1561enum ReconstructionModelBinding {
1562    InitialCertifiedZero(ModelGenerationId),
1563    Evaluated(ModelGenerationId),
1564}
1565
1566impl ReconstructionModelBinding {
1567    const fn generation(self) -> ModelGenerationId {
1568        match self {
1569            Self::InitialCertifiedZero(generation) | Self::Evaluated(generation) => generation,
1570        }
1571    }
1572
1573    const fn is_evaluated(self) -> bool {
1574        matches!(self, Self::Evaluated(_))
1575    }
1576
1577    const fn is_initial_certified_zero(self) -> bool {
1578        matches!(self, Self::InitialCertifiedZero(_))
1579    }
1580}
1581
1582const fn reconstruction_model_binding(
1583    pass: SpectralOperatorPass,
1584    generation: ModelGenerationId,
1585    origin: ModelGenerationOrigin,
1586) -> ReconstructionModelBinding {
1587    match (pass, origin) {
1588        (SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor, ModelGenerationOrigin::Empty) => {
1589            ReconstructionModelBinding::InitialCertifiedZero(generation)
1590        }
1591        _ => ReconstructionModelBinding::Evaluated(generation),
1592    }
1593}

1814/// Return implementation dimensions for the runtime's physical projection.
1815#[doc(hidden)]
1816pub fn spectral_operator_workload(
1817    specification: &SpectralOperatorSpecification,
1818    max_replay_block_samples: usize,
1819    pass: SpectralOperatorPass,
1820) -> Result<SpectralOperatorWorkload, SpectralOperatorError> {
1821    if max_replay_block_samples == 0 {
1822        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
1823    }
1824    let coefficient_terms = specification.coefficient_terms();
1825    let normal_moments = specification.normal_moments();
1826    let major_coefficient_planes = specification
1827        .basis
1828        .major_coefficient_planes(specification.slab);
1829    let major_normal_planes = specification.basis.major_normal_planes(specification.slab);
1830    let polarizations = specification.polarization_count();
1831    let initial_certified_zero = specification.is_initial_certified_zero(pass);
1832    let joint_channels = usize::from(matches!(
1833        specification.basis,
1834        SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }
1835    ))
1836    .checked_mul(specification.slab.total_channels())
1837    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1838    let grid_planes = match pass {
1839        SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor => major_coefficient_planes
1840            .checked_mul(if initial_certified_zero { 2 } else { 4 })
1841            .and_then(|values| {
1842                major_normal_planes
1843                    .checked_mul(2)
1844                    .and_then(|moments| values.checked_add(moments))
1845                    .and_then(|planes| {
1846                        usize::from(specification.aw_projection.is_some())
1847                            .checked_mul(major_normal_planes)
1848                            .and_then(|moments| moments.checked_mul(2))
1849                            .and_then(|sensitivity| planes.checked_add(sensitivity))
1850                    })
1851                    .and_then(|planes| {
1852                        joint_channels
1853                            .checked_mul(2)
1854                            .and_then(|common| planes.checked_add(common))
1855                    })
1856            }),
1857        SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh => {
1858            major_coefficient_planes.checked_mul(2).and_then(|planes| {
1859                joint_channels
1860                    .checked_mul(2)
1861                    .and_then(|common| planes.checked_add(common))
1862            })
1863        }
1864    }
1865    .and_then(|planes| planes.checked_mul(polarizations))
1866    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1867    let grid_complex_values = specification
1868        .charts
1869        .iter()
1870        .try_fold(0_usize, |total, chart| {
1871            checked_cells(chart.geometry.grid_shape)?
1872                .checked_mul(grid_planes)
1873                .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
1874                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1875        })?;
1876    let convolution_f64_values =
1877        specification
1878            .charts
1879            .iter()
1880            .try_fold(0_usize, |total, chart| {
1881                let standard = (OVERSAMPLING + 1)
1882                    .checked_mul(TAP_COUNT)
1883                    .and_then(|values| {
1884                        values.checked_add(
1885                            chart.geometry.grid_shape[0] + chart.geometry.grid_shape[1],
1886                        )
1887                    });
1888                let projected = specification.w_projection.map_or(standard, |contract| {
1889                    let conv_size = chart.geometry.grid_shape.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
1890                    let half_field_angle = ((chart.geometry.image_shape[0] as f64
1891                        * chart.geometry.increment_rad[0].abs())
1892                    .max(
1893                        chart.geometry.image_shape[1] as f64
1894                            * chart.geometry.increment_rad[1].abs(),
1895                    )) / 2.0;
1896                    let automatic =
1897                        (1.05 * contract.maximum_abs_w_lambda() * half_field_angle.sin().abs())
1898                            as usize;
1899                    let planes = contract
1900                        .planes()
1901                        .map(std::num::NonZeroUsize::get)
1902                        .unwrap_or(automatic.max(1));
1903                    let quarter_cells = (conv_size / 2)
1904                        .saturating_sub(1)
1905                        .checked_mul((conv_size / 2).saturating_sub(1));
1906                    let retained = quarter_cells
1907                        .and_then(|cells| cells.checked_mul(planes))
1908                        .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(2));
1909                    let build_workspace = conv_size
1910                        .checked_mul(conv_size)
1911                        .and_then(|cells| cells.checked_mul(4));
1912                    standard
1913                        .and_then(|values| retained.and_then(|w| values.checked_add(w)))
1914                        .and_then(|values| {
1915                            build_workspace.and_then(|workspace| values.checked_add(workspace))
1916                        })
1917                });
1918                projected
1919                    .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
1920                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1921            })?;
1922    let fft_resident_complex_values =
1923        specification
1924            .charts
1925            .iter()
1926            .try_fold(0_usize, |total, chart| {
1927                fft_resident_complex_values_for_shape(chart.geometry.grid_shape)?
1928                    .checked_add(total)
1929                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1930            })?;
1931    let fft_planning_words = specification
1932        .charts
1933        .iter()
1934        .try_fold(0_usize, |total, chart| {
1935            chart
1936                .geometry
1937                .grid_shape
1938                .into_iter()
1939                .try_fold(0_usize, |domain_total, length| {
1940                    length
1941                        .checked_mul(FFT_PLANNING_WORD_BOUND_PER_POINT)
1942                        .and_then(|values| domain_total.checked_add(values))
1943                })
1944                .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
1945                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1946        })?;
1947    let forward_complex_values = specification
1948        .charts
1949        .iter()
1950        .try_fold(0_usize, |total, chart| {
1951            checked_cells(chart.geometry.grid_shape)?
1952                .checked_mul(specification.forward_terms())
1953                .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(polarizations))
1954                .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
1955                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1956        })?
1957        .checked_add(max_replay_block_samples)
1958        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1959    let image_cells = specification
1960        .domains
1961        .iter()
1962        .try_fold(0_usize, |total, domain| {
1963            checked_cells(domain.image_shape)?
1964                .checked_add(total)
1965                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1966        })?;
1967    let chart_count = specification.charts.len();
1968    let maximum_chart_cells = specification
1969        .charts
1970        .iter()
1971        .try_fold(None, |maximum, chart| {
1972            let cells = checked_cells(chart.geometry.image_shape)?;
1973            Ok::<_, SpectralOperatorError>(Some(
1974                maximum.map_or(cells, |value: usize| value.max(cells)),
1975            ))
1976        })?
1977        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGeometry)?;
1978    let mosaic_selected_channel_capacity = specification
1979        .mosaic_response_selections
1980        .iter()
1981        .try_fold(0_usize, |total, selection| {
1982            total
1983                .checked_add(selection.channel_indices.len())
1984                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
1985        })?;
1986    let mosaic_response_route_capacity = mosaic_selected_channel_capacity
1987        .checked_mul(4)
1988        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1989    let mosaic_projector_capacity = mosaic_selected_channel_capacity
1990        .checked_mul(3)
1991        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
1992    let maximum_mosaic_selection_channels = specification
1993        .mosaic_response_selections
1994        .iter()
1995        .map(|selection| selection.channel_indices.len())
1996        .max()
1997        .unwrap_or(0);
1998    let mosaic_selection_bytes = specification
1999        .mosaic_response_selections
2000        .len()
2001        .checked_mul(size_of::<MosaicResponseSelection>())
2002        .and_then(|bytes| {
2003            mosaic_selected_channel_capacity
2004                .checked_mul(size_of::<u32>())
2005                .and_then(|channels| bytes.checked_add(channels))
2006        })
2007        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2008    let response_residency = crate::mosaic::response_residency_projection(
2009        mosaic_response_route_capacity,
2010        mosaic_selection_bytes,
2011        maximum_mosaic_selection_channels,
2012    )?;
2013    let chart_residency = specification.charts.iter().try_fold(
2014        crate::mosaic::MosaicResidencyProjection {
2015            retained_bytes: 0,
2016            workspace_bytes: 0,
2017        },
2018        |total, chart| {
2019            let chart = crate::mosaic::residency_projection(
2020                chart.geometry.image_shape,
2021                chart.geometry.grid_shape,
2022                mosaic_projector_capacity,
2023                specification.mosaic_field_capacity,
2024                specification.mosaic_normal_entry_capacity,
2025                specification.mosaic_normal_entry_capacity,
2026                normal_moments
2027                    .checked_mul(polarizations)
2028                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2029            )?;
2030            Ok::<_, SpectralOperatorError>(crate::mosaic::MosaicResidencyProjection {
2031                retained_bytes: total
2032                    .retained_bytes
2033                    .checked_add(chart.retained_bytes)
2034                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2035                workspace_bytes: total.workspace_bytes.max(chart.workspace_bytes),
2036            })
2037        },
2038    )?;
2039    let mosaic_residency = crate::mosaic::MosaicResidencyProjection {
2040        retained_bytes: response_residency
2041            .retained_bytes
2042            .checked_add(chart_residency.retained_bytes)
2043            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2044        workspace_bytes: response_residency
2045            .workspace_bytes
2046            .max(chart_residency.workspace_bytes),
2047    };
2048    let parent_spectral_planes = coefficient_terms
2049        .checked_mul(match pass {
2050            SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor if initial_certified_zero => 2,
2051            SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor => 3,
2052            SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh => 2,
2053        })
2054        .and_then(|values| values.checked_add(normal_moments))
2055        .and_then(|values| {
2056            joint_channels
2057                .checked_mul(2)
2058                .and_then(|common| values.checked_add(common))
2059        })
2060        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2061    let parent_complex_planes = parent_spectral_planes
2062        .checked_mul(polarizations)
2063        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2064    let local_complex_planes = match pass {
2065        SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor => parent_spectral_planes,
2066        SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh => major_coefficient_planes
2067            .checked_add(joint_channels)
2068            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2069    }
2070    .checked_mul(polarizations)
2071    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2072    let fold_accumulator_complex_values = image_cells
2073        .checked_mul(parent_complex_planes)
2074        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2075    let domain_count = specification.domains.len();
2076    let fold_accumulator_f64_values = image_cells
2077        .checked_mul(normal_moments)
2078        .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(polarizations))
2079        .and_then(|values| {
2080            normal_moments
2081                .checked_mul(polarizations)
2082                .and_then(|weights| weights.checked_mul(2))
2083                .and_then(|weights| {
2084                    joint_channels
2085                        .checked_mul(polarizations)
2086                        .and_then(|channel_weights| weights.checked_add(channel_weights))
2087                })
2088                .and_then(|metadata| metadata.checked_mul(domain_count))
2089                .and_then(|metadata| values.checked_add(metadata))
2090        })
2091        .and_then(|values| {
2092            usize::from(
2093                specification.instrument_model.is_some()
2094                    && specification.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some(),
2095            )
2096            .checked_mul(image_cells)
2097            .and_then(|beam| beam.checked_mul(polarizations))
2098            .and_then(|beam| values.checked_add(beam))
2099        })
2100        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2101    let fold_accumulator_validity_values = specification
2102        .basis
2103        .validity_entries(specification.slab)
2104        .checked_mul(polarizations)
2105        .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(domain_count))
2106        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2107    let initial_phase_residency =
2108        project_initial_phase_residency(specification, pass, grid_complex_values)?;
2109    Ok(SpectralOperatorWorkload {
2110        pass,
2111        slab: specification.slab,
2112        grid_shape: specification.grid_shape,
2113        grid_complex_values,
2114        convolution_f64_values,
2115        fft_resident_complex_values,
2116        fft_planning_words,
2117        forward_complex_values,
2118        primitive_complex_values: image_cells
2119            .checked_mul(parent_complex_planes)
2120            .and_then(|values| {
2121                maximum_chart_cells
2122                    .checked_mul(local_complex_planes)
2123                    .and_then(|local| values.checked_add(local))
2124            })
2125            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2126        primitive_f64_values: image_cells
2127            .checked_mul(normal_moments)
2128            .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(polarizations))
2129            .and_then(|values| {
2130                usize::from(matches!(pass, SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor))
2131                    .checked_mul(maximum_chart_cells)
2132                    .and_then(|cells| cells.checked_mul(normal_moments))
2133                    .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(polarizations))
2134                    .and_then(|local| values.checked_add(local))
2135            })
2136            .and_then(|values| {
2137                normal_moments
2138                    .checked_mul(polarizations)
2139                    .and_then(|weights| weights.checked_mul(2))
2140                    .and_then(|values| {
2141                        joint_channels
2142                            .checked_mul(polarizations)
2143                            .and_then(|common| values.checked_add(common))
2144                    })
2145                    .and_then(|per_chart| per_chart.checked_mul(chart_count))
2146                    .and_then(|metadata| values.checked_add(metadata))
2147            })
2148            .and_then(|values| {
2149                specification
2150                    .basis
2151                    .channel_major_taylor()
2152                    .map_or(Some(0), |_| {
2153                        specification
2154                            .slab
2155                            .core_depth()
2156                            .checked_mul(polarizations)
2157                            .and_then(|channels| channels.checked_mul(4))
2158                            .and_then(|per_chart| per_chart.checked_mul(chart_count))
2159                    })
2160                    .and_then(|folding| values.checked_add(folding))
2161            })
2162            .and_then(|values| {
2163                specification.instrument_model.map_or(Some(values), |_| {
2164                    image_cells
2165                        .checked_mul(polarizations)
2166                        .and_then(|retained| {
2167                            maximum_chart_cells
2168                                .checked_mul(polarizations)
2169                                .and_then(|local| retained.checked_add(local))
2170                        })
2171                        .and_then(|response| values.checked_add(response))
2172                })
2173            })
2174            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2175        fold_accumulator_complex_values,
2176        fold_accumulator_f64_values,
2177        response_f32_values: usize::from(specification.instrument_model.is_some())
2178            .checked_mul(maximum_chart_cells)
2179            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2180        mosaic_state_bytes: mosaic_residency.retained_bytes,
2181        mosaic_workspace_bytes: mosaic_residency.workspace_bytes,
2182        primitive_validity_values: specification
2183            .basis
2184            .validity_entries(specification.slab)
2185            .checked_mul(polarizations)
2186            .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(chart_count))
2187            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2188        fold_accumulator_validity_values,
2189        coefficient_terms,
2190        normal_moments,
2191        resident_model_terms: specification
2192            .resident_model_terms()
2193            .checked_mul(polarizations)
2194            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2195        total_model_terms: specification
2196            .basis
2197            .total_model_terms(specification.slab)
2198            .checked_mul(polarizations)
2199            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
2200        max_replay_block_samples,
2201        initial_phase_residency,
2202    })
2203}
2204
2205fn project_initial_phase_residency(
2206    specification: &SpectralOperatorSpecification,
2207    pass: SpectralOperatorPass,
2208    grid_complex_values: usize,
2209) -> Result<Option<SpectralOperatorInitialPhaseResidency>, SpectralOperatorError> {
2210    let [chart] = specification.charts.as_ref() else {
2211        return Ok(None);
2212    };
2213    let [domain] = specification.domains.as_ref() else {
2214        return Ok(None);
2215    };
2216    if !specification.is_initial_certified_zero(pass)
2217        || specification.aw_projection.is_none()
2218        || specification.instrument_model != Some(InstrumentModel::CasaEvlaWidebandAwV1)
2219        || specification.mosaic
2220        || !matches!(specification.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_))
2221        || chart.geometry.image_shape != domain.image_shape
2222        || chart.window.origin() != [0, 0]
2223    {
2224        return Ok(None);
2225    }
2226    let overflow = || SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow;
2227    let cells = checked_cells(chart.geometry.image_shape)?;
2228    let polarizations = specification.polarization_count();
2229    let coefficients = specification
2230        .coefficient_terms()
2231        .checked_mul(polarizations)
2232        .ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2233    let moments = specification
2234        .normal_moments()
2235        .checked_mul(polarizations)
2236        .ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2237    let complex_plane = cells
2238        .checked_mul(size_of::<Complex64>())
2239        .ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2240    let real_plane = cells.checked_mul(size_of::<f64>()).ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2241    let metadata = moments
2242        .checked_mul(2 * size_of::<f64>())
2243        .and_then(|bytes| {
2244            specification
2245                .basis
2246                .validity_entries(specification.slab)
2247                .checked_mul(polarizations)
2248                .and_then(|values| values.checked_mul(size_of::<SpectralChannelValidity>()))
2249                .and_then(|validity| bytes.checked_add(validity))
2250        })
2251        .ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2252    let bytes = |complex_planes: usize, real_planes: usize| {
2253        complex_planes
2254            .checked_mul(complex_plane)
2255            .and_then(|complex| {
2256                real_planes
2257                    .checked_mul(real_plane)
2258                    .and_then(|real| complex.checked_add(real))
2259            })
2260            .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(metadata))
2261            .ok_or_else(overflow)
2262    };
2263    let doubled_coefficients = coefficients.checked_mul(2).ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2264    let doubled_moments = moments.checked_mul(2).ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2265    let retained_bytes = bytes(
2266        doubled_coefficients
2267            .checked_add(moments)
2268            .ok_or_else(overflow)?,
2269        moments,
2270    )?;
2271    // In-place Complex64 -> f64 collection may retain the larger allocation.
2272    // Boxing may overlap that entire allocation with the final real slice.
2273    let local_formation_bytes = bytes(
2274        doubled_coefficients
2275            .checked_add(doubled_moments)
2276            .ok_or_else(overflow)?,
2277        moments,
2278    )?;
2279    // Parent dirty is cloned only after local dirty/invariant/PSF arrays drop.
2280    let parent_copy_bytes = bytes(
2281        coefficients
2282            .checked_mul(3)
2283            .and_then(|planes| planes.checked_add(doubled_moments))
2284            .ok_or_else(overflow)?,
2285        doubled_moments,
2286    )?;
2287    let accumulation_bytes = grid_complex_values
2288        .checked_mul(size_of::<Complex64>())
2289        .ok_or_else(overflow)?;
2290    let completion_bytes = accumulation_bytes
2291        .checked_add(local_formation_bytes)
2292        .ok_or_else(overflow)?
2293        .max(parent_copy_bytes)
2294        .max(retained_bytes);
2295    Ok(Some(SpectralOperatorInitialPhaseResidency {
2296        accumulation_bytes,
2297        completion_bytes,
2298        retained_bytes,
2299    }))
2300}
2301
2302pub(crate) fn fft_planning_words_for_shape(
2303    shape: [usize; 2],
2304) -> Result<usize, SpectralOperatorError> {
2305    shape.into_iter().try_fold(0_usize, |total, length| {
2306        length
2307            .checked_mul(FFT_PLANNING_WORD_BOUND_PER_POINT)
2308            .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
2309            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
2310    })
2311}
2312
2313pub(crate) fn fft_resident_complex_values_for_shape(
2314    shape: [usize; 2],
2315) -> Result<usize, SpectralOperatorError> {
2316    let max_axis = shape.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
2317    let opaque_plans = shape
2318        .into_iter()
2319        .try_fold(0_usize, |total, length| {
2320            length
2321                .checked_mul(FFT_PLAN_COMPLEX_BOUND_PER_AXIS)
2322                .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
2323        })
2324        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
2325    max_axis
2326        .checked_mul(FFT_PLAN_COMPLEX_BOUND_PER_AXIS + 1)
2327        .and_then(|workspace| opaque_plans.checked_add(workspace))
2328        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
2329}

2331/// FFT preparation retained by runtime between its explicit planning and replay nodes.

2333pub struct PreparedSpectralOperator {

2340/// Opaque reusable FFT plans and workspaces returned between ordered slabs.

2342pub struct PreparedSpectralOperatorRecycle {

2345}

2347impl fmt::Debug for PreparedSpectralOperator {

2350            .debug_struct("PreparedSpectralOperator")

2357impl PreparedSpectralOperator {
2358    pub(crate) fn convolution_maximum_support(&self) -> usize {
2359        self.aw_projection.as_ref().map_or_else(
2360            || self.specification.maximum_convolution_support(),
2361            PreparedAwProjection::maximum_imaging_support,
2362        )
2363    }
2364
2365    /// Bind the application-validated paired AW cache to this exact prepared operator.
2366    pub fn with_aw_projection(
2367        mut self,
2368        aw_projection: PreparedAwProjection,
2369    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
2370        if self.specification.aw_projection.is_none() {
2371            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);

2373        self.aw_projection = Some(aw_projection);

2375    }

2383    }

2385    /// Begin before a fused weighting stream has minted its terminal generation.
2386    pub fn begin_streaming(
2387        self,
2388        problem: &CompiledProblem,
2389    ) -> Result<CompleteDataOwnerState, SpectralOperatorError> {
2390        CompleteDataOwnerState::new_streaming(problem, self)
2391    }
2392
2393    pub(crate) fn into_parts(
2394        self,
2395    ) -> (
2396        SpectralOperatorSpecification,
2397        SpectralOperatorWorkload,
2398        Vec<PreparedFft>,
2399        Option<PreparedAwProjection>,
2400    ) {
2401        (
2402            self.specification,
2403            self.workload,
2404            self.ffts,
2405            self.aw_projection,
2406        )
2407    }
