2409
2410/// Prepare the reusable FFT implementation under runtime planning authority.
2411#[doc(hidden)]
2412pub fn prepare_spectral_operator(
2413    specification: SpectralOperatorSpecification,
2414    workload: SpectralOperatorWorkload,
2415) -> Result<PreparedSpectralOperator, SpectralOperatorError> {
2416    if workload
2417        != spectral_operator_workload(
2418            &specification,
2419            workload.max_replay_block_samples,
2420            workload.pass,
2421        )?
2422    {
2423        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
2424    }
2425    let ffts = specification
2426        .charts
2427        .iter()
2428        .map(|chart| {
2429            PreparedFft::new(
2430                chart.geometry.grid_shape,
2431                fft_resident_complex_values_for_shape(chart.geometry.grid_shape)?,
2432            )
2433        })
2434        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, SpectralOperatorError>>()?;
2435    Ok(PreparedSpectralOperator {
2436        specification,
2437        workload,
2438        ffts,
2439        aw_projection: None,
2440    })
2441}
2442
2443/// Rebind already-planned FFT state to the next ordered slab specification.
2444#[doc(hidden)]
2445pub fn reprepare_spectral_operator(
2446    specification: SpectralOperatorSpecification,
2447    workload: SpectralOperatorWorkload,
2448    recycle: PreparedSpectralOperatorRecycle,
2449) -> Result<PreparedSpectralOperator, SpectralOperatorError> {
2450    if workload
2451        != spectral_operator_workload(
2452            &specification,
2453            workload.max_replay_block_samples,
2454            workload.pass,
2455        )?
2456        || recycle.ffts.len() != specification.chart_count()
2457    {
2458        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
2459    }
2460    Ok(PreparedSpectralOperator {
2461        specification,
2462        workload,
2463        ffts: recycle.ffts,
2464        aw_projection: recycle.aw_projection,
2465    })
2466}

2468/// Unnormalized spectral primitives; these are not Product Graph artifacts.
2469#[derive(Debug)]
2470pub struct SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
2471    shape: [usize; 2],
2472    slab: SpectralSlabPlan,
2473    basis: SpectralBasisPlan,
2474    polarizations: usize,
2475    joint_line_term_by_channel: Box<[Option<usize>]>,
2476    dirty: Box<[Complex64]>,
2477    invariant_dirty: Option<Box<[Complex64]>>,
2478    common_residual: Option<Box<[Complex64]>>,
2479    invariant_common_dirty: Option<Box<[Complex64]>>,
2480    psf: Box<[Complex64]>,
2481    sensitivity: Box<[f64]>,
2482    primary_beam_weighted_sum: Option<Box<[f64]>>,
2483    sum_weights: Box<[f64]>,
2484    published_sum_weights: Box<[f64]>,
2485    channel_sum_weights: Box<[f64]>,
2486    validity: Box<[SpectralChannelValidity]>,
2487    major_cycle_residual: Option<Box<[Complex64]>>,
2488    major_cycle_residual_promoted: bool,
2489    residual_model: Option<ModelGenerationId>,
2490    #[cfg(test)]
2491    measurements: SpectralOperatorMeasurements,
2492}
2493
2494impl SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
2495    #[cfg(test)]
2496    pub(crate) fn native_taylor_fixture(
2497        problem: &CompiledProblem,
2498        residual_model: ModelGenerationId,
2499        dirty: Box<[Complex64]>,
2500        psf: Box<[Complex64]>,
2501        response: Option<(Vec<f64>, f64, f64)>,
2502    ) -> Self {
2503        let specification = SpectralOperatorSpecification::new(problem).expect("fixture operator");
2504        let shape = specification.domains()[0].image_shape();
2505        let cells = shape[0] * shape[1];
2506        assert_eq!(dirty.len(), specification.coefficient_terms() * cells);
2507        assert_eq!(psf.len(), specification.normal_moments() * cells);
2508        let (sensitivity, normal_weight, published_weight) =
2509            response.unwrap_or_else(|| (vec![1.0; cells], 1.0, 1.0));
2510        assert_eq!(sensitivity.len(), cells);
2511        Self {
2512            shape,
2513            slab: specification.slab,
2514            basis: specification.basis,
2515            polarizations: 1,
2516            joint_line_term_by_channel: Box::new([]),
2517            dirty,
2518            invariant_dirty: None,
2519            common_residual: None,
2520            invariant_common_dirty: None,
2521            psf,
2522            sensitivity: sensitivity
2523                .repeat(specification.normal_moments())
2524                .into_boxed_slice(),
2525            primary_beam_weighted_sum: None,
2526            sum_weights: vec![normal_weight; specification.normal_moments()].into_boxed_slice(),
2527            published_sum_weights: vec![published_weight; specification.normal_moments()]
2528                .into_boxed_slice(),
2529            channel_sum_weights: vec![1.0].into_boxed_slice(),
2530            validity: vec![SpectralChannelValidity::Valid].into_boxed_slice(),
2531            major_cycle_residual: None,
2532            major_cycle_residual_promoted: true,
2533            residual_model: Some(residual_model),
2534            measurements: SpectralOperatorMeasurements::default(),
2535        }
2536    }
2537
2538    /// Return `[width, height]` shared by every plane.
2539    #[must_use]
2540    pub const fn shape(&self) -> [usize; 2] {
2541        self.shape
2542    }

2544    /// Return the exact output-channel core represented by the flattened planes.
2545    #[must_use]
2546    pub const fn slab(&self) -> SpectralSlabPlan {

2550    /// Return the number of model-coefficient residual terms.
2551    #[must_use]
2552    pub const fn coefficient_term_count(&self) -> usize {
2553        self.basis.coefficient_terms(self.slab)
2554    }
2555
2556    /// Return the number of reconstruction polarization planes.
2557    #[must_use]
2558    pub const fn polarization_count(&self) -> usize {
2559        self.polarizations

2562    /// Return the number of retained normal moments.

2568    /// Return the Taylor reference frequency, or `None` for channel-local state.
2569    #[must_use]
2570    pub const fn reference_frequency_hz(&self) -> Option<f64> {
2571        match self.basis {
2572            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan)
2573            | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => Some(plan.reference_frequency_hz()),
2574            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { continuum, .. } => Some(continuum.reference_frequency_hz()),
2575            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => None,
2576        }
2577    }
2578
2579    /// Return the smooth-coefficient prefix length for a joint block.
2580    #[must_use]
2581    pub const fn joint_continuum_term_count(&self) -> Option<usize> {
2582        match self.basis {
2583            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { continuum, .. } => Some(continuum.coefficient_term_count()),
2584            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal
2585            | SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_)
2586            | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => None,
2587        }
2588    }
2589
2590    /// Map one coefficient-block pair to its retained normal moment.
2591    #[must_use]
2592    pub fn normal_moment_index(&self, row: usize, column: usize) -> Option<usize> {
2593        self.basis.normal_moment_index(row, column)
2594    }

2596    /// Return the unnormalized dirty normal-state plane.
2597    #[must_use]

2600    }
2601
2602    /// Return the channel-local common residual of a joint model.
2603    #[must_use]
2604    pub fn common_residual(&self) -> Option<&[Complex64]> {
2605        self.common_residual.as_deref()
2606    }
2607
2608    /// Return the unnormalized point-spread-function plane.
2609    #[must_use]

2612    }
2613
2614    /// Return scalar-response sensitivity in normal-state units.

2616    pub const fn sensitivity(&self) -> &[f64] {
2617        &self.sensitivity
2618    }
2619
2620    /// Return `sum(W B)` in polarization-major image-plane order when a
2621    /// compiled scalar primary-beam response participated in the operator.
2622    #[must_use]
2623    pub fn primary_beam_weighted_sum(&self) -> Option<&[f64]> {
2624        self.primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_deref()
2625    }
2626
2627    /// Return normal-moment-major, polarization-minor exact sum weights.
2628    ///
2629    /// The length is `normal_moment_count() * polarization_count()`.
2630    #[must_use]
2631    pub const fn sum_weights(&self) -> &[f64] {
2632        &self.sum_weights
2633    }
2634
2635    /// Return CASA publication-statistic numerators in normal-moment-major,
2636    /// polarization-minor order.
2637    ///
2638    /// The length is `normal_moment_count() * polarization_count()`. Channel-
2639    /// major Taylor state retains `sum(W² x^t)` here so products can apply the
2640    /// single complete-family `sum(W)` denominator. Publication does not change
2641    /// scientific normalization.
2642    #[must_use]
2643    pub const fn published_sum_weights(&self) -> &[f64] {
2644        &self.published_sum_weights
2645    }
2646
2647    /// Return exact channel-local response weights for joint common-residual normalization.
2648    #[must_use]
2649    pub const fn channel_sum_weights(&self) -> &[f64] {
2650        &self.channel_sum_weights
2651    }
2652
2653    /// Return support-entry-major, polarization-minor validity.
2654    ///
2655    /// The support-entry count is core-channel depth for channel-local state,
2656    /// one for Taylor state, or total channel count for joint state.
2657    #[must_use]
2658    pub const fn channel_validity(&self) -> &[SpectralChannelValidity] {
2659        &self.validity
2660    }
2661
2662    /// Return the exact scalar sum weight for the one-plane continuum case.
2663    ///
2664    /// Cube consumers use [`Self::sum_weights`] instead.
2665    #[must_use]
2666    pub fn sum_weight(&self) -> f64 {
2667        assert_eq!(
2668            self.sum_weights.len(),
2669            1,
2670            "cube normal state has per-channel weights"
2671        );
2672        self.sum_weights[0]
2673    }
2674
2675    pub(crate) fn promote_major_cycle_residual(
2676        mut self,
2677        expected_model: ModelGenerationId,
2678    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
2679        if self.residual_model != Some(expected_model) {
2680            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ModelMismatch);
2681        }
2682        if !self.major_cycle_residual_promoted {
2683            self.dirty = self
2684                .major_cycle_residual
2685                .take()
2686                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?;
2687            self.major_cycle_residual_promoted = true;
2688        }
2689        Ok(self)
2690    }
2691
2692    /// Derive the owner content identity of the exact unnormalized evidence.
2693    ///
2694    /// The identity binds every primitive value bit, so a Major Cycle names
2695    /// exact normal-state content without promising residency or density.
2696    #[must_use]
2697    pub fn normal_state_content_identity(&self) -> LogicalIdentity {
2698        let taylor = self
2699            .basis
2700            .polynomial()
2701            .filter(|plan| plan.coefficient_term_count() > 1);
2702        let published_sum_weights_differ = self.published_sum_weights != self.sum_weights;
2703        let primary_beam = self.primary_beam_weighted_sum.is_some();
2704        let mut encoder = crate::Encoder::new(
2705            NORMAL_STATE_CONTENT_DOMAIN,
2706            if primary_beam {
2707                5
2708            } else if published_sum_weights_differ {
2709                4
2710            } else if matches!(self.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
2711                3
2712            } else if taylor.is_some() {
2713                2
2714            } else {
2715                1
2716            },
2717        );
2718        encoder.usize(self.shape[0]);
2719        encoder.usize(self.shape[1]);
2720        encoder.usize(self.slab.total_channels);
2721        encoder.usize(self.slab.core_start);
2722        encoder.usize(self.slab.core_end);
2723        if let Some(plan) = taylor {
2724            encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(plan.reference_frequency_hz()));
2725            encoder.usize(plan.coefficient_term_count());
2726            encoder.usize(plan.normal_moment_count());
2727        } else if let SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
2728            continuum,
2729            line_terms,
2730        } = self.basis
2731        {
2732            encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(continuum.reference_frequency_hz()));
2733            encoder.usize(continuum.coefficient_term_count());
2734            encoder.usize(line_terms);
2735            for line in &self.joint_line_term_by_channel {
2736                encoder.usize(line.unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
2737            }
2738        }
2739        for value in &self.dirty {
2740            encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
2741            encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
2742        }
2743        if let Some(residual) = &self.common_residual {
2744            for value in residual {
2745                encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
2746                encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
2747            }
2748        }
2749        for value in &self.psf {
2750            encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
2751            encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
2752        }
2753        for value in &self.sensitivity {
2754            encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(*value));
2755        }
2756        if let Some(values) = &self.primary_beam_weighted_sum {
2757            for value in values {
2758                encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(*value));
2759            }
2760        }
2761        for value in &self.sum_weights {
2762            encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(*value));
2763        }
2764        if published_sum_weights_differ {
2765            for value in &self.published_sum_weights {
2766                encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(*value));
2767            }
2768        }
2769        for value in &self.channel_sum_weights {
2770            encoder.u64(canonical_f64_bits(*value));
2771        }
2772        for validity in &self.validity {
2773            encoder.u8(match validity {
2774                SpectralChannelValidity::Valid => 0,
2775                SpectralChannelValidity::Blank => 1,
2776                SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped => 2,
2777            });
2778        }
2779        LogicalIdentity::from_sha256(encoder.finish())
2780    }
2781}

2900/// Normal-state validity for one output channel.
2901#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
2902pub enum SpectralChannelValidity {
2903    /// At least one mapped sample contributed positive finite weight.
2904    Valid,
2905    /// Samples mapped to the channel but all carried zero effective weight.
2906    Blank,
2907    /// No selected sample mapped to the output channel.
2908    Unmapped,
2909}
2910
2911const fn validity_from_support(
2912    mapped_samples: u64,
2913    order_zero_weight: f64,
2914) -> SpectralChannelValidity {
2915    if order_zero_weight > 0.0 {
2916        SpectralChannelValidity::Valid
2917    } else if mapped_samples > 0 {
2918        SpectralChannelValidity::Blank
2919    } else {
2920        SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped
2921    }
2922}

3094fn scatter_chart_planes<T: Copy>(
3095    destination: &mut [T],
3096    parent_shape: [usize; 2],
3097    source: &[T],
3098    chart_shape: [usize; 2],
3099    origin: [usize; 2],
3100) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
3101    let parent_cells = checked_cells(parent_shape)?;
3102    let chart_cells = checked_cells(chart_shape)?;
3103    if source.len() % chart_cells != 0
3104        || destination.len() != parent_cells * (source.len() / chart_cells)
3105    {
3106        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch);
3107    }
3108    for plane in 0..source.len() / chart_cells {
3109        for x in 0..chart_shape[0] {
3110            for y in 0..chart_shape[1] {
3111                destination
3112                    [plane * parent_cells + (origin[0] + x) * parent_shape[1] + origin[1] + y] =
3113                    source[plane * chart_cells + x * chart_shape[1] + y];
3114            }
3115        }
3116    }
3117    Ok(())
3118}
3119
3120fn combine_initial_chart_primitives(
3121    specification: &SpectralOperatorSpecification,
3122    mut chart_primitives: impl Iterator<
3123        Item = Result<SpectralOperatorPrimitives, SpectralOperatorError>,
3124    >,
3125) -> Result<SpectralPrimitiveDomains, SpectralOperatorError> {
3126    let mut domains = Vec::with_capacity(specification.domain_count());
3127    for domain in specification.domains() {
3128        let parent_shape = domain.image_shape();
3129        let parent_cells = checked_cells(parent_shape)?;
3130        let mut first = Some(
3131            chart_primitives
3132                .next()
3133                .transpose()?
3134                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch)?,
3135        );
3136        let first_ref = first
3137            .as_ref()
3138            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch)?;
3139        let coefficient_terms = first_ref
3140            .basis
3141            .coefficient_terms(first_ref.slab)
3142            .checked_mul(first_ref.polarizations)
3143            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3144        let normal_moments = first_ref
3145            .basis
3146            .normal_moments(first_ref.slab)
3147            .checked_mul(first_ref.polarizations)
3148            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3149        let common_planes = first_ref.common_residual.as_ref().map_or(0, |values| {
3150            values.len() / checked_cells(first_ref.shape).expect("validated chart shape")
3151        });
3152        let mut dirty = vec![Complex64::default(); parent_cells * coefficient_terms];
3153        let mut residual = first_ref
3154            .major_cycle_residual
3155            .as_ref()
3156            .map(|_| vec![Complex64::default(); parent_cells * coefficient_terms]);
3157        let mut common =
3158            (common_planes != 0).then(|| vec![Complex64::default(); parent_cells * common_planes]);
3159        let mut sensitivity = vec![0.0; parent_cells * normal_moments];
3160        let mut primary_beam_weighted_sum =
3161            first_ref.primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_ref().map(|values| {
3162                vec![
3163                    0.0;
3164                    parent_cells
3165                        * (values.len()
3166                            / checked_cells(first_ref.shape).expect("validated chart shape"))
3167                ]
3168            });
3169        let mut psf = vec![Complex64::default(); parent_cells * normal_moments];
3170        let mut retained = None;
3171        for chart_ordinal in domain.chart_range() {
3172            let chart = &specification.charts[chart_ordinal];
3173            let local = if chart_ordinal == domain.chart_start {
3174                first
3175                    .take()
3176                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch)?
3177            } else {
3178                chart_primitives
3179                    .next()
3180                    .transpose()?
3181                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch)?
3182            };
3183            scatter_chart_planes(
3184                &mut dirty,
3185                parent_shape,
3186                &local.dirty,
3187                local.shape,
3188                chart.window.origin(),
3189            )?;
3190            if let (Some(destination), Some(source)) =
3191                (residual.as_mut(), local.major_cycle_residual.as_deref())
3192            {
3193                scatter_chart_planes(
3194                    destination,
3195                    parent_shape,
3196                    source,
3197                    local.shape,
3198                    chart.window.origin(),
3199                )?;
3200            }
3201            if let (Some(destination), Some(source)) =
3202                (common.as_mut(), local.common_residual.as_deref())
3203            {
3204                scatter_chart_planes(
3205                    destination,
3206                    parent_shape,
3207                    source,
3208                    local.shape,
3209                    chart.window.origin(),
3210                )?;
3211            }
3212            scatter_chart_planes(
3213                &mut sensitivity,
3214                parent_shape,
3215                &local.sensitivity,
3216                local.shape,
3217                chart.window.origin(),
3218            )?;
3219            match (
3220                primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_mut(),
3221                local.primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_deref(),
3222            ) {
3223                (Some(destination), Some(source)) => scatter_chart_planes(
3224                    destination,
3225                    parent_shape,
3226                    source,
3227                    local.shape,
3228                    chart.window.origin(),
3229                )?,
3230                (None, None) => {}
3231                _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch),
3232            }
3233            if chart.facet_ordinal == 0 {
3234                let psf_origin = [
3235                    (parent_shape[0] - local.shape[0]) / 2,
3236                    (parent_shape[1] - local.shape[1]) / 2,
3237                ];
3238                scatter_chart_planes(&mut psf, parent_shape, &local.psf, local.shape, psf_origin)?;
3239                retained = Some((
3240                    local.slab,
3241                    local.basis,
3242                    local.polarizations,
3243                    local.joint_line_term_by_channel,
3244                    local.sum_weights,
3245                    local.published_sum_weights,
3246                    local.channel_sum_weights,
3247                    local.validity,
3248                    local.residual_model,
3249                    local.major_cycle_residual_promoted,
3250                ));
3251            }
3252        }
3253        let (
3254            slab,
3255            basis,
3256            polarizations,
3257            joint_line_term_by_channel,
3258            sum_weights,
3259            published_sum_weights,
3260            channel_sum_weights,
3261            validity,
3262            residual_model,
3263            promoted,
3264        ) = retained.ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch)?;
3265        let dirty = dirty.into_boxed_slice();
3266        let common = common.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice);
3267        domains.push(SpectralDomainPrimitives::new(
3268            domain.ordinal,
3269            domain.role.clone(),
3270            SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
3271                shape: parent_shape,
3272                slab,
3273                basis,
3274                polarizations,
3275                joint_line_term_by_channel,
3276                invariant_dirty: Some(dirty.clone()),
3277                dirty,
3278                common_residual: common.clone(),
3279                invariant_common_dirty: common,
3280                psf: psf.into_boxed_slice(),
3281                sensitivity: sensitivity.into_boxed_slice(),
3282                primary_beam_weighted_sum: primary_beam_weighted_sum.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice),
3283                sum_weights,
3284                published_sum_weights,
3285                channel_sum_weights,
3286                validity,
3287                major_cycle_residual: residual.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice),
3288                major_cycle_residual_promoted: promoted,
3289                residual_model,
3290                #[cfg(test)]
3291                measurements: SpectralOperatorMeasurements::default(),
3292            },
3293        ));
3294    }
3295    if chart_primitives.next().is_some() {
3296        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch);
3297    }
3298    SpectralPrimitiveDomains::new(domains.into_boxed_slice())
3299}
3300
3301pub(crate) fn combine_chart_updates(
3302    specification: &SpectralOperatorSpecification,
3303    reusable: Vec<ReusableNormalState>,
3304    mut updates: impl Iterator<Item = Result<SpectralChartUpdate, SpectralOperatorError>>,
3305) -> Result<SpectralPrimitiveDomains, SpectralOperatorError> {
3306    if reusable.len() != specification.domain_count() {
3307        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
3308    }
3309    let mut domains = Vec::with_capacity(reusable.len());
3310    for (domain, prior) in specification.domains().iter().zip(reusable) {
3311        if !prior.matches(specification, domain.ordinal, domain.image_shape) {
3312            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
3313        }
3314        let ReusableNormalState {
3315            shape,
3316            slab,
3317            basis,
3318            polarization_count,
3319            joint_line_term_by_channel,
3320            invariant_dirty,
3321            invariant_common_dirty,
3322            psf,
3323            sensitivity,
3324            primary_beam_weighted_sum,
3325            sum_weights,
3326            published_sum_weights,
3327            channel_sum_weights,
3328            validity,
3329            ..
3330        } = prior;
3331        let invariant_dirty =
3332            invariant_dirty.ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
3333        let mut residual = vec![Complex64::default(); invariant_dirty.len()];
3334        let mut common = invariant_common_dirty
3335            .as_ref()
3336            .map(|values| vec![Complex64::default(); values.len()]);
3337        let mut residual_model = None;
3338        for chart_ordinal in domain.chart_range() {
3339            let chart = &specification.charts[chart_ordinal];
3340            let update = updates
3341                .next()
3342                .transpose()?
3343                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch)?;
3344            let chart_cells = checked_cells(chart.geometry.image_shape)?;
3345            let parent_cells = checked_cells(shape)?;
3346            if update.values.len() % chart_cells != 0 {
3347                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch);
3348            }
3349            let mut values = update.values.into_vec();
3350            if update.normal {
3351                for plane in 0..values.len() / chart_cells {
3352                    for x in 0..chart.geometry.image_shape[0] {
3353                        for y in 0..chart.geometry.image_shape[1] {
3354                            let parent = plane * parent_cells
3355                                + (chart.window.origin()[0] + x) * shape[1]
3356                                + chart.window.origin()[1]
3357                                + y;
3358                            let local = plane * chart_cells + x * chart.geometry.image_shape[1] + y;
3359                            values[local] = invariant_dirty[parent] - values[local];
3360                        }
3361                    }
3362                }
3363            }
3364            scatter_chart_planes(
3365                &mut residual,
3366                shape,
3367                &values,
3368                chart.geometry.image_shape,
3369                chart.window.origin(),
3370            )?;
3371            if let (Some(destination), Some(mut values), Some(invariant)) = (
3372                common.as_mut(),
3373                update.common_values.map(|values| values.into_vec()),
3374                invariant_common_dirty.as_deref(),
3375            ) {
3376                if update.normal {
3377                    for plane in 0..values.len() / chart_cells {
3378                        for x in 0..chart.geometry.image_shape[0] {
3379                            for y in 0..chart.geometry.image_shape[1] {
3380                                let parent = plane * parent_cells
3381                                    + (chart.window.origin()[0] + x) * shape[1]
3382                                    + chart.window.origin()[1]
3383                                    + y;
3384                                let local =
3385                                    plane * chart_cells + x * chart.geometry.image_shape[1] + y;
3386                                values[local] = invariant[parent] - values[local];
3387                            }
3388                        }
3389                    }
3390                }
3391                scatter_chart_planes(
3392                    destination,
3393                    shape,
3394                    &values,
3395                    chart.geometry.image_shape,
3396                    chart.window.origin(),
3397                )?;
3398            }
3399            if residual_model
3400                .replace(update.residual_model)
3401                .is_some_and(|model| model != update.residual_model)
3402            {
3403                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ModelMismatch);
3404            }
3405        }
3406        domains.push(SpectralDomainPrimitives::new(
3407            domain.ordinal,
3408            domain.role.clone(),
3409            SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
3410                shape,
3411                slab,
3412                basis,
3413                polarizations: polarization_count,
3414                joint_line_term_by_channel,
3415                dirty: residual.into_boxed_slice(),
3416                invariant_dirty: Some(invariant_dirty),
3417                common_residual: common.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice),
3418                invariant_common_dirty,
3419                psf,
3420                sensitivity,
3421                primary_beam_weighted_sum,
3422                sum_weights,
3423                published_sum_weights,
3424                channel_sum_weights,
3425                validity,
3426                major_cycle_residual: None,
3427                major_cycle_residual_promoted: true,
3428                residual_model,
3429                #[cfg(test)]
3430                measurements: SpectralOperatorMeasurements::default(),
3431            },
3432        ));
3433    }
3434    if updates.next().is_some() {
3435        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch);
3436    }
3437    SpectralPrimitiveDomains::new(domains.into_boxed_slice())
3438}

3440impl SpectralPrimitiveDomains {
3441    pub(crate) fn new(
3442        domains: Box<[SpectralDomainPrimitives]>,
3443    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3444        if domains.is_empty()
3445            || domains
3446                .iter()
3447                .enumerate()
3448                .any(|(ordinal, domain)| domain.domain_ordinal != ordinal)
3449        {
3450            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch);
3451        }
3452        Ok(Self { domains })
3453    }
3454
3455    pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
3456        self.domains.len()
3457    }
3458
3459    pub(crate) fn iter(&self) -> std::slice::Iter<'_, SpectralDomainPrimitives> {
3460        self.domains.iter()
3461    }
3462
3463    pub(crate) fn primary(&self) -> &SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
3464        &self.domains[0].primitives
3465    }
3466
3467    pub(crate) fn get(&self, ordinal: usize) -> Option<&SpectralDomainPrimitives> {
3468        self.domains.get(ordinal)
3469    }
3470
3471    pub(crate) fn into_iter(self) -> impl Iterator<Item = SpectralDomainPrimitives> {
3472        self.domains.into_vec().into_iter()
3473    }
3474
3475    pub(crate) fn promote_major_cycle_residual(
3476        self,
3477        expected_model: ModelGenerationId,
3478    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3479        let domains = self
3480            .into_iter()
3481            .map(|domain| {
3482                domain
3483                    .primitives
3484                    .promote_major_cycle_residual(expected_model)
3485                    .map(|primitives| SpectralDomainPrimitives {
3486                        primitives,
3487                        ..domain
3488                    })
3489            })
3490            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?
3491            .into_boxed_slice();
3492        Self::new(domains)
3493    }
3494
3495    pub(crate) fn normal_state_content_identity(&self) -> LogicalIdentity {
3496        let mut encoder = crate::Encoder::new(NORMAL_STATE_CONTENT_DOMAIN, 4);
3497        encoder.usize(self.domains.len());
3498        for domain in &self.domains {
3499            encoder.usize(domain.domain_ordinal);
3500            match &domain.domain_role {
3501                ImageDomainRole::Main => encoder.u8(0),
3502                ImageDomainRole::Outlier(name) => {
3503                    encoder.u8(1);
3504                    encoder.bytes(name.as_bytes());
3505                }
3506            }
3507            encoder.identity(domain.primitives.normal_state_content_identity().as_bytes());
3508        }
3509        LogicalIdentity::from_sha256(encoder.finish())
3510    }
3511}

3516    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
3517        &self.domains[0].primitives
3518    }

3521#[doc(hidden)]
3522#[derive(Debug)]
3523pub struct CompleteDataOwnerResult {
3524    pub(crate) domains: SpectralPrimitiveDomains,
3525    pub(crate) completion: CompleteDataOwnerCompletion,
3526}
3527
3528impl CompleteDataOwnerResult {
3529    /// Return dirty, PSF, sensitivity, and sum-weight normal-state primitives.
3530    #[must_use]
3531    pub fn primitives(&self) -> &SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
3532        self.domains.primary()
3533    }
3534
3535    /// Return the canonical image-domain cardinality of this one completion.
3536    #[must_use]
3537    pub fn domain_count(&self) -> usize {
3538        self.domains.len()
3539    }
3540
3541    /// Return the owner-minted complete-data proof for these exact primitives.
3542    #[must_use]
3543    pub const fn completion(&self) -> &CompleteDataOwnerCompletion {
3544        &self.completion
3545    }
3546
3547    /// Deterministically combine adjacent channel-major MVC slab results.
3548    ///
3549    /// Every slab must describe the same exhaustive weighted replay and the
3550    /// ordered core ranges must cover the complete channel axis exactly once.
3551    /// The fold remains reconstruction-owned because it combines scientific
3552    /// normal-state primitives, not runtime buffers or application products.
3553    pub fn fold_channel_major_slabs(
3554        slabs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Self>,
3555    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3556        Self::fold_channel_major_slabs_inner(slabs, true)
3557    }
3558
3559    /// Extend one deterministic ordered MVC prefix by its adjacent slab.
3560    #[doc(hidden)]
3561    pub fn fold_channel_major_slab_prefix(
3562        prefix: Self,
3563        next: Self,
3564    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3565        Self::fold_channel_major_slabs_inner([prefix, next], false)
3566    }
3567
3568    fn fold_channel_major_slabs_inner(
3569        slabs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Self>,
3570        require_complete_coverage: bool,
3571    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3572        let mut slabs = slabs.into_iter();
3573        let first = slabs
3574            .next()
3575            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage)?;
3576        let total_channels = first.primitives().slab().total_channels();
3577        let mut next_channel = first.primitives().slab().core_range().end;
3578        if first.primitives().slab().core_range().start != 0
3579            || !matches!(
3580                first.primitives().basis,
3581                SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_)
3582            )
3583        {
3584            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab);
3585        }
3586        let mut completion = Some(first.completion);
3587        let mut domains = first.domains;
3588        for next in slabs {
3589            let range = next.primitives().slab().core_range();
3590            if range.start != next_channel
3591                || next.primitives().slab().total_channels() != total_channels
3592                || !same_complete_data_authority(
3593                    completion
3594                        .as_ref()
3595                        .expect("fold retains one canonical completion"),
3596                    &next.completion,
3597                )
3598                || next.domains.len() != domains.len()
3599            {
3600                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage);
3601            }
3602            next_channel = range.end;
3603            for (destination, source) in domains.domains.iter_mut().zip(next.domains.domains) {
3604                let source = source.primitives;
3605                let destination = &mut destination.primitives;
3606                if destination.shape != source.shape
3607                    || destination.basis != source.basis
3608                    || destination.polarizations != source.polarizations
3609                    || destination.joint_line_term_by_channel != source.joint_line_term_by_channel
3610                    || destination.channel_sum_weights != source.channel_sum_weights
3611                    || destination.residual_model != source.residual_model
3612                    || destination.major_cycle_residual_promoted
3613                        != source.major_cycle_residual_promoted
3614                {
3615                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
3616                }
3617                accumulate_complex_slice(&mut destination.dirty, &source.dirty)?;
3618                accumulate_optional_complex_slice(
3619                    destination.invariant_dirty.as_deref_mut(),
3620                    source.invariant_dirty.as_deref(),
3621                )?;
3622                accumulate_complex_slice(&mut destination.psf, &source.psf)?;
3623                accumulate_f64_slice(&mut destination.sensitivity, &source.sensitivity)?;
3624                match (
3625                    destination.primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_deref_mut(),
3626                    source.primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_deref(),
3627                ) {
3628                    (Some(destination), Some(source)) => {
3629                        accumulate_f64_slice(destination, source)?;
3630                    }
3631                    (None, None) => {}
3632                    _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch),
3633                }
3634                accumulate_f64_slice(&mut destination.sum_weights, &source.sum_weights)?;
3635                accumulate_f64_slice(
3636                    &mut destination.published_sum_weights,
3637                    &source.published_sum_weights,
3638                )?;
3639                accumulate_optional_complex_slice(
3640                    destination.major_cycle_residual.as_deref_mut(),
3641                    source.major_cycle_residual.as_deref(),
3642                )?;
3643                if destination.validity.len() != source.validity.len() {
3644                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
3645                }
3646                for (destination, source) in destination.validity.iter_mut().zip(source.validity) {
3647                    *destination = combine_validity(*destination, source);
3648                }
3649            }
3650        }
3651        if require_complete_coverage && next_channel != total_channels {
3652            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage);
3653        }
3654        let folded_slab = SpectralSlabPlan {
3655            total_channels,
3656            core_start: 0,
3657            core_end: next_channel,
3658            resident_start: 0,
3659            resident_end: next_channel,
3660        };
3661        for domain in &mut domains.domains {
3662            domain.primitives.slab = folded_slab;
3663            if next_channel == total_channels {
3664                normalize_completed_primary_beam_psf_fold(&mut domain.primitives)?;
3665            }
3666        }
3667        Ok(Self {
3668            domains,
3669            completion: completion
3670                .take()
3671                .expect("fold retains one canonical completion"),
3672        })
3673    }
3674
3675    /// Consume the pairing without exposing either member separately outside
3676    /// this crate; the Major-Cycle owner is the only split consumer.
3677    #[must_use]
3678    pub(crate) fn into_parts(self) -> (SpectralPrimitiveDomains, CompleteDataOwnerCompletion) {
3679        (self.domains, self.completion)
3680    }
3681}
3682
3683/// Reconstruction-owned accumulator for an ordered channel-major slab schedule.
3684///
3685/// Taylor slabs contribute to the same coefficient planes and are summed.
3686/// Channel-local slabs own disjoint output planes and are copied into one
3687/// complete-axis allocation. Keeping both operations behind this opaque owner
3688/// prevents the runtime from interpreting normal-state layouts.
3689#[doc(hidden)]
3690#[derive(Debug)]
3691pub struct CompleteDataOwnerSlabFold {
3692    state: CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState,
3693}
3694
3695#[derive(Debug)]
3696enum CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState {
3697    Taylor(CompleteDataOwnerResult),
3698    ChannelLocal(ChannelLocalSlabFold),
3699}
3700
3701#[derive(Debug)]
3702struct ChannelLocalSlabFold {
3703    domains: SpectralPrimitiveDomains,
3704    completion: CompleteDataOwnerCompletion,
3705    next_channel: usize,
3706}
3707
3708impl CompleteDataOwnerSlabFold {
3709    /// Start an ordered fold and allocate any complete-axis channel-local state.
3710    pub fn begin(first: CompleteDataOwnerResult) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3711        let range = first.primitives().slab().core_range();
3712        if range.start != 0 {
3713            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab);
3714        }
3715        let state = match first.primitives().basis {
3716            SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => {
3717                CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::Taylor(first)
3718            }
3719            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
3720                CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::ChannelLocal(ChannelLocalSlabFold::new(first)?)
3721            }
3722            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_) | SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
3723                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSlab);
3724            }
3725        };
3726        Ok(Self { state })
3727    }
3728
3729    /// Extend the prefix with the next adjacent slab.
3730    pub fn extend(self, next: CompleteDataOwnerResult) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3731        let state = match self.state {
3732            CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::Taylor(prefix) => {
3733                CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::Taylor(
3734                    CompleteDataOwnerResult::fold_channel_major_slab_prefix(prefix, next)?,
3735                )
3736            }
3737            CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::ChannelLocal(prefix) => {
3738                CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::ChannelLocal(prefix.extend(next)?)
3739            }
3740        };
3741        Ok(Self { state })
3742    }
3743
3744    /// Seal a fold only after its ordered prefix covers the complete axis.
3745    pub fn finish(self) -> Result<CompleteDataOwnerResult, SpectralOperatorError> {
3746        match self.state {
3747            CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::Taylor(result) => {
3748                let slab = result.primitives().slab();
3749                if slab.core_range() != (0..slab.total_channels()) {
3750                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage);
3751                }
3752                Ok(result)
3753            }
3754            CompleteDataOwnerSlabFoldState::ChannelLocal(fold) => fold.finish(),
3755        }
3756    }
3757}
3758
3759impl ChannelLocalSlabFold {
3760    fn new(first: CompleteDataOwnerResult) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3761        if first.completion.primitives != SpectralPrimitiveCatalog::UnnormalizedChannelSlabV1 {
3762            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
3763        }
3764        let next_channel = first.primitives().slab().core_range().end;
3765        let mut domains = first.domains;
3766        for domain in &mut domains.domains {
3767            expand_channel_local_prefix(&mut domain.primitives)?;
3768        }
3769        Ok(Self {
3770            domains,
3771            completion: first.completion,
3772            next_channel,
3773        })
3774    }
3775
3776    fn extend(mut self, next: CompleteDataOwnerResult) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
3777        let range = next.primitives().slab().core_range();
3778        let total_channels = self.domains.primary().slab().total_channels();
3779        if range.start != self.next_channel
3780            || next.primitives().slab().total_channels() != total_channels
3781            || !matches!(next.primitives().basis, SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal)
3782            || !same_complete_data_authority(&self.completion, &next.completion)
3783            || next.domains.len() != self.domains.len()
3784        {
3785            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage);
3786        }
3787        for (destination, source) in self.domains.domains.iter_mut().zip(next.domains.domains) {
3788            append_channel_local_domain(destination, source)?;
3789        }
3790        self.next_channel = range.end;
3791        Ok(self)
3792    }
3793
3794    fn finish(mut self) -> Result<CompleteDataOwnerResult, SpectralOperatorError> {
3795        let total_channels = self.domains.primary().slab().total_channels();
3796        if self.next_channel != total_channels {
3797            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage);
3798        }
3799        for domain in &mut self.domains.domains {
3800            normalize_completed_primary_beam_psf_fold(&mut domain.primitives)?;
3801        }
3802        Ok(CompleteDataOwnerResult {
3803            domains: self.domains,
3804            completion: self.completion,
3805        })
3806    }
3807}
3808
3809fn expand_channel_local_prefix(
3810    primitives: &mut SpectralOperatorPrimitives,
3811) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
3812    let slab = primitives.slab;
3813    let range = slab.core_range();
3814    if !matches!(primitives.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal)
3815        || range.start != 0
3816        || primitives.joint_line_term_by_channel.len() != slab.total_channels()
3817        || primitives.common_residual.is_some()
3818        || primitives.invariant_common_dirty.is_some()
3819        || primitives.primary_beam_weighted_sum.is_some()
3820        || !primitives.channel_sum_weights.is_empty()
3821    {
3822        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
3823    }
3824    let cells = checked_cells(primitives.shape)?;
3825    let prefix_planes = range
3826        .len()
3827        .checked_mul(primitives.polarizations)
3828        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3829    let total_planes = slab
3830        .total_channels()
3831        .checked_mul(primitives.polarizations)
3832        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3833    let prefix_values = prefix_planes
3834        .checked_mul(cells)
3835        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3836    let total_values = total_planes
3837        .checked_mul(cells)
3838        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3839
3840    primitives.dirty = expand_prefix(
3841        std::mem::take(&mut primitives.dirty),
3842        prefix_values,
3843        total_values,
3844    )?;
3845    primitives.invariant_dirty = expand_optional_prefix(
3846        primitives.invariant_dirty.take(),
3847        prefix_values,
3848        total_values,
3849        Complex64::default(),
3850    )?;
3851    primitives.psf = expand_prefix(
3852        std::mem::take(&mut primitives.psf),
3853        prefix_values,
3854        total_values,
3855    )?;
3856    primitives.sensitivity = expand_prefix(
3857        std::mem::take(&mut primitives.sensitivity),
3858        prefix_values,
3859        total_values,
3860    )?;
3861    primitives.sum_weights = expand_prefix(
3862        std::mem::take(&mut primitives.sum_weights),
3863        prefix_planes,
3864        total_planes,
3865    )?;
3866    primitives.published_sum_weights = expand_prefix(
3867        std::mem::take(&mut primitives.published_sum_weights),
3868        prefix_planes,
3869        total_planes,
3870    )?;
3871    primitives.validity = expand_prefix_with(
3872        std::mem::take(&mut primitives.validity),
3873        prefix_planes,
3874        total_planes,
3875        SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped,
3876    )?;
3877    primitives.major_cycle_residual = expand_optional_prefix(
3878        primitives.major_cycle_residual.take(),
3879        prefix_values,
3880        total_values,
3881        Complex64::default(),
3882    )?;
3883    primitives.slab = SpectralSlabPlan {
3884        total_channels: slab.total_channels(),
3885        core_start: 0,
3886        core_end: slab.total_channels(),
3887        resident_start: 0,
3888        resident_end: slab.total_channels(),
3889    };
3890    Ok(())
3891}
3892
3893fn append_channel_local_domain(
3894    destination: &mut SpectralDomainPrimitives,
3895    source: SpectralDomainPrimitives,
3896) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
3897    if destination.domain_ordinal != source.domain_ordinal
3898        || destination.domain_role != source.domain_role
3899    {
3900        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DomainProjectionMismatch);
3901    }
3902    let source = source.primitives;
3903    let destination = &mut destination.primitives;
3904    let range = source.slab.core_range();
3905    let cells = checked_cells(source.shape)?;
3906    let source_planes = range
3907        .len()
3908        .checked_mul(source.polarizations)
3909        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3910    let plane_offset = range
3911        .start
3912        .checked_mul(source.polarizations)
3913        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3914    let source_values = source_planes
3915        .checked_mul(cells)
3916        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3917    let value_offset = plane_offset
3918        .checked_mul(cells)
3919        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
3920    if destination.shape != source.shape
3921        || !matches!(source.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal)
3922        || destination.basis != source.basis
3923        || destination.polarizations != source.polarizations
3924        || destination.joint_line_term_by_channel != source.joint_line_term_by_channel
3925        || destination.residual_model != source.residual_model
3926        || destination.major_cycle_residual_promoted != source.major_cycle_residual_promoted
3927        || source.common_residual.is_some()
3928        || source.invariant_common_dirty.is_some()
3929        || source.primary_beam_weighted_sum.is_some()
3930        || !source.channel_sum_weights.is_empty()
3931    {
3932        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
3933    }
3934    copy_slab(
3935        &mut destination.dirty,
3936        &source.dirty,
3937        value_offset,
3938        source_values,
3939    )?;
3940    copy_optional_slab(
3941        destination.invariant_dirty.as_deref_mut(),
3942        source.invariant_dirty.as_deref(),
3943        value_offset,
3944        source_values,
3945    )?;
3946    copy_slab(
3947        &mut destination.psf,
3948        &source.psf,
3949        value_offset,
3950        source_values,
3951    )?;
3952    copy_slab(
3953        &mut destination.sensitivity,
3954        &source.sensitivity,
3955        value_offset,
3956        source_values,
3957    )?;
3958    copy_slab(
3959        &mut destination.sum_weights,
3960        &source.sum_weights,
3961        plane_offset,
3962        source_planes,
3963    )?;
3964    copy_slab(
3965        &mut destination.published_sum_weights,
3966        &source.published_sum_weights,
3967        plane_offset,
3968        source_planes,
3969    )?;
3970    copy_slab(
3971        &mut destination.validity,
3972        &source.validity,
3973        plane_offset,
3974        source_planes,
3975    )?;
3976    copy_optional_slab(
3977        destination.major_cycle_residual.as_deref_mut(),
3978        source.major_cycle_residual.as_deref(),
3979        value_offset,
3980        source_values,
3981    )?;
3982    Ok(())
3983}
3984
3985fn expand_prefix<T: Copy + Default>(
3986    prefix: Box<[T]>,
3987    prefix_len: usize,
3988    total_len: usize,
3989) -> Result<Box<[T]>, SpectralOperatorError> {
3990    expand_prefix_with(prefix, prefix_len, total_len, T::default())
3991}
3992
3993fn expand_prefix_with<T: Copy>(
3994    prefix: Box<[T]>,
3995    prefix_len: usize,
3996    total_len: usize,
3997    fill: T,
3998) -> Result<Box<[T]>, SpectralOperatorError> {
3999    if prefix.len() != prefix_len || prefix_len > total_len {
4000        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
4001    }
4002    let mut expanded = vec![fill; total_len];
4003    expanded[..prefix_len].copy_from_slice(&prefix);
4004    Ok(expanded.into_boxed_slice())
4005}
4006
4007fn expand_optional_prefix<T: Copy>(
4008    prefix: Option<Box<[T]>>,
4009    prefix_len: usize,
4010    total_len: usize,
4011    fill: T,
4012) -> Result<Option<Box<[T]>>, SpectralOperatorError> {
4013    prefix
4014        .map(|values| expand_prefix_with(values, prefix_len, total_len, fill))
4015        .transpose()
4016}
4017
4018fn copy_slab<T: Copy>(
4019    destination: &mut [T],
4020    source: &[T],
4021    offset: usize,
4022    source_len: usize,
4023) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4024    let end = offset
4025        .checked_add(source_len)
4026        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
4027    if source.len() != source_len || end > destination.len() {
4028        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
4029    }
4030    destination[offset..end].copy_from_slice(source);
4031    Ok(())
4032}
4033
4034fn copy_optional_slab<T: Copy>(
4035    destination: Option<&mut [T]>,
4036    source: Option<&[T]>,
4037    offset: usize,
4038    source_len: usize,
4039) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4040    match (destination, source) {
4041        (Some(destination), Some(source)) => copy_slab(destination, source, offset, source_len),
4042        (None, None) => Ok(()),
4043        _ => Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch),
4044    }
4045}

4047// Derived slab replays reuse the sealed coverage identity without repeating
4048// its hashing work. Those work counters are receipts, not completion authority;
4049// the ordered fold retains the encoded prefix completion and its counters.
4050fn same_complete_data_authority(
4051    left: &CompleteDataOwnerCompletion,
4052    right: &CompleteDataOwnerCompletion,
4053) -> bool {
4054    left.problem == right.problem
4055        && left.geometry == right.geometry
4056        && left.numerics == right.numerics
4057        && left.weighting_commitment == right.weighting_commitment
4058        && left.weighting_generation == right.weighting_generation
4059        && left.replay == right.replay
4060        && left.coverage == right.coverage
4061        && left.primitives == right.primitives
4062        && left.selected_generation == right.selected_generation
4063        && left.continuum_transform_generation == right.continuum_transform_generation
4064        && left.sample_count == right.sample_count
4065        && left.block_count == right.block_count
4066}
4067
4068fn accumulate_complex_slice(
4069    destination: &mut [Complex64],
4070    source: &[Complex64],
4071) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4072    if destination.len() != source.len() {
4073        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
4074    }
4075    for (sum, value) in destination.iter_mut().zip(source) {
4076        *sum += *value;
4077    }
4078    Ok(())
4079}
4080
4081fn accumulate_optional_complex_slice(
4082    destination: Option<&mut [Complex64]>,
4083    source: Option<&[Complex64]>,
4084) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4085    match (destination, source) {
4086        (Some(destination), Some(source)) => accumulate_complex_slice(destination, source),
4087        (None, None) => Ok(()),
4088        _ => Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch),
4089    }
4090}
4091
4092fn accumulate_f64_slice(
4093    destination: &mut [f64],
4094    source: &[f64],
4095) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4096    if destination.len() != source.len() {
4097        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
4098    }
4099    for (sum, value) in destination.iter_mut().zip(source) {
4100        *sum += *value;
4101    }
4102    Ok(())
4103}
4104
4105fn normalize_response_family(
4106    values: &mut [Complex64],
4107    plane_count: usize,
4108    polarizations: usize,
4109    cells: usize,
4110    sum_weights: &[f64],
4111    primary_beam_weighted_sum: &[f64],
4112) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4113    if values.len() != plane_count * polarizations * cells
4114        || primary_beam_weighted_sum.len() != polarizations * cells
4115        || sum_weights.len() < polarizations
4116    {
4117        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
4118    }
4119    for plane in 0..plane_count {
4120        for (polarization, weight) in sum_weights.iter().copied().enumerate().take(polarizations) {
4121            let start = (plane * polarizations + polarization) * cells;
4122            let response_start = polarization * cells;
4123            for cell in 0..cells {
4124                let denominator = primary_beam_weighted_sum[response_start + cell];
4125                values[start + cell] = if denominator > 0.0 {
4126                    values[start + cell] * (weight / denominator)
4127                } else {
4128                    Complex64::default()
4129                };
4130            }
4131        }
4132    }
4133    Ok(())
4134}
4135
4136fn normalize_completed_primary_beam_psf_fold(
4137    primitives: &mut SpectralOperatorPrimitives,
4138) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4139    let Some(primary_beam_weighted_sum) = primitives.primary_beam_weighted_sum.as_deref() else {
4140        return Ok(());
4141    };
4142    let cells = checked_cells(primitives.shape)?;
4143    let normal_moments = primitives.basis.normal_moments(primitives.slab);
4144    trace_complex_values("publication_coefficient_before", &primitives.dirty);
4145    trace_complex_values("publication_psf_before", &primitives.psf);
4146    normalize_response_family(
4147        &mut primitives.psf,
4148        normal_moments,
4149        primitives.polarizations,
4150        cells,
4151        &primitives.sum_weights,
4152        primary_beam_weighted_sum,
4153    )?;
4154    trace_complex_values("publication_coefficient_after", &primitives.dirty);
4155    trace_complex_values("publication_psf_after", &primitives.psf);
4156    Ok(())
4157}
4158
4159const fn combine_validity(
4160    left: SpectralChannelValidity,
4161    right: SpectralChannelValidity,
4162) -> SpectralChannelValidity {
4163    match (left, right) {
4164        (SpectralChannelValidity::Valid, _) | (_, SpectralChannelValidity::Valid) => {
4165            SpectralChannelValidity::Valid
4166        }
4167        (SpectralChannelValidity::Blank, _) | (_, SpectralChannelValidity::Blank) => {
4168            SpectralChannelValidity::Blank
4169        }
4170        (SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped, SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped) => {
4171            SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped
4172        }
4173    }
4174}

4242#[derive(Debug)]
4243struct AwBlockProgress {
4244    owner: u64,
4245    started: Option<Instant>,
4246    last_reported: Option<Duration>,
4247    checkpoint_block: Option<u64>,
4248}
4249
4250impl AwBlockProgress {
4251    fn new() -> Self {
4252        use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
4253        static NEXT_OWNER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(1);
4254        Self {
4255            owner: NEXT_OWNER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed),
4256            started: None,
4257            last_reported: None,
4258            checkpoint_block: std::env::var("CASA_RS_TRACE_AW_CHECKPOINT_BLOCK").ok().map(
4259                |value| {
4260                    value
4261                        .parse::<std::num::NonZeroU64>()
4262                        .expect("AW checkpoint block must be a positive integer")
4263                        .get()
4264                },
4265            ),
4266        }
4267    }
4268
4269    fn begin(&mut self) {
4270        self.started.get_or_insert_with(Instant::now);
4271    }
4272
4273    fn observe(
4274        progress: &mut Option<Self>,
4275        complete: bool,
4276        completed_blocks: u64,
4277        emit: impl FnOnce(u64, Duration),
4278    ) {
4279        let Some(progress) = progress else {
4280            return;
4281        };
4282        let elapsed = progress
4283            .started
4284            .map_or(Duration::ZERO, |start| start.elapsed());
4285        if progress.report_at(
4286            elapsed,
4287            complete || progress.checkpoint_block == Some(completed_blocks),
4288        ) {
4289            emit(progress.owner, elapsed);
4290        }
4291    }
4292
4293    fn report_at(&mut self, elapsed: Duration, complete: bool) -> bool {
4294        if complete
4295            || self
4296                .last_reported
4297                .is_none_or(|previous| elapsed.saturating_sub(previous) >= Duration::from_secs(30))
4298        {
4299            self.last_reported = Some(elapsed);
4300            true
4301        } else {
4302            false
4303        }
4304    }
4305}

4314#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
4315struct CumulativeAwProbeConfig {
4316    row_start: u64,
4317    row_end: u64,
4318    ddid: i32,
4319    spw: u32,
4320    channels: usize,
4321    correlations: usize,
4322    accepted_hands: u64,
4323}
4324
4325impl CumulativeAwProbeConfig {
4326    fn parse(value: &str) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
4327        let values = value
4328            .split(':')
4329            .map(str::parse::<u64>)
4330            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
4331            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration)?;
4332        let [
4333            row_start,
4334            row_end,
4335            ddid,
4336            spw,
4337            channels,
4338            correlations,
4339            accepted_hands,
4340        ] = values.as_slice()
4341        else {
4342            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration);
4343        };
4344        let groups = row_end
4345            .checked_sub(*row_start)
4346            .and_then(|rows| rows.checked_mul(*channels))
4347            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration)?;
4348        if groups == 0
4349            || groups > 262_144
4350            || *channels > 4096
4351            || *correlations != 4
4352            || *ddid > i32::MAX as u64
4353            || *spw > u32::MAX as u64
4354            || *accepted_hands > groups * 2
4355        {
4356            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration);
4357        }
4358        Ok(Self {
4359            row_start: *row_start,
4360            row_end: *row_end,
4361            ddid: *ddid as i32,
4362            spw: *spw as u32,
4363            channels: *channels as usize,
4364            correlations: *correlations as usize,
4365            accepted_hands: *accepted_hands,
4366        })
4367    }
4368
4369    fn slot(self, address: SelectedSampleAddress) -> Result<Option<usize>, SpectralOperatorError> {
4370        if !(self.row_start..self.row_end).contains(&address.physical_row) {
4371            return Ok(None);
4372        }
4373        if address.data_description_id != self.ddid
4374            || address.spectral_window_id != self.spw
4375            || address.channel_index as usize >= self.channels
4376        {
4377            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch);
4378        }
4379        Ok(Some(
4380            (address.physical_row - self.row_start) as usize * self.channels
4381                + address.channel_index as usize,
4382        ))
4383    }
4384}

4405impl CumulativeAwScienceProbe {

4408            config,
4409            measurement_set: None,
4410            seen: vec![false; (config.row_end - config.row_start) as usize * config.channels],
4411            groups: 0,
4412            prefix_samples: 0,
4413            channels: vec![CumulativeAwChannel::default(); config.channels],
4414        }
4415    }
4416
4417    fn record_group(
4418        &mut self,
4419        address: SelectedSampleAddress,
4420        correlation_mask: u32,
4421    ) -> Result<bool, SpectralOperatorError> {
4422        let Some(slot) = self.config.slot(address)? else {
4423            return Ok(false);
4424        };
4425        if correlation_mask != (1 << self.config.correlations) - 1
4426            || self.seen[slot]
4427            || self
4428                .measurement_set
4429                .is_some_and(|ms| ms != address.measurement_set)
4430        {
4431            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch);
4432        }
4433        self.measurement_set = Some(address.measurement_set);
4434        self.seen[slot] = true;
4435        self.groups += 1;
4436        Ok(true)
4437    }
4438
4439    fn observe_inputs(
4440        &mut self,
4441        group: &[crate::weighting::WeightingSampleValue],
4442    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4443        self.prefix_samples = self
4444            .prefix_samples
4445            .checked_add(group.len() as u64)
4446            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)?;
4447        let first = group.first().ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
4448        let selected = first.selected();
4449        if self.config.slot(selected.address())?.is_none() {
4450            return Ok(());
4451        }
4452        let mut mask = 0_u32;
4453        let mut flags = 0_u32;
4454        for weighted in group {
4455            let input = weighted.selected();
4456            let index = input.address().correlation_index;
4457            if index >= self.config.correlations as u32 || mask & (1 << index) != 0 {
4458                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch);
4459            }
4460            mask |= 1 << index;
4461            flags |= u32::from(input.channel_flag) << index;
4462        }
4463        self.record_group(selected.address(), mask)?;
4464        let weight = first
4465            .source_imaging_weight()
4466            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
4467        let channel = &mut self.channels[selected.address().channel_index as usize];
4468        channel.raw_weight += f64::from(selected.input_weight);
4469        channel.imaging_weight += weight;
4470        eprintln!(
4471            "sample\t{}\t{}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}\t{weight:.17e}\t{flags}",
4472            selected.address().physical_row,
4473            selected.address().channel_index,
4474            selected.output_frame_frequency_hz(),
4475            selected.input_weight,
4476        );
4477        Ok(())
4478    }
4479
4480    fn observe_aw(
4481        &mut self,
4482        address: SelectedSampleAddress,
4483        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
4484        aw: &AwScienceProbePair,
4485    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4486        if self.config.slot(address)?.is_none() {
4487            return Ok(());
4488        }
4489        let channel = &mut self.channels[address.channel_index as usize];
4490        for (role, name, probe) in [(0, "CFS", &aw.imaging), (1, "WTCF", &aw.normal)] {
4491            if probe.taps.is_empty() {
4492                channel.off_grid[role] += 1;
4493                continue;
4494            }
4495            channel.accepted[role] += 1;
4496            channel.weighted_norm[role] += sample.imaging_weight
4497                * sample.spectral_factor
4498                * sample.spectral_factor
4499                * probe.raw_tap_sum.norm();
4500            eprintln!(
4501                "role_sample_rust\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{name}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}\t{}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}",
4502                address.physical_row,
4503                address.channel_index,
4504                address.correlation_index,
4505                probe.selected_frequency_hz,
4506                probe.selected_w_lambda,
4507                probe.mueller_element,
4508                probe.raw_tap_sum.re,
4509                probe.raw_tap_sum.im,
4510                probe.raw_tap_sum.norm(),
4511                probe.grid_location[0],
4512                probe.grid_location[1],
4513                probe.fractional_offset[0],
4514                probe.fractional_offset[1],
4515            );
4516        }
4517        Ok(())
4518    }
4519
4520    fn complete(&self) -> bool {
4521        self.groups == self.seen.len()
4522    }
4523
4524    fn stop_reason(&self) -> SpectralOperatorError {
4525        let accepted = self.channels.iter().fold([0_u64; 2], |mut sum, channel| {
4526            for (sum, count) in sum.iter_mut().zip(channel.accepted) {
4527                *sum += count;
4528            }
4529            sum
4530        });
4531        if !self.complete() || accepted != [self.config.accepted_hands; 2] {
4532            SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch
4533        } else {
4534            SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticStop
4535        }
4536    }
4537
4538    fn emit(&self) {
4539        eprintln!("cumulative_prefix_samples\t{}", self.prefix_samples);
4540        eprintln!(
4541            "cumulative_coverage\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{:?}",
4542            self.groups,
4543            self.seen.len(),
4544            self.config.accepted_hands,
4545            self.stop_reason()
4546        );
4547        for (index, channel) in self.channels.iter().enumerate() {
4548            eprintln!(
4549                "channel_rust\t{index}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}",
4550                channel.raw_weight,
4551                channel.imaging_weight,
4552                channel.accepted[0],
4553                channel.accepted[1],
4554                channel.off_grid[0],
4555                channel.off_grid[1],
4556                channel.weighted_norm[0],
4557                channel.weighted_norm[1],
4558            );
4559        }
4560    }
4561}

4563#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq)]
4564struct PolynomialAwScienceAggregate {
4565    accepted_count: u64,
4566    post_briggs_imaging_weight_sum: f64,
4567    published_polarization_weight_sum: f64,
4568    taylor_x_moment_sum: f64,
4569    pre_cf_imaging_moment_sum: f64,
4570    pre_cf_published_moment_sum: f64,
4571    selected_imaging_cf_normalization_sum: f64,
4572    selected_normal_cf_normalization_sum: f64,
4573    accumulated_normal_sumwt: f64,
4574    normal_sumwt_compensation: f64,
4575    accumulated_published_cfs_sumwt: f64,
4576    published_cfs_sumwt_compensation: f64,
4577}
4578
4579impl PolynomialAwScienceAggregate {
4580    fn accumulate_sumwt(&mut self, normal: f64, published_cfs: f64) {
4581        let corrected = normal - self.normal_sumwt_compensation;
4582        let updated = self.accumulated_normal_sumwt + corrected;
4583        self.normal_sumwt_compensation = (updated - self.accumulated_normal_sumwt) - corrected;
4584        self.accumulated_normal_sumwt = updated;
4585
4586        let corrected = published_cfs - self.published_cfs_sumwt_compensation;
4587        let updated = self.accumulated_published_cfs_sumwt + corrected;
4588        self.published_cfs_sumwt_compensation =
4589            (updated - self.accumulated_published_cfs_sumwt) - corrected;
4590        self.accumulated_published_cfs_sumwt = updated;
4591    }
4592}
