4594#[derive(Debug)]
4595struct SpectralScienceSample {
4596    address: SelectedSampleAddress,
4597    frequency_hz: f64,
4598    uvw_m: [f64; 3],
4599    post_briggs_weight: f64,
4600    spectral_factor: f64,
4601    taylor_factors: Box<[f64]>,
4602    aw: AwScienceProbePair,
4603}
4604
4605impl SpectralScienceProbe {
4606    fn emit_actual_aw_accumulator(
4607        operator: &SpectralSlabOperator,
4608    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4609        let grid = operator
4610            .psf_grids
4611            .as_ref()
4612            .and_then(|grids| grids.first())
4613            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)?;
4614        if grid.len() > 1_048_576 {
4615            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration);
4616        }
4617        let sum_weight = operator
4618            .sum_weights
4619            .first()
4620            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)?;
4621        let published = operator
4622            .aw_published_sum_weights
4623            .as_ref()
4624            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)?;
4625        eprintln!("actual_psf_grid_scope\tcumulative_prefix\ttaylor_0");
4626        eprintln!("actual_psf_grid_shape\t{}\t{}", grid.nrows(), grid.ncols());
4627        eprintln!("actual_psf_sum_weight\t{sum_weight:.17e}");
4628        for (lane, values) in published.normal.iter().enumerate() {
4629            let value = values
4630                .first()
4631                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)?;
4632            eprintln!("actual_published_cfs_sum_weight\t{lane}\t{value:.17e}");
4633        }
4634        let mut nonzero = 0;
4635        for ((x, y), value) in grid.indexed_iter() {
4636            if *value != Complex64::default() {
4637                eprintln!(
4638                    "actual_psf_grid\t{x}\t{y}\t{:.17e}\t{:.17e}",
4639                    value.re, value.im
4640                );
4641                nonzero += 1;
4642            }
4643        }
4644        eprintln!("actual_psf_grid_complete\t{nonzero}");
4645        Ok(())
4646    }
4647
4648    fn configured(
4649        enabled: bool,
4650        config: impl FnOnce() -> Result<Option<CumulativeAwProbeConfig>, SpectralOperatorError>,
4651    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, SpectralOperatorError> {
4652        if !enabled {
4653            return Ok(None);
4654        }
4655        Ok(Some(Self {
4656            cumulative: config()?.map(CumulativeAwScienceProbe::new),
4657            ..Self::default()
4658        }))
4659    }
4660
4661    fn from_environment(
4662        specification: &SpectralOperatorSpecification,
4663    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, SpectralOperatorError> {
4664        let probe = Self::configured(imaging_science_trace_enabled(), || {
4665            static CONFIG: OnceLock<
4666                Result<Option<CumulativeAwProbeConfig>, SpectralOperatorError>,
4667            > = OnceLock::new();
4668            *CONFIG.get_or_init(|| match std::env::var("CASA_RS_TRACE_AW_GROUP") {
4669                Ok(value) => CumulativeAwProbeConfig::parse(&value).map(Some),
4670                Err(std::env::VarError::NotPresent) => Ok(None),
4671                Err(_) => Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration),
4672            })
4673        })?;
4674        if probe
4675            .as_ref()
4676            .is_some_and(|probe| probe.cumulative.is_some())
4677            && (specification.aw_projection.is_none()
4678                || specification.chart_count() != 1
4679                || !matches!(specification.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_)))
4680        {
4681            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticConfiguration);
4682        }
4683        Ok(probe)
4684    }
4685
4686    fn finish(self) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4687        let stop = self
4688            .cumulative
4689            .as_ref()
4690            .map(CumulativeAwScienceProbe::stop_reason);
4691        self.emit();
4692        stop.map_or(Ok(()), Err)
4693    }
4694
4695    fn observe_polynomial_aw(
4696        &mut self,
4697        spectral_window: u32,
4698        plan: BlockNormalPlan,
4699        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
4700        imaging_cf_normalization: f64,
4701        normal_cf_normalization: f64,
4702    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4703        let x = plan
4704            .normalized_frequency(sample.frequency_hz)
4705            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
4706        let spectral_factor_squared = sample.spectral_factor * sample.spectral_factor;
4707        for moment in 0..plan.normal_moment_count() {
4708            let taylor_x_moment =
4709                x.powi(i32::try_from(moment).map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?);
4710            let pre_cf_imaging_moment =
4711                sample.imaging_weight * spectral_factor_squared * taylor_x_moment;
4712            let pre_cf_published_moment =
4713                sample.published_weight * spectral_factor_squared * taylor_x_moment;
4714            let aggregate = self
4715                .polynomial_aw
4716                .entry((spectral_window, moment))
4717                .or_default();
4718            aggregate.accepted_count = aggregate
4719                .accepted_count
4720                .checked_add(1)
4721                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
4722            aggregate.post_briggs_imaging_weight_sum += sample.imaging_weight;
4723            aggregate.published_polarization_weight_sum += sample.published_weight;
4724            aggregate.taylor_x_moment_sum += taylor_x_moment;
4725            aggregate.pre_cf_imaging_moment_sum += pre_cf_imaging_moment;
4726            aggregate.pre_cf_published_moment_sum += pre_cf_published_moment;
4727            aggregate.selected_imaging_cf_normalization_sum += imaging_cf_normalization;
4728            aggregate.selected_normal_cf_normalization_sum += normal_cf_normalization;
4729            aggregate.accumulate_sumwt(
4730                pre_cf_imaging_moment * normal_cf_normalization,
4731                pre_cf_published_moment * imaging_cf_normalization,
4732            );
4733        }
4734        Ok(())
4735    }
4736
4737    fn emit(self) {
4738        if let Some(cumulative) = &self.cumulative {
4739            cumulative.emit();
4740        }
4741        for ((spw, moment), aggregate) in self.polynomial_aw {
4742            eprintln!(
4743                "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=polynomial_aw_summary spw={spw} normal_moment={moment} accepted_count={} post_briggs_imaging_weight_sum={:.17e} published_polarization_weight_sum={:.17e} taylor_x_moment_sum={:.17e} pre_cf_imaging_moment_sum={:.17e} pre_cf_published_moment_sum={:.17e} selected_imaging_cf_normalization_sum={:.17e} selected_normal_cf_normalization_sum={:.17e} accumulated_normal_sumwt={:.17e} accumulated_published_cfs_sumwt={:.17e}",
4744                aggregate.accepted_count,
4745                aggregate.post_briggs_imaging_weight_sum,
4746                aggregate.published_polarization_weight_sum,
4747                aggregate.taylor_x_moment_sum,
4748                aggregate.pre_cf_imaging_moment_sum,
4749                aggregate.pre_cf_published_moment_sum,
4750                aggregate.selected_imaging_cf_normalization_sum,
4751                aggregate.selected_normal_cf_normalization_sum,
4752                aggregate.accumulated_normal_sumwt,
4753                aggregate.accumulated_published_cfs_sumwt,
4754            );
4755        }
4756        let Some(sample) = self.sample else { return };
4757        let AwScienceProbePair { imaging, normal } = sample.aw;
4758        for (cf_role, aw) in [("imaging", imaging), ("normal", normal)] {
4759            eprintln!(
4760                "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=sample_aw cf_role={cf_role} ms={:?} row={} ddid={} spw={} channel={} polarization={} correlation={} frequency_hz={:.17e} w_m={:.17e} w_lambda={:.17e} cf_identity={:?} cf_frequency_hz={:.17e} cf_w_lambda={:.17e} cf_mueller={} cf_pa_deg={:.17e} support_x={} support_y={} sampling={} grid_x={:.17e} grid_y={:.17e} location_x={} location_y={} offset_x={} offset_y={} tap_sum_re={:.17e} tap_sum_im={:.17e} abs_normalization={:.17e} channel_sumwt_increment={:.17e}",
4761                sample.address.measurement_set,
4762                sample.address.physical_row,
4763                sample.address.data_description_id,
4764                sample.address.spectral_window_id,
4765                sample.address.channel_index,
4766                sample.address.polarization_id,
4767                sample.address.correlation_index,
4768                sample.frequency_hz,
4769                sample.uvw_m[2],
4770                sample.uvw_m[2] * sample.frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S,
4771                aw.identity,
4772                aw.selected_frequency_hz,
4773                aw.selected_w_lambda,
4774                aw.mueller_element,
4775                aw.parallactic_angle_deg,
4776                aw.support[0],
4777                aw.support[1],
4778                aw.oversampling,
4779                aw.grid_position[0],
4780                aw.grid_position[1],
4781                aw.grid_location[0],
4782                aw.grid_location[1],
4783                aw.fractional_offset[0],
4784                aw.fractional_offset[1],
4785                aw.raw_tap_sum.re,
4786                aw.raw_tap_sum.im,
4787                aw.raw_tap_sum.norm(),
4788                sample.post_briggs_weight
4789                    * sample.spectral_factor
4790                    * sample.spectral_factor
4791                    * aw.raw_tap_sum.norm(),
4792            );
4793            for tap in aw.taps {
4794                eprintln!(
4795                    "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=sample_tap cf_role={cf_role} row={} spw={} channel={} ox={} oy={} grid_x={} grid_y={} cf_x={} cf_y={}",
4796                    sample.address.physical_row,
4797                    sample.address.spectral_window_id,
4798                    sample.address.channel_index,
4799                    tap.support_offset[0],
4800                    tap.support_offset[1],
4801                    tap.grid_coordinate[0],
4802                    tap.grid_coordinate[1],
4803                    tap.cf_coordinate[0],
4804                    tap.cf_coordinate[1],
4805                );
4806            }
4807            for (term, taylor_factor) in sample.taylor_factors.iter().copied().enumerate() {
4808                eprintln!(
4809                    "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=sample_sumwt cf_role={cf_role} row={} spw={} channel={} term={} taylor_factor={:.17e} sumwt_increment={:.17e}",
4810                    sample.address.physical_row,
4811                    sample.address.spectral_window_id,
4812                    sample.address.channel_index,
4813                    term,
4814                    taylor_factor,
4815                    sample.post_briggs_weight
4816                        * sample.spectral_factor
4817                        * sample.spectral_factor
4818                        * taylor_factor
4819                        * aw.raw_tap_sum.norm(),
4820                );
4821            }
4822        }
4823    }
4824}

4883#[derive(Debug)]
4884struct CasaLinearRowResampler {
4885    pending: Option<NativeSpectralGroup>,
4886    grid: Option<CasaLinearGrid>,
4887    next_fine_channel: usize,
4888}
4889
4890impl CasaLinearRowResampler {
4891    const fn new() -> Self {
4892        Self {
4893            pending: None,
4894            grid: None,
4895            next_fine_channel: 0,
4896        }
4897    }
4898
4899    fn push(
4900        &mut self,
4901        current: NativeSpectralGroup,
4902        output: CasaLinearOutputGrid,
4903        finite_values: FiniteValuePolicy,
4904        mut emit: impl FnMut(CasaResampledGroup) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError>,
4905    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
4906        let Some(previous) = self.pending.take() else {
4907            self.pending = Some(current);
4908            return Ok(());
4909        };
4910        if previous.key != current.key {
4911            self.grid = None;
4912            self.next_fine_channel = 0;
4913            self.pending = Some(current);
4914            return Ok(());
4915        }
4916        let grid = match self.grid {
4917            Some(grid) => grid,
4918            None => CasaLinearGrid::compile_for_output(
4919                output,
4920                previous.frequency_hz,
4921                current.frequency_hz,
4922            )
4923            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
4924        };
4925        let result = grid
4926            .samples_for_pair(
4927                &mut self.next_fine_channel,
4928                previous.frequency_hz,
4929                current.frequency_hz,
4930            )
4931            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?
4932            .try_for_each(|sample| {
4933                emit(resample_native_pair(
4934                    &previous,
4935                    &current,
4936                    sample,
4937                    finite_values,
4938                )?)
4939            });
4940        self.grid = Some(grid);
4941        self.pending = Some(current);
4942        result
4943    }
4944
4945    fn finish(&mut self) {
4946        self.pending = None;
4947        self.grid = None;
4948        self.next_fine_channel = 0;
4949    }
4950}
4951
4952fn resample_native_pair(
4953    left: &NativeSpectralGroup,
4954    right: &NativeSpectralGroup,
4955    fine: CasaLinearSample,
4956    finite_values: FiniteValuePolicy,
4957) -> Result<CasaResampledGroup, SpectralOperatorError> {
4958    if left.samples.len() != right.samples.len()
4959        || left.observed.len() != left.samples.len()
4960        || right.observed.len() != right.samples.len()
4961        || left.predicted.len() != left.samples.len()
4962        || right.predicted.len() != right.samples.len()
4963    {
4964        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
4965    }
4966    let [left_factor, right_factor] = fine.factors();
4967    let epsilon = f64::EPSILON;
4968    let mut correlations = SmallVec::new();
4969    let mut observed = SmallVec::new();
4970    let mut predicted = SmallVec::new();
4971    let mut weights = SmallVec::new();
4972    let mut flags = SmallVec::new();
4973    for (ordinal, (left_weighted, right_weighted)) in
4974        left.samples.iter().zip(&right.samples).enumerate()
4975    {
4976        let left_selected = left_weighted.selected();
4977        let right_selected = right_weighted.selected();
4978        if left_selected.address().correlation_type != right_selected.address().correlation_type
4979            || left_selected.address().correlation_index
4980                != right_selected.address().correlation_index
4981        {
4982            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
4983        }
4984        correlations.push(left_selected.address().correlation_type);
4985        observed
4986            .push(left.observed[ordinal] * left_factor + right.observed[ordinal] * right_factor);
4987        predicted
4988            .push(left.predicted[ordinal] * left_factor + right.predicted[ordinal] * right_factor);
4989        let left_weight = spectral_weight_for_output(left_weighted, fine.output_channel())?;
4990        let right_weight = spectral_weight_for_output(right_weighted, fine.output_channel())?;
4991        weights.push(left_weight * left_factor + right_weight * right_factor);
4992        let left_flag = !accept_polarization_input(left_selected, finite_values)?;
4993        let right_flag = !accept_polarization_input(right_selected, finite_values)?;
4994        flags.push(if right_factor <= epsilon {
4995            left_flag
4996        } else if right_factor >= 1.0 - epsilon {
4997            right_flag
4998        } else {
4999            left_flag || right_flag
5000        });
5001    }
5002    let selected = left
5003        .samples
5004        .first()
5005        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?
5006        .selected()
5007        .clone();
5008    Ok(CasaResampledGroup {
5009        output_channel: fine.output_channel(),
5010        frequency_hz: fine.frequency_hz(),
5011        selected,
5012        correlations,
5013        observed,
5014        predicted,
5015        weights,
5016        flags,
5017    })
5018}
5019
5020fn spectral_weight_for_output(
5021    weighted: &crate::weighting::WeightingSampleValue,
5022    output_channel: usize,
5023) -> Result<f64, SpectralOperatorError> {
5024    for spectral in weighted.spectral_values() {
5025        if usize::try_from(spectral.contribution().output_channel())
5026            .ok()
5027            .is_some_and(|channel| channel == output_channel)
5028        {
5029            return Ok(spectral.imaging_weight());
5030        }
5031    }
5032    weighted
5033        .source_imaging_weight()
5034        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)
5035}

5043        let (specification, workload, ffts, aw_projection) = prepared.into_parts();
5044        let slab = specification.slab();
5045        if specification.aw_projection.is_some() != aw_projection.is_some() {
5046            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
5047        }
5048        if SpectralOperatorSpecification::for_slab(
5049            problem,
5050            slab.core_range().start,
5051            slab.core_depth(),
5052        )? != specification
5053            || !weighting.matches_problem(problem)
5054        {
5055            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
5056        }
5057        if ffts.len() != specification.chart_count() {
5058            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
5059        }
5060        let specification = Arc::new(specification);
5061        let operators = specification
5062            .charts
5063            .iter()
5064            .zip(ffts)
5065            .map(|(chart, fft)| {
5066                SpectralSlabOperator::new_chart(
5067                    Arc::clone(&specification),
5068                    chart,
5069                    workload,
5070                    fft,
5071                    0,
5072                    aw_projection.clone(),
5073                )
5074            })
5075            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
5076        let linear_rows = CasaLinearRowResampler::new();
5077        let mosaic_response_capacity = specification.mosaic_response_route_capacity();
5078        let science_probe = SpectralScienceProbe::from_environment(&specification)?;
5079        let aw_progress = aw_projection
5080            .as_ref()
5081            .and_then(|_| imaging_stage_timing_started())
5082            .map(|_| AwBlockProgress::new());
5083        Ok(Self {

5085            geometry: specification.geometry,

5090            sample_count: 0,

5172    /// Bind a sealed first-pass coverage invariant before a derived later
5173    /// replay reaches the operator, including the empty-stream case.
5174    pub fn authorize_derived_coverage(
5175        &mut self,
5176        proof: FrozenWeightingCoverageProof,
5177    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
5178        if !proof.matches_streaming_operator(self.problem, self.weighting_commitment)
5179            || self.weighting_generation.is_some_and(|generation| {
5180                !proof.matches_operator(self.problem, self.weighting_commitment, generation)
5181            })
5182        {
5183            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::WeightingGeneration);
5184        }
5185        self.weighting_generation = Some(proof.generation());
5186        self.coverage = CoverageEncoder::derived(proof.coverage());
5187        Ok(())
5188    }
5189
5190    /// Bind the exact prepared final model before the exhaustive replay starts.
5191    pub fn bind_major_cycle_model(
5192        &mut self,
5193        generation: &ModelGeneration,
5194        prior_normal_state: Option<crate::FinalNormalState>,
5195    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
5196        if self.sample_count != 0 || self.next_block_sequence != 0 || self.model_binding.is_some() {
5197            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::MajorCycleAlreadyBound);
5198        }
5199        if prior_normal_state.is_some()
5200            && self
5201                .operators
5202                .iter()
5203                .any(|operator| operator.workload.initial_phase_residency().is_some())
5204        {
5205            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
5206        }
5207        let prior = prior_normal_state
5208            .map(crate::FinalNormalState::into_reusable_domains)
5209            .transpose()?
5210            .unwrap_or_default();
5211        if !prior.is_empty() && prior.len() != self.specification.domain_count() {
5212            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
5213        }
5214        let mut binding = None;
5215        for operator in &mut self.operators {
5216            if let Some(domain) = prior.get(operator.domain_ordinal) {
5217                operator.prepare_primary_beam_replay(domain)?;
5218            } else if operator.requires_primary_beam_replay()
5219                && operator.workload.pass == SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh
5220            {
5221                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
5222            }
5223            let domain_binding = operator.prepare_bound_residual_model(generation, None)?;
5224            if binding.is_some_and(|binding| binding != domain_binding) {
5225                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ModelMismatch);
5226            }
5227            binding = Some(domain_binding);
5228        }
5229        self.reusable_domains = (!prior.is_empty()).then_some(prior);
5230        self.model_binding = binding;
5231        Ok(())
5232    }
5233
5234    /// Bind the terminal model for prediction-only selected output.
5235    pub fn bind_selected_output_model(
5236        &mut self,
5237        generation: &ModelGeneration,
5238    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
5239        if self.sample_count != 0 || self.next_block_sequence != 0 || self.model_binding.is_some() {
5240            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::MajorCycleAlreadyBound);
5241        }
5242        for operator in &mut self.operators {
5243            operator.prepare_selected_output_model(generation)?;
5244        }
5245        self.model_binding = Some(ReconstructionModelBinding::Evaluated(
5246            generation.generation_id(),
5247        ));
5248        Ok(())
5249    }

5261
5262    /// Consume one reconstruction-owned T18 block in canonical replay order.
5263    pub fn consume_block(
5264        &mut self,
5265        block: &WeightingReplayChunk,
5266    ) -> Result<&[FinalVisibilitySample], SpectralOperatorError> {
5267        if let Some(progress) = &mut self.aw_progress {
5268            progress.begin();
5269        }
5270        if self.science_probe.is_some() {
5271            self.consume_block_inner::<true>(block)
5272        } else {
5273            self.consume_block_inner::<false>(block)
5274        }
5275    }
5276
5277    fn consume_block_inner<const OBSERVE: bool>(
5278        &mut self,
5279        block: &WeightingReplayChunk,
5280    ) -> Result<&[FinalVisibilitySample], SpectralOperatorError> {
5281        if block.sequence() != self.next_block_sequence {
5282            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::BlockSequence);
5283        }
5284        self.coverage.adopt(block.coverage_checkpoint());
5285        self.predicted_selected.clear();
5286        for group in block.correlation_groups() {
5287            if OBSERVE {
5288                if let Some(probe) = self
5289                    .science_probe
5290                    .as_mut()
5291                    .and_then(|probe| probe.cumulative.as_mut())
5292                {
5293                    probe.observe_inputs(group)?;
5294                }
5295            }
5296            self.consume_correlation_group::<OBSERVE>(group)?;
5297            if OBSERVE
5298                && self
5299                    .science_probe
5300                    .as_ref()
5301                    .and_then(|probe| probe.cumulative.as_ref())
5302                    .is_some_and(CumulativeAwScienceProbe::complete)
5303            {
5304                SpectralScienceProbe::emit_actual_aw_accumulator(
5305                    self.operators
5306                        .first()
5307                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)?,
5308                )?;
5309                self.science_probe
5310                    .take()
5311                    .expect("complete diagnostic exists")
5312                    .finish()?;
5313            }
5314        }
5315        self.sample_count = self
5316            .sample_count
5317            .checked_add(
5318                u64::try_from(block.samples().len())
5319                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?,
5320            )
5321            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
5322        self.next_block_sequence = self
5323            .next_block_sequence
5324            .checked_add(1)
5325            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
5326        self.observe_aw_block_progress(Some(block), false);
5327        Ok(&self.predicted_selected)
5328    }
5329
5330    fn observe_aw_block_progress(&mut self, block: Option<&WeightingReplayChunk>, complete: bool) {
5331        AwBlockProgress::observe(
5332            &mut self.aw_progress,
5333            complete,
5334            self.next_block_sequence,
5335            |owner, elapsed| {
5336                let first = block
5337                    .and_then(|block| block.samples().first())
5338                    .map(|sample| sample.selected().address());
5339                let last = block
5340                    .and_then(|block| block.samples().last())
5341                    .map(|sample| sample.selected().address());
5342                for operator in &self.operators {
5343                    let Some(aw) = &operator.aw_projection else {
5344                        continue;
5345                    };
5346                    let counters = match aw.lock() {
5347                        Ok(aw) => {
5348                            aw.emit_timing_checkpoint();
5349                            aw.diagnostics()
5350                        }
5351                        Err(_) => {
5352                            eprintln!(
5353                                "imaging_aw_block_progress owner={} chart={} diagnostics_available=0",
5354                                owner, operator.chart_ordinal
5355                            );
5356                            continue;
5357                        }
5358                    };
5359                    eprintln!(
5360                        "imaging_aw_block_progress owner={} chart={} pass={:?} complete={} elapsed_nanos={} completed_blocks={} completed_samples={} last_sequence={:?} problem={} weighting={:?} model={:?} first_row={:?} last_row={:?} first_ddid={:?} last_ddid={:?} first_spw={:?} last_spw={:?} selections={} degrid_passes={} grid_preparations={} evaluated_cfs_taps={} evaluated_wtcf_taps={} provider_hits={} provider_loads={} evicted_bytes={} copied_bytes={} resident_byte_ceiling={} diagnostics_available=1",
5361                        owner,
5362                        operator.chart_ordinal,
5363                        operator.workload.pass,
5364                        u8::from(complete),
5365                        elapsed.as_nanos(),
5366                        self.next_block_sequence,
5367                        self.sample_count,
5368                        self.next_block_sequence.checked_sub(1),
5369                        self.problem,
5370                        self.weighting_generation,
5371                        self.model_binding,
5372                        first.map(|address| address.physical_row),
5373                        last.map(|address| address.physical_row),
5374                        first.map(|address| address.data_description_id),
5375                        last.map(|address| address.data_description_id),
5376                        first.map(|address| address.spectral_window_id),
5377                        last.map(|address| address.spectral_window_id),
5378                        counters.selections,
5379                        counters.degrid_passes,
5380                        counters.grid_passes,
5381                        counters.imaging_taps,
5382                        counters.weight_taps,
5383                        counters.provider_hits,
5384                        counters.provider_loads,
5385                        counters.evicted_bytes,
5386                        counters.copied_bytes,
5387                        counters.resident_byte_ceiling,
5388                    );
5389                }
5390            },
5391        );
5392    }

5400        &mut self,
5401        selected: &crate::weighting::WeightingSelectedSample,
5402    ) -> Result<Option<MosaicResponse>, SpectralOperatorError> {
