7134impl SpectralSlabOperator {
7135    pub(crate) fn convolution_maximum_support(&self) -> usize {
7136        self.maximum_convolution_support
7137    }
7138
7139    #[cfg(test)]
7140    fn new_with_geometry(
7141        geometry: SpectralOperatorGeometry,
7142        slab: SpectralSlabPlan,
7143        workload: SpectralOperatorWorkload,
7144        fft: PreparedFft,
7145    ) -> Self {
7146        Self::new_inner(
7147            SpectralSlabDefinition {
7148                specification: None,
7149                chart_ordinal: 0,
7150                domain_ordinal: 0,
7151                facet_ordinal: 0,
7152                window: None,
7153                geometry,
7154                slab,
7155                basis: if slab.total_channels() == 1 {
7156                    SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(
7157                        BlockNormalPlan::constant(1.0).expect("positive test reference frequency"),
7158                    )
7159                } else {
7160                    SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal
7161                },
7162                polarization_count: 1,
7163                joint_line_term_by_channel: vec![None; slab.total_channels()].into_boxed_slice(),
7164                output_channel_frequencies_hz: vec![1.0; slab.total_channels()].into_boxed_slice(),
7165                instrument_model: None,
7166                w_projection: None,
7167                mosaic: false,
7168                primary_beam_cutoff: 0.0,
7169                aw_projection: None,
7170            },
7171            workload,
7172            fft,
7173            workload.max_replay_block_samples,
7174        )
7175        .expect("test convolution contract is valid")
7176    }
7177
7178    fn new_inner(
7179        definition: SpectralSlabDefinition,
7180        workload: SpectralOperatorWorkload,
7181        fft: PreparedFft,
7182        prediction_capacity: usize,
7183    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
7184        let SpectralSlabDefinition {
7185            specification,
7186            chart_ordinal,
7187            domain_ordinal,
7188            facet_ordinal,
7189            window,
7190            geometry,
7191            slab,
7192            basis,
7193            polarization_count,
7194            joint_line_term_by_channel,
7195            output_channel_frequencies_hz,
7196            instrument_model,
7197            w_projection,
7198            mosaic,
7199            primary_beam_cutoff,
7200            aw_projection,
7201        } = definition;
7202        let gridder = ConvolutionOperator::new(&geometry, w_projection)?;
7203        let maximum_convolution_support = aw_projection.as_ref().map_or_else(
7204            || gridder.maximum_support(),
7205            PreparedAwProjection::maximum_imaging_support,
7206        );
7207        let shape = (geometry.grid_shape[0], geometry.grid_shape[1]);
7208        let plane_grids =
7209            |depth: usize| (0..depth).map(|_| Array2::zeros(shape)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
7210        let initial = workload.pass == SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor;
7211        let aw_imaging_oversampling = aw_projection
7212            .as_ref()
7213            .map(PreparedAwProjection::imaging_oversampling);
7214        let aw_weight_oversampling = aw_projection
7215            .as_ref()
7216            .map(PreparedAwProjection::weight_oversampling);
7217        let has_aw_projection = aw_projection.is_some();
7218        let normal_moments = basis.normal_moments(slab) * polarization_count;
7219        let major_coefficient_planes = basis.major_coefficient_planes(slab) * polarization_count;
7220        let major_normal_planes = basis.major_normal_planes(slab) * polarization_count;
7221        let resident_terms = if instrument_model.is_some() && basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some()
7222        {
7223            slab.resident_depth()
7224        } else {
7225            basis.resident_terms(slab)
7226        } * polarization_count;
7227        let joint_channels = if matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
7228            slab.total_channels() * polarization_count
7229        } else {
7230            0
7231        };
7232        let channel_major_planes = if basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
7233            slab.core_depth() * polarization_count
7234        } else {
7235            0
7236        };
7237        let mosaic_normal_entry_capacity = specification.as_ref().map_or(0, |specification| {
7238            specification.mosaic_normal_entry_capacity
7239        });
7240        Ok(Self {
7241            specification,
7242            chart_ordinal,
7243            domain_ordinal,
7244            facet_ordinal,
7245            window,
7246            geometry,
7247            slab,
7248            basis,
7249            polarization_count,
7250            joint_line_term_by_channel,
7251            output_channel_frequencies_hz,
7252            workload,
7253            gridder,
7254            aw_projection: aw_projection
7255                .map(|projection| projection.instantiate())
7256                .transpose()?
7257                .map(Mutex::new),
7258            maximum_convolution_support,
7259            fft,
7260            dirty_grids: initial.then(|| plane_grids(major_coefficient_planes)),
7261            dirty_compensations: initial.then(|| plane_grids(major_coefficient_planes)),
7262            psf_grids: initial.then(|| plane_grids(major_normal_planes)),
7263            psf_compensations: initial.then(|| plane_grids(major_normal_planes)),
7264            aw_sensitivity_grids: (initial && has_aw_projection)
7265                .then(|| plane_grids(major_normal_planes)),
7266            aw_sensitivity_compensations: (initial && has_aw_projection)
7267                .then(|| plane_grids(major_normal_planes)),
7268            residual_grids: None,
7269            residual_compensations: None,
7270            common_residual_grids: (initial && matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }))
7271                .then(|| plane_grids(slab.total_channels() * polarization_count)),
7272            common_residual_compensations: (initial
7273                && matches!(basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }))
7274            .then(|| plane_grids(slab.total_channels() * polarization_count)),
7275            reused_normal_state: None,
7276            primary_beam: instrument_model.and_then(|instrument_model| {
7277                if instrument_model == InstrumentModel::CasaEvlaWidebandAwV1 {
7278                    return None;
7279                }
7280                let response = PreparedPrimaryBeamPower::casa_alma_aca_interferometric_direct(
7281                    geometry.reference_pixel,
7282                    geometry.increment_rad,
7283                    geometry.image_shape,
7284                    if matches!(
7285                        instrument_model,
7286                        InstrumentModel::CasaAlmaAcaHeterogeneousInterferometricResponseV1
7287                    ) {
7288                        0.0
7289                    } else {
7290                        primary_beam_cutoff
7291                    },
7292                )
7293                .expect("compiled response geometry is valid");
7294                match instrument_model {
7295                    InstrumentModel::CasaAca7mInterferometricDirectPbV1 => Some(response),
7296                    InstrumentModel::CasaAlmaAcaHeterogeneousInterferometricResponseV1 => {
7297                        Some(response.with_casa_aca_hetarray_convolution())
7298                    }
7299                    InstrumentModel::CasaEvlaWidebandAwV1 => unreachable!(
7300                        "EVLA AW response is consumed from paired prepared convolution functions"
7301                    ),
7302                }
7303            }),
7304            mosaic_normal: mosaic.then(|| {
7305                (0..normal_moments)
7306                    .map(|_| {
7307                        MosaicNormalAccumulator::with_capacity(
7308                            mosaic_normal_entry_capacity,
7309                            mosaic_normal_entry_capacity,
7310                        )
7311                    })
7312                    .collect()
7313            }),
7314            mosaic_projectors: BTreeMap::new(),
7315            primary_beam_replay: None,
7316            forward_grids: plane_grids(resident_terms),
7317            predictions: vec![Complex64::default(); prediction_capacity].into_boxed_slice(),
7318            prediction_len: 0,
7319            sum_weights: vec![0.0; normal_moments],
7320            sum_weight_compensations: vec![0.0; normal_moments],
7321            published_sum_weights: vec![0.0; normal_moments],
7322            published_sum_weight_compensations: vec![0.0; normal_moments],
7323            aw_published_sum_weights: has_aw_projection
7324                .then(|| AwPublishedSumWeights::new(normal_moments, channel_major_planes)),
7325            channel_sum_weights: vec![0.0; joint_channels],
7326            channel_sum_weight_compensations: vec![0.0; joint_channels],
7327            channel_major_sum_weights: vec![0.0; channel_major_planes],
7328            channel_major_sum_weight_compensations: vec![0.0; channel_major_planes],
7329            channel_major_published_sum_weights: vec![0.0; channel_major_planes],
7330            channel_major_published_sum_weight_compensations: vec![0.0; channel_major_planes],
7331            mapped_samples: vec![0; basis.validity_entries(slab) * polarization_count],
7332            coefficient_basis: vec![0.0; basis.coefficient_terms(slab)],
7333            normal_moment_weights: vec![0.0; basis.normal_moments(slab)],
7334            image_correction_oversampling: aw_imaging_oversampling
7335                .or_else(|| mosaic.then_some(MOSAIC_OVERSAMPLING)),
7336            aw_weight_oversampling,
7337            #[cfg(test)]
7338            measurements: SpectralOperatorMeasurements::default(),
7339        })
7340    }
7341
7342    pub(crate) fn new_chart(
7343        specification: Arc<SpectralOperatorSpecification>,
7344        chart: &SpectralOperatorChartSpecification,
7345        workload: SpectralOperatorWorkload,
7346        fft: PreparedFft,
7347        prediction_capacity: usize,
7348        aw_projection: Option<PreparedAwProjection>,
7349    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
7350        Self::new_inner(
7351            SpectralSlabDefinition {
7352                specification: Some(Arc::clone(&specification)),
7353                chart_ordinal: chart.ordinal,
7354                domain_ordinal: chart.domain_ordinal,
7355                facet_ordinal: chart.facet_ordinal,
7356                window: Some(chart.window),
7357                geometry: chart.geometry,
7358                slab: specification.slab,
7359                basis: specification.basis,
7360                polarization_count: specification.polarization_count(),
7361                joint_line_term_by_channel: specification.joint_line_term_by_channel.clone(),
7362                output_channel_frequencies_hz: specification.output_channel_frequencies_hz.clone(),
7363                instrument_model: specification.instrument_model,
7364                w_projection: specification.w_projection,
7365                mosaic: specification.mosaic,
7366                primary_beam_cutoff: specification.primary_beam_cutoff,
7367                aw_projection,
7368            },
7369            workload,
7370            fft,
7371            prediction_capacity,
7372        )
7373    }
7374
7375    /// Accumulate one already-weighted spectral contribution.
7376    #[cfg(test)]
7377    fn push(&mut self, sample: SpectralOperatorSample) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7378        self.push_polarization(sample, 0)
7379    }
7380
7381    fn push_polarization(
7382        &mut self,
7383        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
7384        polarization: usize,
7385    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7386        if polarization >= self.polarization_count {
7387            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
7388        }
7389        let channel_plane = self.slab.core_index(sample.output_channel);
7390        match self.basis {
7391            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
7392                let Some(plane) = channel_plane else {
7393                    return Ok(());
7394                };
7395                let plane = self.polarization_plane(plane, polarization);
7396                self.mapped_samples[plane] = self.mapped_samples[plane]
7397                    .checked_add(1)
7398                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
7399            }
7400            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_) | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => {
7401                if channel_plane.is_none() {
7402                    return Ok(());
7403                }
7404                for mapped in self
7405                    .mapped_samples
7406                    .iter_mut()
7407                    .skip(polarization)
7408                    .step_by(self.polarization_count)
7409                {
7410                    *mapped = mapped
7411                        .checked_add(1)
7412                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
7413                }
7414            }
7415            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
7416                if self
7417                    .mapped_samples
7418                    .get(self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization))
7419                    .is_none()
7420                {
7421                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
7422                }
7423            }
7424        }
7425        if sample.imaging_weight == 0.0 {
7426            return Ok(());
7427        }
7428        let Some(taps) = self.operator_taps(sample, false)? else {
7429            return Ok(());
7430        };
7431        let taps = self.prepare_grid_taps(taps, true)?;
7432        let normal_normalization = taps.normal_normalization(&self.gridder)?;
7433        let published_normalization = taps.imaging_normalization(&self.gridder)?;
7434        let aw_publication_lane = self.aw_publication_lane(sample)?;
7435        let factor = sample.spectral_factor;
7436        match self.basis {
7437            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
7438                let plane = self.polarization_plane(
7439                    channel_plane.expect("mapped channel-local sample has a core plane"),
7440                    polarization,
7441                );
7442                self.grid_dirty_term(
7443                    plane,
7444                    &taps,
7445                    sample.visibility * sample.phase() * (sample.imaging_weight * factor),
7446                )?;
7447                let normal_weight = sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor;
7448                self.accumulate_mosaic_normal(plane, sample, &taps, normal_weight)?;
7449                self.grid_normal_moment(plane, &taps, normal_weight, normal_normalization)?;
7450                self.accumulate_published_sum_weight(
7451                    plane,
7452                    sample.published_weight * factor * factor,
7453                    published_normalization,
7454                    aw_publication_lane,
7455                )?;
7456            }
7457            SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => {
7458                let plane = self.polarization_plane(
7459                    channel_plane.expect("mapped channel-major sample has a core plane"),
7460                    polarization,
7461                );
7462                self.grid_dirty_term(
7463                    plane,
7464                    &taps,
7465                    sample.visibility * sample.phase() * (sample.imaging_weight * factor),
7466                )?;
7467                self.grid_channel_major_normal(
7468                    plane,
7469                    &taps,
7470                    &ChannelMajorNormalContribution {
7471                        imaging_weight: sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor,
7472                        normal_normalization,
7473                        published_weight: sample.published_weight * factor * factor,
7474                        published_normalization,
7475                        aw_publication_lane,
7476                    },
7477                )?;
7478            }
7479            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) => {
7480                plan.fill_weighted_coefficient_basis(
7481                    sample.frequency_hz,
7482                    sample.imaging_weight * factor,
7483                    &mut self.coefficient_basis,
7484                )
7485                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7486                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(
7487                    sample.frequency_hz,
7488                    sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor,
7489                    &mut self.normal_moment_weights,
7490                )
7491                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7492                let visibility_scale = sample.visibility * sample.phase();
7493                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
7494                    let coefficient = self.coefficient_basis[term];
7495                    let plane = self.polarization_plane(term, polarization);
7496                    self.grid_dirty_term(plane, &taps, visibility_scale * coefficient)?;
7497                }
7498                for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
7499                    let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
7500                    let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
7501                    self.accumulate_mosaic_normal(moment, sample, &taps, weight)?;
7502                    self.grid_normal_moment(moment, &taps, weight, normal_normalization)?;
7503                }
7504                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(
7505                    sample.frequency_hz,
7506                    sample.published_weight * factor * factor,
7507                    &mut self.normal_moment_weights,
7508                )
7509                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7510                for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
7511                    let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
7512                    let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
7513                    self.accumulate_published_sum_weight(
7514                        moment,
7515                        weight,
7516                        published_normalization,
7517                        aw_publication_lane,
7518                    )?;
7519                }
7520            }
7521            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
7522                let mapped_index = self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization);
7523                let mapped = self
7524                    .mapped_samples
7525                    .get_mut(mapped_index)
7526                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7527                *mapped = mapped
7528                    .checked_add(1)
7529                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
7530                let channel = self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization);
7531                if normal_normalization > 0.0 {
7532                    let corrected = sample.imaging_weight * normal_normalization
7533                        - self.channel_sum_weight_compensations[channel];
7534                    let updated = self.channel_sum_weights[channel] + corrected;
7535                    self.channel_sum_weight_compensations[channel] =
7536                        (updated - self.channel_sum_weights[channel]) - corrected;
7537                    self.channel_sum_weights[channel] = updated;
7538                }
7539                self.fill_joint_coefficient_basis(sample.frequency_hz, sample.output_channel)?;
7540                let weighted_factor = sample.imaging_weight * factor;
7541                let visibility_scale = sample.visibility * sample.phase() * weighted_factor;
7542                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
7543                    let plane = self.polarization_plane(term, polarization);
7544                    self.grid_dirty_term(
7545                        plane,
7546                        &taps,
7547                        visibility_scale * self.coefficient_basis[term],
7548                    )?;
7549                }
7550                self.grid_common_residual_term(channel, &taps, visibility_scale)?;
7551                self.fill_joint_normal_weights(sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor)?;
7552                for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
7553                    let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
7554                    let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
7555                    self.grid_normal_moment(moment, &taps, weight, normal_normalization)?;
7556                }
7557                self.fill_joint_normal_weights(sample.published_weight * factor * factor)?;
7558                for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
7559                    let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
7560                    let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
7561                    self.accumulate_published_sum_weight(
7562                        moment,
7563                        weight,
7564                        published_normalization,
7565                        aw_publication_lane,
7566                    )?;
7567                }
7568            }
7569        }
7570        Ok(())
7571    }
7572
7573    fn operator_taps(
7574        &mut self,
7575        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
7576        prediction: bool,
7577    ) -> Result<Option<OperatorTaps>, SpectralOperatorError> {
7578        if self.aw_projection.is_some() {
7579            return self
7580                .aw_visibility_sample(
7581                    AwReplayCoordinates::from_sample(sample)?,
7582                    [0, 0],
7583                    prediction,
7584                )
7585                .map(OperatorTaps::Aw)
7586                .map(Some);
7587        }
7588        if self.mosaic_normal.is_none() {
7589            return Ok(self
7590                .gridder
7591                .taps(sample.uvw_lambda())
7592                .map(OperatorTaps::Standard));
7593        }
7594        let (field_id, pointings) = sample
7595            .mosaic_route
7596            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7597        if pointings.antenna1.frame() != pointings.antenna2.frame()
7598            || pointings.antenna1.frame() != self.geometry.direction.reference_direction().frame()
7599        {
7600            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem);
7601        }
7602        let mosaic_response = sample
7603            .mosaic_response
7604            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7605        let pointings = mosaic_response.canonical_pointings(pointings);
7606        if !self.mosaic_projectors.contains_key(&mosaic_response.key) {
7607            let response = self
7608                .primary_beam
7609                .as_ref()
7610                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?;
7611            let specification = self
7612                .specification
7613                .as_ref()
7614                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?;
7615            let response_capacity = specification.mosaic_projector_capacity();
7616            if self.mosaic_projectors.len() == response_capacity {
7617                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow);
7618            }
7619            self.mosaic_projectors.insert(
7620                mosaic_response.key,
7621                MosaicProjector::new(
7622                    self.geometry,
7623                    response,
7624                    mosaic_response.canonical_responses(),
7625                    mosaic_response.frequency_hz,
7626                    mosaic_response.support_frequency_hz,
7627                    specification.mosaic_field_capacity,
7628                )?,
7629            );
7630        }
7631        let response = self
7632            .primary_beam
7633            .as_ref()
7634            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedProblem)?;
7635        let plan = self
7636            .mosaic_projectors
7637            .get_mut(&mosaic_response.key)
7638            .expect("frequency projector was inserted")
7639            .plan(response, field_id, sample.uv_lambda(), pointings)?;
7640        Ok(plan.map(|plan| OperatorTaps::Mosaic {
7641            response_key: mosaic_response.key,
7642            plan,
7643        }))
7644    }
7645
7646    fn prepare_grid_taps(
7647        &mut self,
7648        taps: OperatorTaps,
7649        with_sensitivity: bool,
7650    ) -> Result<GridOperatorTaps, SpectralOperatorError> {
7651        match taps {
7652            OperatorTaps::Standard(taps) => Ok(GridOperatorTaps::Standard(taps)),
7653            OperatorTaps::Mosaic { response_key, plan } => {
7654                Ok(GridOperatorTaps::Mosaic { response_key, plan })
7655            }
7656            OperatorTaps::Aw(sample) => {
7657                let aw = self
7658                    .aw_projection
7659                    .as_ref()
7660                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7661                let mut aw = aw
7662                    .lock()
7663                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7664                let (imaging, normal, sensitivity) = if with_sensitivity {
7665                    let (imaging, normal) =
7666                        aw.prepare_imaging_and_normal_grid(self.geometry.grid_shape, sample)?;
7667                    (
7668                        imaging,
7669                        Some(normal),
7670                        Some(aw.prepare_sensitivity_grid(self.geometry.grid_shape, sample)?),
7671                    )
7672                } else {
7673                    (
7674                        aw.prepare_imaging_grid(self.geometry.grid_shape, sample)?,
7675                        None,
7676                        None,
7677                    )
7678                };
7679                Ok(GridOperatorTaps::Aw {
7680                    imaging,
7681                    normal,
7682                    sensitivity,
7683                })
7684            }
7685        }
7686    }
7687
7688    fn observe_aw_grid(
7689        &mut self,
7690        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
7691    ) -> Result<AwScienceProbePair, SpectralOperatorError> {
7692        let OperatorTaps::Aw(sample) = self
7693            .operator_taps(sample, false)?
7694            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?
7695        else {
7696            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
7697        };
7698        let aw = self
7699            .aw_projection
7700            .as_ref()
7701            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7702        let mut aw = aw
7703            .lock()
7704            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7705        aw.prepare_imaging_and_normal_grid_observed(self.geometry.grid_shape, sample)
7706            .map(|(_, _, probes)| probes)
7707            .map_err(Into::into)
7708    }
7709
7710    fn accumulate_mosaic_normal(
7711        &mut self,
7712        plane: usize,
7713        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
7714        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
7715        weight: f64,
7716    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7717        let Some(accumulators) = self.mosaic_normal.as_mut() else {
7718            return Ok(());
7719        };
7720        let (field_id, pointings) = sample
7721            .mosaic_route
7722            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7723        let mosaic_response = sample
7724            .mosaic_response
7725            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7726        let pointings = mosaic_response.canonical_pointings(pointings);
7727        let GridOperatorTaps::Mosaic { plan, .. } = taps else {
7728            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
7729        };
7730        accumulators
7731            .get_mut(plane)
7732            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?
7733            .accumulate(
7734                field_id,
7735                mosaic_response.key,
7736                pointings,
7737                mosaic_response.frequency_hz,
7738                *plan,
7739                weight,
7740            )
7741    }
7742
7743    fn polarization_plane(&self, spectral_plane: usize, polarization: usize) -> usize {
7744        spectral_plane * self.polarization_count + polarization
7745    }
7746
7747    fn fill_joint_coefficient_basis(
7748        &mut self,
7749        frequency_hz: f64,
7750        output_channel: usize,
7751    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7752        let SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
7753            continuum,
7754            line_terms,
7755        } = self.basis
7756        else {
7757            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
7758        };
7759        self.coefficient_basis.fill(0.0);
7760        let continuum_terms = continuum.coefficient_term_count();
7761        continuum
7762            .fill_coefficient_basis(frequency_hz, &mut self.coefficient_basis[..continuum_terms])
7763            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
7764        if let Some(line_term) = self
7765            .joint_line_term_by_channel
7766            .get(output_channel)
7767            .copied()
7768            .flatten()
7769        {
7770            if line_term >= line_terms {
7771                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
7772            }
7773            self.coefficient_basis[continuum_terms + line_term] = 1.0;
7774        }
7775        Ok(())
7776    }
7777
7778    fn fill_joint_normal_weights(&mut self, scale: f64) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7779        if !scale.is_finite() || scale < 0.0 {
7780            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
7781        }
7782        let terms = self.coefficient_basis.len();
7783        if self.normal_moment_weights.len() != terms.saturating_mul(terms) {
7784            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
7785        }
7786        for row in 0..terms {
7787            for column in 0..terms {
7788                self.normal_moment_weights[row * terms + column] =
7789                    scale * self.coefficient_basis[row] * self.coefficient_basis[column];
7790            }
7791        }
7792        Ok(())
7793    }
7794
7795    fn grid_dirty_term(
7796        &mut self,
7797        plane: usize,
7798        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
7799        value: Complex64,
7800    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7801        let grid = &mut self
7802            .dirty_grids
7803            .as_mut()
7804            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?[plane];
7805        let compensation = &mut self
7806            .dirty_compensations
7807            .as_mut()
7808            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?[plane];
7809        grid_operator_compensated(
7810            &self.gridder,
7811            &self.mosaic_projectors,
7812            CompensatedGrid {
7813                values: grid,
7814                errors: compensation,
7815            },
7816            taps,
7817            GridAccumulationRole::Imaging,
7818            value,
7819        )?;
7820        #[cfg(test)]
7821        record_measurement(
7822            &mut self.measurements.dirty_grid_tap_visits,
7823            TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE,
7824        );
7825        Ok(())
7826    }
7827
7828    fn grid_normal_moment(
7829        &mut self,
7830        moment: usize,
7831        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
7832        weight: f64,
7833        normalization: f64,
7834    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7835        let grid = &mut self
7836            .psf_grids
7837            .as_mut()
7838            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?[moment];
7839        let compensation = &mut self
7840            .psf_compensations
7841            .as_mut()
7842            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?[moment];
7843        grid_operator_compensated(
7844            &self.gridder,
7845            &self.mosaic_projectors,
7846            CompensatedGrid {
7847                values: grid,
7848                errors: compensation,
7849            },
7850            taps,
7851            GridAccumulationRole::Normal,
7852            Complex64::new(weight, 0.0),
7853        )?;
7854        #[cfg(test)]
7855        record_measurement(
7856            &mut self.measurements.psf_grid_tap_visits,
7857            TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE,
7858        );
7859        self.grid_aw_sensitivity(moment, taps, weight)?;
7860        if normalization > 0.0 {
7861            let corrected = weight * normalization - self.sum_weight_compensations[moment];
7862            let updated = self.sum_weights[moment] + corrected;
7863            self.sum_weight_compensations[moment] =
7864                (updated - self.sum_weights[moment]) - corrected;
7865            self.sum_weights[moment] = updated;
7866        }
7867        Ok(())
7868    }
7869
7870    fn grid_channel_major_normal(
7871        &mut self,
7872        plane: usize,
7873        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
7874        contribution: &ChannelMajorNormalContribution,
7875    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7876        grid_operator_compensated(
7877            &self.gridder,
7878            &self.mosaic_projectors,
7879            CompensatedGrid {
7880                values: &mut self
7881                    .psf_grids
7882                    .as_mut()
7883                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?[plane],
7884                errors: &mut self
7885                    .psf_compensations
7886                    .as_mut()
7887                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?[plane],
7888            },
7889            taps,
7890            GridAccumulationRole::Normal,
7891            Complex64::new(contribution.imaging_weight, 0.0),
7892        )?;
7893        #[cfg(test)]
7894        record_measurement(
7895            &mut self.measurements.psf_grid_tap_visits,
7896            TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE,
7897        );
7898        self.grid_aw_sensitivity(plane, taps, contribution.imaging_weight)?;
7899        accumulate_compensated(
7900            &mut self.channel_major_sum_weights,
7901            &mut self.channel_major_sum_weight_compensations,
7902            plane,
7903            contribution.imaging_weight * contribution.normal_normalization,
7904        )?;
7905        if let Some(lane) = contribution.aw_publication_lane {
7906            let aw = self
7907                .aw_published_sum_weights
7908                .as_mut()
7909                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7910            accumulate_compensated(
7911                aw.channel_major
7912                    .get_mut(lane)
7913                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
7914                aw.channel_major_compensations
7915                    .get_mut(lane)
7916                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
7917                plane,
7918                contribution.published_weight * contribution.published_normalization,
7919            )
7920        } else {
7921            accumulate_compensated(
7922                &mut self.channel_major_published_sum_weights,
7923                &mut self.channel_major_published_sum_weight_compensations,
7924                plane,
7925                contribution.published_weight * contribution.published_normalization,
7926            )
7927        }
7928    }
7929
7930    fn grid_aw_sensitivity(
7931        &mut self,
7932        moment: usize,
7933        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
7934        weight: f64,
7935    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7936        let plan = match taps {
7937            GridOperatorTaps::Aw {
7938                sensitivity: Some(plan),
7939                ..
7940            } => plan,
7941            GridOperatorTaps::Aw {
7942                sensitivity: None, ..
7943            } => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch),
7944            GridOperatorTaps::Standard(_) | GridOperatorTaps::Mosaic { .. } => return Ok(()),
7945        };
7946        let grids = self
7947            .aw_sensitivity_grids
7948            .as_mut()
7949            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7950        let compensations = self
7951            .aw_sensitivity_compensations
7952            .as_mut()
7953            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7954        let grid = grids
7955            .get_mut(moment)
7956            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7957        let compensation = compensations
7958            .get_mut(moment)
7959            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7960        plan.grid_compensated(
7961            grid.as_slice_mut()
7962                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?,
7963            compensation
7964                .as_slice_mut()
7965                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?,
7966            Complex64::new(weight, 0.0),
7967        )
7968        .map_err(Into::into)
7969    }
7970
7971    fn accumulate_published_sum_weight(
7972        &mut self,
7973        moment: usize,
7974        weight: f64,
7975        normalization: f64,
7976        aw_publication_lane: Option<usize>,
7977    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
7978        if normalization == 0.0 {
7979            return Ok(());
7980        }
7981        if let Some(lane) = aw_publication_lane {
7982            let aw = self
7983                .aw_published_sum_weights
7984                .as_mut()
7985                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
7986            return accumulate_compensated(
7987                aw.normal
7988                    .get_mut(lane)
7989                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
7990                aw.normal_compensations
7991                    .get_mut(lane)
7992                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?,
7993                moment,
7994                weight * normalization,
7995            );
7996        }
7997        let sum = self
7998            .published_sum_weights
7999            .get_mut(moment)
8000            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8001        let compensation = self
8002            .published_sum_weight_compensations
8003            .get_mut(moment)
8004            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8005        let corrected = weight * normalization - *compensation;
8006        let updated = *sum + corrected;
8007        *compensation = (updated - *sum) - corrected;
8008        *sum = updated;
8009        Ok(())
8010    }
8011
8012    fn aw_publication_lane(
8013        &self,
8014        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
8015    ) -> Result<Option<usize>, SpectralOperatorError> {
8016        if self.aw_projection.is_none() {
8017            return Ok(None);
8018        }
8019        match sample.mueller_element {
8020            0 => Ok(Some(0)),
8021            15 => Ok(Some(1)),
8022            _ => Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample),
8023        }
8024    }
8025
8026    fn finalize_aw_sum_weights(&mut self) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8027        let Some(aw) = self.aw_published_sum_weights.take() else {
8028            return Ok(());
8029        };
8030        let direct_aw_taylor = matches!(
8031            self.basis,
8032            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) if plan.coefficient_term_count() > 1
8033        );
8034        if aw.normal[0].len() != self.published_sum_weights.len()
8035            || aw.normal[1].len() != self.published_sum_weights.len()
8036            || aw.channel_major[0].len() != self.channel_major_published_sum_weights.len()
8037            || aw.channel_major[1].len() != self.channel_major_published_sum_weights.len()
8038        {
8039            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
8040        }
8041        for (moment, (destination, (first, last))) in self
8042            .published_sum_weights
8043            .iter_mut()
8044            .zip(aw.normal[0].iter().zip(&aw.normal[1]))
8045            .enumerate()
8046        {
8047            *destination = if direct_aw_taylor {
8048                first + last
8049            } else {
8050                first.min(*last)
8051            };
8052            if imaging_science_trace_enabled() {
8053                if direct_aw_taylor {
8054                    eprintln!(
8055                        "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=aw_cfs_sumwt term={moment} rr={first:.17e} ll={last:.17e} cfs_stokes_i={destination:.17e}"
8056                    );
8057                } else {
8058                    eprintln!(
8059                        "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=aw_published_sumwt term={moment} rr={first:.17e} ll={last:.17e} stokes_i={destination:.17e}"
8060                    );
8061                }
8062            }
8063        }
8064        self.published_sum_weight_compensations.fill(0.0);
8065        for (destination, (first, last)) in self
8066            .channel_major_published_sum_weights
8067            .iter_mut()
8068            .zip(aw.channel_major[0].iter().zip(&aw.channel_major[1]))
8069        {
8070            *destination = first.min(*last);
8071        }
8072        self.channel_major_published_sum_weight_compensations
8073            .fill(0.0);
8074        if let SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) = self.basis
8075            && direct_aw_taylor
8076        {
8077            let coefficient_terms = plan.coefficient_term_count();
8078            for moment in 0..plan.normal_moment_count() {
8079                for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
8080                    let plane = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
8081                    if moment >= coefficient_terms {
8082                        self.published_sum_weights[plane] = self.sum_weights[plane];
8083                    }
8084                }
8085            }
8086            self.published_sum_weight_compensations.fill(0.0);
8087        }
8088        Ok(())
8089    }
8090
8091    fn prepare_primary_beam_replay(
8092        &mut self,
8093        prior: &ReusableNormalState,
8094    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8095        if !self.requires_primary_beam_replay() {
8096            self.primary_beam_replay = None;
8097            return Ok(());
8098        }
8099        let specification = self
8100            .specification
8101            .as_ref()
8102            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
8103        let domain = specification
8104            .domains
8105            .get(self.domain_ordinal)
8106            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
8107        if !prior.matches(specification, self.domain_ordinal, domain.image_shape) {
8108            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
8109        }
8110        let source = prior
8111            .primary_beam_weighted_sum
8112            .as_deref()
8113            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
8114        let parent_cells = checked_cells(prior.shape)?;
8115        let local_cells = checked_cells(self.geometry.image_shape)?;
8116        if source.len() != parent_cells * self.polarization_count
8117            || prior.sum_weights.len() < self.polarization_count
8118        {
8119            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
8120        }
8121        let origin = self.window.map_or([0, 0], FacetWindow::origin);
8122        let mut weighted_sum = vec![0.0; local_cells * self.polarization_count];
8123        for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
8124            for x in 0..self.geometry.image_shape[0] {
8125                for y in 0..self.geometry.image_shape[1] {
8126                    let parent = polarization * parent_cells
8127                        + (origin[0] + x) * prior.shape[1]
8128                        + origin[1]
8129                        + y;
8130                    let local = polarization * local_cells + x * self.geometry.image_shape[1] + y;
8131                    weighted_sum[local] = source[parent];
8132                }
8133            }
8134        }
8135        self.primary_beam_replay = Some(PrimaryBeamReplayState {
8136            weighted_sum: weighted_sum.into_boxed_slice(),
8137            sum_weights: prior.sum_weights[..self.polarization_count].into(),
8138        });
8139        Ok(())
8140    }
8141
8142    fn requires_primary_beam_replay(&self) -> bool {
8143        self.primary_beam.is_some() && self.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some()
8144    }
8145
8146    fn prepare_bound_residual_model(
8147        &mut self,
8148        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8149        reused_normal_state: Option<ReusableNormalState>,
8150    ) -> Result<ReconstructionModelBinding, SpectralOperatorError> {
8151        let binding = self.bind_residual_model(generation, reused_normal_state)?;
8152        if !binding.is_evaluated() {
8153            return Ok(binding);
8154        }
8155        let grid_shape = (self.geometry.grid_shape[0], self.geometry.grid_shape[1]);
8156        let coefficient_terms = self
8157            .basis
8158            .major_coefficient_planes(self.slab)
8159            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
8160            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
8161        self.residual_grids = Some(
8162            (0..coefficient_terms)
8163                .map(|_| Array2::zeros(grid_shape))
8164                .collect(),
8165        );
8166        self.residual_compensations = Some(
8167            (0..coefficient_terms)
8168                .map(|_| Array2::zeros(grid_shape))
8169                .collect(),
8170        );
8171        if matches!(self.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
8172            self.common_residual_grids = Some(
8173                (0..self.slab.total_channels() * self.polarization_count)
8174                    .map(|_| Array2::zeros(grid_shape))
8175                    .collect(),
8176            );
8177            self.common_residual_compensations = Some(
8178                (0..self.slab.total_channels() * self.polarization_count)
8179                    .map(|_| Array2::zeros(grid_shape))
8180                    .collect(),
8181            );
8182        }
8183        Ok(binding)
8184    }
8185
8186    /// Bind a gridded replay model while sector owners hold residual accumulators.
8187    pub(crate) fn prepare_gridded_normal_model(
8188        &mut self,
8189        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8190        prior: &ReusableNormalState,
8191    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8192        self.prepare_primary_beam_replay(prior)?;
8193        if !self.bind_residual_model(generation, None)?.is_evaluated() {
8194            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
8195        }
8196        Ok(())
8197    }
8198
8199    fn bind_residual_model(
8200        &mut self,
8201        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8202        reused_normal_state: Option<ReusableNormalState>,
8203    ) -> Result<ReconstructionModelBinding, SpectralOperatorError> {
8204        self.validate_model_generation(generation)?;
8205        if self.specification.as_ref().is_some_and(|specification| {
8206            specification.is_initial_certified_zero(self.workload.pass)
8207        }) && !matches!(generation.origin(), ModelGenerationOrigin::Empty)
8208        {
8209            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ModelMismatch);
8210        }
8211        match (self.workload.pass, reused_normal_state.as_ref()) {
8212            (SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor, None) => {}
8213            (SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh, None) => {}
8214            (SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh, Some(state))
8215                if self.specification.as_ref().is_some_and(|specification| {
8216                    state.matches(
8217                        specification,
8218                        self.domain_ordinal,
8219                        self.geometry.image_shape,
8220                    )
8221                }) => {}
8222            _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch),
8223        }
8224        self.reused_normal_state = reused_normal_state;
8225        let binding = reconstruction_model_binding(
8226            self.workload.pass,
8227            generation.generation_id(),
8228            generation.origin(),
8229        );
8230        if binding.is_evaluated() {
8231            self.prepare_forward_generation(generation)?;
8232        }
8233        Ok(binding)
8234    }
8235
8236    fn prepare_selected_output_model(
8237        &mut self,
8238        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8239    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8240        self.validate_model_generation(generation)?;
8241        self.reused_normal_state = None;
8242        self.prepare_forward_generation(generation)
8243    }
8244
8245    fn validate_model_generation(
8246        &self,
8247        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8248    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8249        let shape = generation.shape();
8250        if shape.domains().len()
8251            != self
8252                .specification
8253                .as_ref()
8254                .map_or(1, |specification| specification.domain_count())
8255            || shape.coefficients() != self.basis.total_model_terms(self.slab)
8256            || shape.polarizations() != self.polarization_count
8257            || shape
8258                .domains()
8259                .get(self.domain_ordinal)
8260                .is_none_or(|domain| {
8261                    self.specification.as_ref().is_some_and(|specification| {
8262                        domain.pixels() != specification.domains[self.domain_ordinal].image_shape
8263                    })
8264                })
8265            || generation.samples().len() != shape.sample_count()
8266        {
8267            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ModelShape);
8268        }
8269        Ok(())
8270    }
8271
8272    fn prepare_forward_generation(
8273        &mut self,
8274        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8275    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8276        if self.primary_beam.is_some() && self.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
8277            return self.prepare_primary_beam_forward_generation(generation);
8278        }
8279        let width = self.geometry.image_shape[0];
8280        let height = self.geometry.image_shape[1];
8281        let origin = self.window.map_or([0, 0], FacetWindow::origin);
8282        let coefficient_range = match self.basis {
8283            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => self.slab.resident_range(),
8284            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan)
8285            | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => 0..plan.coefficient_term_count(),
8286            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
8287                continuum,
8288                line_terms,
8289            } => 0..continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms,
8290        };
8291        let mosaic = self.mosaic_normal.is_some();
8292        let aw_projection = self.aw_projection.is_some();
8293        let specification = self.specification.as_deref();
8294        let domain_ordinal = self.domain_ordinal;
8295        for (resident, coefficient) in coefficient_range.enumerate() {
8296            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
8297                let plane = self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization);
8298                let grid = &mut self.forward_grids[plane];
8299                grid.fill(Complex64::default());
8300                for y in 0..height {
8301                    for x in 0..width {
8302                        let index = generation
8303                            .shape()
8304                            .flat_index(casa_imaging_model::ModelCell::new(
8305                                self.domain_ordinal,
8306                                coefficient,
8307                                polarization,
8308                                [origin[0] + x, origin[1] + y],
8309                            ))
8310                            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ModelShape)?;
8311                        let sample = generation.samples()[index];
8312                        if sample.support() == ModelSupport::Invalid {
8313                            continue;
8314                        }
8315                        if pixel_has_later_domain_owner(
8316                            specification,
8317                            domain_ordinal,
8318                            [origin[0] + x, origin[1] + y],
8319                        )? {
8320                            continue;
8321                        }
8322                        let correction = if aw_projection {
8323                            1.0
8324                        } else if mosaic {
8325                            self.gridder
8326                                .sinc_image_correction(x, y, MOSAIC_OVERSAMPLING)
8327                        } else {
8328                            self.gridder.model_correction(x, y)
8329                        };
8330                        grid[(
8331                            self.geometry.image_blc[0] + x,
8332                            self.geometry.image_blc[1] + y,
8333                        )] = Complex64::new(sample.value().value(), 0.0) * correction;
8334                    }
8335                }
8336                self.fft.transform(grid, false);
8337                #[cfg(test)]
8338                record_measurement(&mut self.measurements.forward_fft_planes, 1);
8339            }
8340        }
8341        if self
8342            .forward_grids
8343            .iter()
8344            .flatten()
8345            .any(|value| !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite())
8346        {
8347            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
8348        }
8349        Ok(())
8350    }
8351
8352    fn prepare_primary_beam_forward_generation(
8353        &mut self,
8354        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8355    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8356        let response = self
8357            .primary_beam
8358            .clone()
8359            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
8360        let plan = self
8361            .basis
8362            .channel_major_taylor()
8363            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
8364        let replay = self
8365            .primary_beam_replay
8366            .as_ref()
8367            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
8368        let primary_beam_weighted_sum = &replay.weighted_sum;
8369        let width = self.geometry.image_shape[0];
8370        let height = self.geometry.image_shape[1];
8371        let cells = checked_cells(self.geometry.image_shape)?;
8372        if primary_beam_weighted_sum.len() != cells * self.polarization_count
8373            || self.forward_grids.len() != self.slab.resident_depth() * self.polarization_count
8374        {
8375            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
8376        }
8377        if imaging_science_trace_enabled() {
8378            self.trace_primary_beam_forward_generation(generation, &response, plan, replay)?;
8379        }
8380        let origin = self.window.map_or([0, 0], FacetWindow::origin);
8381        let mut primary_beam_plane = vec![0.0; cells];
8382        let mut basis = vec![0.0; plan.coefficient_term_count()];
8383        let mosaic = self.mosaic_normal.is_some();
8384        let aw_projection = self.aw_projection.is_some();
8385        for (resident, output_channel) in self.slab.resident_range().enumerate() {
8386            let frequency = *self
8387                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
8388                .get(output_channel)
8389                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8390            response.fill_power_plane_into(frequency, &mut primary_beam_plane)?;
8391            plan.fill_coefficient_basis(frequency, &mut basis)
8392                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8393            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
8394                let plane = self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization);
8395                let grid = &mut self.forward_grids[plane];
8396                grid.fill(Complex64::default());
8397                let total_weight = replay.sum_weights[polarization];
8398                let response_start = polarization * cells;
8399                for x in 0..width {
8400                    for y in 0..height {
8401                        let cell = x * height + y;
8402                        let denominator = primary_beam_weighted_sum[response_start + cell];
8403                        let channel_response = f64::from(primary_beam_plane[cell]);
8404                        if denominator <= 0.0 || channel_response <= 0.0 {
8405                            continue;
8406                        }
8407                        let mut value = 0.0;
8408                        for (coefficient, basis) in basis.iter().copied().enumerate() {
8409                            let index = generation
8410                                .shape()
8411                                .flat_index(casa_imaging_model::ModelCell::new(
8412                                    self.domain_ordinal,
8413                                    coefficient,
8414                                    polarization,
8415                                    [origin[0] + x, origin[1] + y],
8416                                ))
8417                                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ModelShape)?;
8418                            let sample = generation.samples()[index];
8419                            if sample.support() != ModelSupport::Invalid {
8420                                value += sample.value().value() * basis;
8421                            }
8422                        }
8423                        let staged = value * channel_response * total_weight / denominator;
8424                        let correction = if aw_projection {
8425                            1.0
8426                        } else if mosaic {
8427                            self.gridder
8428                                .sinc_image_correction(x, y, MOSAIC_OVERSAMPLING)
8429                        } else {
8430                            self.gridder.model_correction(x, y)
8431                        };
8432                        grid[(
8433                            self.geometry.image_blc[0] + x,
8434                            self.geometry.image_blc[1] + y,
8435                        )] = Complex64::new(staged, 0.0) * correction;
8436                    }
8437                }
8438                self.fft.transform(grid, false);
8439                #[cfg(test)]
8440                record_measurement(&mut self.measurements.forward_fft_planes, 1);
8441            }
8442        }
8443        if self
8444            .forward_grids
8445            .iter()
8446            .flatten()
8447            .any(|value| !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite())
8448        {
8449            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
8450        }
8451        Ok(())
8452    }
8453
8454    fn trace_primary_beam_forward_generation(
8455        &self,
8456        generation: &ModelGeneration,
8457        response: &PreparedPrimaryBeamPower,
8458        plan: BlockNormalPlan,
8459        replay: &PrimaryBeamReplayState,
8460    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8461        let width = self.geometry.image_shape[0];
8462        let height = self.geometry.image_shape[1];
8463        let cells = checked_cells(self.geometry.image_shape)?;
8464        let origin = self.window.map_or([0, 0], FacetWindow::origin);
8465        let mut primary_beam_plane = vec![0.0; cells];
8466        let mut basis = vec![0.0; plan.coefficient_term_count()];
8467        let mut before = ScienceTraceDigest::new();
8468        let mut after = ScienceTraceDigest::new();
8469        for output_channel in self.slab.resident_range() {
8470            let frequency = *self
8471                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
8472                .get(output_channel)
8473                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8474            response.fill_power_plane_into(frequency, &mut primary_beam_plane)?;
8475            plan.fill_coefficient_basis(frequency, &mut basis)
8476                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8477            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
8478                let total_weight = replay.sum_weights[polarization];
8479                let response_start = polarization * cells;
8480                for x in 0..width {
8481                    for y in 0..height {
8482                        let cell = x * height + y;
8483                        let mut value = 0.0;
8484                        for (coefficient, basis) in basis.iter().copied().enumerate() {
8485                            let index = generation
8486                                .shape()
8487                                .flat_index(casa_imaging_model::ModelCell::new(
8488                                    self.domain_ordinal,
8489                                    coefficient,
8490                                    polarization,
8491                                    [origin[0] + x, origin[1] + y],
8492                                ))
8493                                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ModelShape)?;
8494                            let sample = generation.samples()[index];
8495                            if sample.support() != ModelSupport::Invalid {
8496                                value += sample.value().value() * basis;
8497                            }
8498                        }
8499                        let denominator = replay.weighted_sum[response_start + cell];
8500                        let channel_response = f64::from(primary_beam_plane[cell]);
8501                        let staged = if denominator > 0.0 && channel_response > 0.0 {
8502                            value * channel_response * total_weight / denominator
8503                        } else {
8504                            0.0
8505                        };
8506                        before.push_real(value);
8507                        after.push_real(staged);
8508                    }
8509                }
8510            }
8511        }
8512        before.emit("channel_model_before_pbc_pbbar");
8513        after.emit("channel_model_after_pbc_pbbar");
8514        Ok(())
8515    }
8516
8517    #[cfg(test)]
8518    fn push_with_residual(
8519        &mut self,
8520        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
8521        predicted: Complex64,
8522    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8523        self.push_with_residual_polarization(sample, predicted, 0)
8524    }
8525
8526    fn push_with_residual_polarization(
8527        &mut self,
8528        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
8529        predicted: Complex64,
8530        polarization: usize,
8531    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8532        if polarization >= self.polarization_count {
8533            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
8534        }
8535        let channel_plane = self.slab.core_index(sample.output_channel);
8536        match self.basis {
8537            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
8538                let Some(plane) = channel_plane else {
8539                    return Ok(());
8540                };
8541                let plane = self.polarization_plane(plane, polarization);
8542                self.mapped_samples[plane] = self.mapped_samples[plane]
8543                    .checked_add(1)
8544                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
8545            }
8546            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_) | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => {
8547                if channel_plane.is_none() {
8548                    return Ok(());
8549                }
8550                for mapped in self
8551                    .mapped_samples
8552                    .iter_mut()
8553                    .skip(polarization)
8554                    .step_by(self.polarization_count)
8555                {
8556                    *mapped = mapped
8557                        .checked_add(1)
8558                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
8559                }
8560            }
8561            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
8562                if self
8563                    .mapped_samples
8564                    .get(self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization))
8565                    .is_none()
8566                {
8567                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
8568                }
8569            }
8570        }
8571        if sample.imaging_weight == 0.0 {
8572            return Ok(());
8573        }
8574        let Some(taps) = self.operator_taps(sample, false)? else {
8575            return Ok(());
8576        };
8577        let taps = self.prepare_grid_taps(taps, self.psf_grids.is_some())?;
8578        let normal_normalization = taps.normal_normalization(&self.gridder)?;
8579        let published_normalization = taps.imaging_normalization(&self.gridder)?;
8580        let aw_publication_lane = self.aw_publication_lane(sample)?;
8581        let factor = sample.spectral_factor;
8582        let observed_scale = sample.visibility * sample.phase() * (sample.imaging_weight * factor);
8583        let residual_scale =
8584            (sample.visibility - predicted) * sample.phase() * (sample.imaging_weight * factor);
8585        match self.basis {
8586            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
8587                let plane = self.polarization_plane(
8588                    channel_plane.expect("mapped channel-local sample has a core plane"),
8589                    polarization,
8590                );
8591                if self.dirty_grids.is_some() {
8592                    self.grid_dirty_term(plane, &taps, observed_scale)?;
8593                }
8594                self.grid_residual_term(plane, &taps, residual_scale)?;
8595                if self.psf_grids.is_some() {
8596                    self.grid_normal_moment(
8597                        plane,
8598                        &taps,
8599                        sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor,
8600                        normal_normalization,
8601                    )?;
8602                    self.accumulate_published_sum_weight(
8603                        plane,
8604                        sample.published_weight * factor * factor,
8605                        published_normalization,
8606                        aw_publication_lane,
8607                    )?;
8608                }
8609            }
8610            SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => {
8611                let plane = self.polarization_plane(
8612                    channel_plane.expect("mapped channel-major sample has a core plane"),
8613                    polarization,
8614                );
8615                if self.dirty_grids.is_some() {
8616                    self.grid_dirty_term(plane, &taps, observed_scale)?;
8617                }
8618                self.grid_residual_term(plane, &taps, residual_scale)?;
8619                if self.psf_grids.is_some() {
8620                    self.grid_channel_major_normal(
8621                        plane,
8622                        &taps,
8623                        &ChannelMajorNormalContribution {
8624                            imaging_weight: sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor,
8625                            normal_normalization,
8626                            published_weight: sample.published_weight * factor * factor,
8627                            published_normalization,
8628                            aw_publication_lane,
8629                        },
8630                    )?;
8631                }
8632            }
8633            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) => {
8634                plan.fill_weighted_coefficient_basis(
8635                    sample.frequency_hz,
8636                    sample.imaging_weight * factor,
8637                    &mut self.coefficient_basis,
8638                )
8639                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8640                let polynomial_observed_scale = sample.visibility * sample.phase();
8641                let polynomial_residual_scale = (sample.visibility - predicted) * sample.phase();
8642                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
8643                    let coefficient = self.coefficient_basis[term];
8644                    let plane = self.polarization_plane(term, polarization);
8645                    if self.dirty_grids.is_some() {
8646                        self.grid_dirty_term(
8647                            plane,
8648                            &taps,
8649                            polynomial_observed_scale * coefficient,
8650                        )?;
8651                    }
8652                    self.grid_residual_term(plane, &taps, polynomial_residual_scale * coefficient)?;
8653                }
8654                if self.psf_grids.is_some() {
8655                    plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(
8656                        sample.frequency_hz,
8657                        sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor,
8658                        &mut self.normal_moment_weights,
8659                    )
8660                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8661                    for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
8662                        let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
8663                        let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
8664                        self.grid_normal_moment(moment, &taps, weight, normal_normalization)?;
8665                    }
8666                    plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(
8667                        sample.frequency_hz,
8668                        sample.published_weight * factor * factor,
8669                        &mut self.normal_moment_weights,
8670                    )
8671                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8672                    for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
8673                        let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
8674                        let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
8675                        self.accumulate_published_sum_weight(
8676                            moment,
8677                            weight,
8678                            published_normalization,
8679                            aw_publication_lane,
8680                        )?;
8681                    }
8682                }
8683            }
8684            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
8685                let mapped_index = self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization);
8686                let mapped = self
8687                    .mapped_samples
8688                    .get_mut(mapped_index)
8689                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8690                *mapped = mapped
8691                    .checked_add(1)
8692                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::CoverageOverflow)?;
8693                if self.psf_grids.is_some() && normal_normalization > 0.0 {
8694                    let channel = self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization);
8695                    let corrected = sample.imaging_weight * normal_normalization
8696                        - self.channel_sum_weight_compensations[channel];
8697                    let updated = self.channel_sum_weights[channel] + corrected;
8698                    self.channel_sum_weight_compensations[channel] =
8699                        (updated - self.channel_sum_weights[channel]) - corrected;
8700                    self.channel_sum_weights[channel] = updated;
8701                }
8702                self.fill_joint_coefficient_basis(sample.frequency_hz, sample.output_channel)?;
8703                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
8704                    let coefficient = self.coefficient_basis[term];
8705                    let plane = self.polarization_plane(term, polarization);
8706                    if self.dirty_grids.is_some() {
8707                        self.grid_dirty_term(plane, &taps, observed_scale * coefficient)?;
8708                    }
8709                    self.grid_residual_term(plane, &taps, residual_scale * coefficient)?;
8710                }
8711                self.grid_common_residual_term(
8712                    self.polarization_plane(sample.output_channel, polarization),
8713                    &taps,
8714                    residual_scale,
8715                )?;
8716                if self.psf_grids.is_some() {
8717                    self.fill_joint_normal_weights(sample.imaging_weight * factor * factor)?;
8718                    for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
8719                        let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
8720                        let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
8721                        self.grid_normal_moment(moment, &taps, weight, normal_normalization)?;
8722                    }
8723                    self.fill_joint_normal_weights(sample.published_weight * factor * factor)?;
8724                    for moment in 0..self.normal_moment_weights.len() {
8725                        let weight = self.normal_moment_weights[moment];
8726                        let moment = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
8727                        self.accumulate_published_sum_weight(
8728                            moment,
8729                            weight,
8730                            published_normalization,
8731                            aw_publication_lane,
8732                        )?;
8733                    }
8734                }
8735            }
8736        }
8737        Ok(())
8738    }
8739
8740    fn grid_residual_term(
8741        &mut self,
8742        plane: usize,
8743        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
8744        value: Complex64,
8745    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8746        let grid = &mut self
8747            .residual_grids
8748            .as_mut()
8749            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?[plane];
8750        let compensation = &mut self
8751            .residual_compensations
8752            .as_mut()
8753            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?[plane];
8754        grid_operator_compensated(
8755            &self.gridder,
8756            &self.mosaic_projectors,
8757            CompensatedGrid {
8758                values: grid,
8759                errors: compensation,
8760            },
8761            taps,
8762            GridAccumulationRole::Imaging,
8763            value,
8764        )?;
8765        #[cfg(test)]
8766        record_measurement(
8767            &mut self.measurements.residual_grid_tap_visits,
8768            TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE,
8769        );
8770        Ok(())
8771    }
8772
8773    fn grid_common_residual_term(
8774        &mut self,
8775        output_channel: usize,
8776        taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
8777        value: Complex64,
8778    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8779        let grid = &mut self
8780            .common_residual_grids
8781            .as_mut()
8782            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?[output_channel];
8783        let compensation = &mut self
8784            .common_residual_compensations
8785            .as_mut()
8786            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?[output_channel];
8787        grid_operator_compensated(
8788            &self.gridder,
8789            &self.mosaic_projectors,
8790            CompensatedGrid {
8791                values: grid,
8792                errors: compensation,
8793            },
8794            taps,
8795            GridAccumulationRole::Imaging,
8796            value,
8797        )?;
8798        Ok(())
8799    }

8801    fn validate_reused_lineage(
8802        &self,
8803        weighting_generation: WeightingGenerationId,
8804        selected_generation: SelectedObservationGenerationId,
8805        continuum_transform_generation: Option<ContinuumTransformGenerationId>,
8806    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8807        match (self.workload.pass, self.reused_normal_state.as_ref()) {
8808            (SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor, None) => Ok(()),
8809            (SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh, None) => Ok(()),
8810            (SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh, Some(state))
8811                if state.matches_replay(
8812                    weighting_generation,
8813                    selected_generation,
8814                    continuum_transform_generation,
8815                ) =>
8816            {
8817                Ok(())
8818            }
8819            _ => Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch),
8820        }
8821    }
