8823    /// Predict unweighted selected visibilities with the paired forward operator.
8824    #[cfg(test)]
8825    fn predict(
8826        &mut self,
8827        model: &[Complex64],
8828        samples: &[SpectralOperatorSample],
8829    ) -> Result<Box<[Complex64]>, SpectralOperatorError> {
8830        self.prepare_prediction_grid(model)?;
8831        samples
8832            .iter()
8833            .map(|sample| self.predict_one(*sample))
8834            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
8835            .map(Vec::into_boxed_slice)
8836    }
8837
8838    fn prepare_prediction_grid(
8839        &mut self,
8840        model: &[Complex64],
8841    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
8842        let cells = checked_cells(self.geometry.image_shape)?;
8843        if model.len()
8844            != cells
8845                .checked_mul(self.basis.total_model_terms(self.slab))
8846                .and_then(|samples| samples.checked_mul(self.polarization_count))
8847                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?
8848        {
8849            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ModelShape);
8850        }
8851        let coefficient_range = match self.basis {
8852            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => self.slab.resident_range(),
8853            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan)
8854            | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => 0..plan.coefficient_term_count(),
8855            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
8856                continuum,
8857                line_terms,
8858            } => 0..continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms,
8859        };
8860        let mosaic = self.mosaic_normal.is_some();
8861        let aw_projection = self.aw_projection.is_some();
8862        for (resident, coefficient) in coefficient_range.enumerate() {
8863            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
8864                let plane = self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization);
8865                let grid = &mut self.forward_grids[plane];
8866                grid.fill(Complex64::default());
8867                for x in 0..self.geometry.image_shape[0] {
8868                    for y in 0..self.geometry.image_shape[1] {
8869                        let correction = if aw_projection {
8870                            1.0
8871                        } else if mosaic {
8872                            self.gridder
8873                                .sinc_image_correction(x, y, MOSAIC_OVERSAMPLING)
8874                        } else {
8875                            self.gridder.model_correction(x, y)
8876                        };
8877                        grid[(
8878                            self.geometry.image_blc[0] + x,
8879                            self.geometry.image_blc[1] + y,
8880                        )] = model[(coefficient * self.polarization_count + polarization) * cells
8881                            + x * self.geometry.image_shape[1]
8882                            + y]
8883                            * correction;
8884                    }
8885                }
8886                self.fft.transform(grid, false);
8887                #[cfg(test)]
8888                record_measurement(&mut self.measurements.forward_fft_planes, 1);
8889            }
8890        }
8891        if self
8892            .forward_grids
8893            .iter()
8894            .flatten()
8895            .any(|value| !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite())
8896        {
8897            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
8898        }
8899        Ok(())
8900    }
8901
8902    #[cfg(test)]
8903    fn predict_one(
8904        &mut self,
8905        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
8906    ) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
8907        self.predict_one_polarization(sample, 0)
8908    }
8909
8910    fn predict_one_polarization(
8911        &mut self,
8912        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
8913        polarization: usize,
8914    ) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
8915        if polarization >= self.polarization_count {
8916            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample);
8917        }
8918        let Some(taps) = self.operator_taps(sample, true)? else {
8919            return Ok(Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0));
8920        };
8921        match self.basis {
8922            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
8923                let resident = self
8924                    .slab
8925                    .resident_index(sample.output_channel)
8926                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteSpectralHalo)?;
8927                self.predict_one_with_taps(
8928                    self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization),
8929                    sample,
8930                    taps,
8931                )
8932            }
8933            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) => {
8934                plan.fill_coefficient_basis(sample.frequency_hz, &mut self.coefficient_basis)
8935                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8936                let mut predicted = Complex64::default();
8937                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
8938                    let grid = &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)];
8939                    predicted += degrid_operator(
8940                        &self.gridder,
8941                        &self.aw_projection,
8942                        &self.mosaic_projectors,
8943                        grid,
8944                        taps,
8945                        None,
8946                    )? * self.coefficient_basis[term];
8947                }
8948                predicted = predicted * sample.phase().conj() * sample.spectral_factor;
8949                #[cfg(test)]
8950                record_measurement(
8951                    &mut self.measurements.prediction_degrid_tap_visits,
8952                    TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE
8953                        * u64::try_from(plan.coefficient_term_count())
8954                            .expect("coefficient count fits measurement"),
8955                );
8956                if predicted.re.is_finite() && predicted.im.is_finite() {
8957                    Ok(predicted)
8958                } else {
8959                    Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite)
8960                }
8961            }
8962            SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
8963                if self.primary_beam.is_some() {
8964                    let resident = self
8965                        .slab
8966                        .resident_index(sample.output_channel)
8967                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteSpectralHalo)?;
8968                    return self.predict_one_with_taps(
8969                        self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization),
8970                        sample,
8971                        taps,
8972                    );
8973                }
8974                let frequency_hz = *self
8975                    .output_channel_frequencies_hz
8976                    .get(sample.output_channel)
8977                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8978                plan.fill_coefficient_basis(frequency_hz, &mut self.coefficient_basis)
8979                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
8980                let mut predicted = Complex64::default();
8981                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
8982                    let grid = &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)];
8983                    predicted += degrid_operator(
8984                        &self.gridder,
8985                        &self.aw_projection,
8986                        &self.mosaic_projectors,
8987                        grid,
8988                        taps,
8989                        None,
8990                    )? * self.coefficient_basis[term];
8991                }
8992                predicted = predicted * sample.phase().conj() * sample.spectral_factor;
8993                #[cfg(test)]
8994                record_measurement(
8995                    &mut self.measurements.prediction_degrid_tap_visits,
8996                    TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE
8997                        * u64::try_from(plan.coefficient_term_count())
8998                            .expect("coefficient count fits measurement"),
8999                );
9000                if predicted.re.is_finite() && predicted.im.is_finite() {
9001                    Ok(predicted)
9002                } else {
9003                    Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite)
9004                }
9005            }
9006            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
9007                self.fill_joint_coefficient_basis(sample.frequency_hz, sample.output_channel)?;
9008                let mut predicted = Complex64::default();
9009                for term in 0..self.coefficient_basis.len() {
9010                    let grid = &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)];
9011                    predicted += degrid_operator(
9012                        &self.gridder,
9013                        &self.aw_projection,
9014                        &self.mosaic_projectors,
9015                        grid,
9016                        taps,
9017                        None,
9018                    )? * self.coefficient_basis[term];
9019                }
9020                predicted = predicted * sample.phase().conj() * sample.spectral_factor;
9021                if predicted.re.is_finite() && predicted.im.is_finite() {
9022                    Ok(predicted)
9023                } else {
9024                    Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite)
9025                }
9026            }
9027        }
9028    }
9029
9030    fn predict_one_with_taps(
9031        &mut self,
9032        resident: usize,
9033        sample: SpectralOperatorSample,
9034        taps: OperatorTaps,
9035    ) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
9036        let predicted = degrid_operator(
9037            &self.gridder,
9038            &self.aw_projection,
9039            &self.mosaic_projectors,
9040            &self.forward_grids[resident],
9041            taps,
9042            None,
9043        )? * sample.phase().conj()
9044            * sample.spectral_factor;
9045        #[cfg(test)]
9046        record_measurement(
9047            &mut self.measurements.prediction_degrid_tap_visits,
9048            TAP_VISITS_PER_SAMPLE,
9049        );
9050        if predicted.re.is_finite() && predicted.im.is_finite() {
9051            Ok(predicted)
9052        } else {
9053            Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite)
9054        }
9055    }

9082    fn push_prediction_value(&mut self, predicted: Complex64) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9083        if self.prediction_len == self.predictions.len() {
9084            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::IncompleteCoverage);
9085        }
9086        self.predictions[self.prediction_len] = predicted;
9087        self.prediction_len += 1;
9088        Ok(())
9089    }
9090
9091    pub(crate) fn predict_gridded_normal_polarization(
9092        &self,
9093        output_channel: usize,
9094        polarization: usize,
9095        taps: SampleTaps,
9096        forward_scale: Complex64,
9097    ) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
9098        if polarization >= self.polarization_count {
9099            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9100        }
9101        if let SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
9102            continuum,
9103            line_terms,
9104        } = self.basis
9105        {
9106            let frequency = *self
9107                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9108                .get(output_channel)
9109                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9110            let x = continuum
9111                .normalized_frequency(frequency)
9112                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9113            let mut predicted = Complex64::default();
9114            for term in 0..continuum.coefficient_term_count() {
9115                predicted += self.gridder.degrid(
9116                    &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)],
9117                    taps,
9118                )? * x.powi(
9119                    i32::try_from(term)
9120                        .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?,
9121                );
9122            }
9123            if let Some(line) = self
9124                .joint_line_term_by_channel
9125                .get(output_channel)
9126                .copied()
9127                .flatten()
9128            {
9129                if line >= line_terms {
9130                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9131                }
9132                predicted += self.gridder.degrid(
9133                    &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(
9134                        continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line,
9135                        polarization,
9136                    )],
9137                    taps,
9138                )?;
9139            }
9140            predicted *= forward_scale;
9141            if !predicted.re.is_finite() || !predicted.im.is_finite() {
9142                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9143            }
9144            return Ok(predicted);
9145        }
9146        if let SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) = self.basis {
9147            if self.primary_beam.is_some() {
9148                let resident = self
9149                    .slab
9150                    .resident_index(output_channel)
9151                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9152                let predicted = self.gridder.degrid(
9153                    &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization)],
9154                    taps,
9155                )? * forward_scale;
9156                if !predicted.re.is_finite() || !predicted.im.is_finite() {
9157                    return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9158                }
9159                return Ok(predicted);
9160            }
9161            let frequency = *self
9162                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9163                .get(output_channel)
9164                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9165            let x = plan
9166                .normalized_frequency(frequency)
9167                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9168            let mut predicted = Complex64::default();
9169            for term in 0..plan.coefficient_term_count() {
9170                predicted += self.gridder.degrid(
9171                    &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)],
9172                    taps,
9173                )? * x.powi(
9174                    i32::try_from(term)
9175                        .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?,
9176                );
9177            }
9178            predicted *= forward_scale;
9179            if !predicted.re.is_finite() || !predicted.im.is_finite() {
9180                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9181            }
9182            return Ok(predicted);
9183        }
9184        let resident = self
9185            .slab
9186            .resident_index(output_channel)
9187            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9188        if !forward_scale.re.is_finite() || !forward_scale.im.is_finite() {
9189            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9190        }
9191        let predicted = self.gridder.degrid(
9192            &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization)],
9193            taps,
9194        )? * forward_scale;
9195        if !predicted.re.is_finite() || !predicted.im.is_finite() {
9196            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9197        }
9198        Ok(predicted)
9199    }
9200
9201    fn aw_visibility_sample(
9202        &self,
9203        coordinates: AwReplayCoordinates,
9204        tile_origin: [usize; 2],
9205        prediction: bool,
9206    ) -> Result<AwVisibilitySample, SpectralOperatorError> {
9207        if tile_origin[0] > self.geometry.grid_shape[0]
9208            || tile_origin[1] > self.geometry.grid_shape[1]
9209        {
9210            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9211        }
9212        let scale = coordinates.frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S;
9213        let uv_lambda = [coordinates.uvw_m[0] * scale, coordinates.uvw_m[1] * scale];
9214        let grid_position = [
9215            uv_lambda[0]
9216                * self.geometry.grid_shape[0] as f64
9217                * self.geometry.increment_rad[0].abs()
9218                + self.geometry.grid_shape[0] as f64 / 2.0
9219                - tile_origin[0] as f64,
9220            -uv_lambda[1]
9221                * self.geometry.grid_shape[1] as f64
9222                * self.geometry.increment_rad[1].abs()
9223                + self.geometry.grid_shape[1] as f64 / 2.0
9224                - tile_origin[1] as f64,
9225        ];
9226        let reference_frequency_hz = self
9227            .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9228            .get(self.output_channel_frequencies_hz.len() / 2)
9229            .copied()
9230            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9231        // CASA GridToData selects the CF from the MS W while DataToGrid uses
9232        // the transformed W. Both place the stencil with transformed UV.
9233        let w_m = if prediction {
9234            coordinates.prediction_w_m
9235        } else {
9236            coordinates.uvw_m[2]
9237        };
9238        AwVisibilitySample::new(
9239            coordinates.frequency_hz,
9240            reference_frequency_hz,
9241            w_m * scale,
9242            coordinates.mueller_element,
9243            coordinates.parallactic_angle_deg,
9244            grid_position,
9245            coordinates.pointing_phase_gradient_rad_per_grid_cell,
9246        )
9247        .map_err(Into::into)
9248    }
9249
9250    pub(crate) fn aw_gridded_grid_footprint(
9251        &self,
9252        coordinates: AwReplayCoordinates,
9253    ) -> Result<([usize; 2], usize), SpectralOperatorError> {
9254        let sample = self.aw_visibility_sample(coordinates, [0, 0], false)?;
9255        self.aw_projection
9256            .as_ref()
9257            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?
9258            .lock()
9259            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?
9260            .grid_footprint(self.geometry.grid_shape, sample)
9261            .map_err(Into::into)
9262    }
9263
9264    pub(crate) fn predict_gridded_normal_aw_polarization(
9265        &self,
9266        output_channel: usize,
9267        polarization: usize,
9268        coordinates: AwReplayCoordinates,
9269        forward_scale: Complex64,
9270    ) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
9271        if polarization >= self.polarization_count
9272            || !forward_scale.re.is_finite()
9273            || !forward_scale.im.is_finite()
9274        {
9275            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9276        }
9277        let mut prediction_coordinates = coordinates;
9278        if coordinates.uvw_m[2] <= 0.0 {
9279            prediction_coordinates.mueller_element = match coordinates.mueller_element {
9280                0 => 15,
9281                15 => 0,
9282                _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch),
9283            };
9284        }
9285        let sample = self.aw_visibility_sample(prediction_coordinates, [0, 0], true)?;
9286        let degrid = |grid: &Array2<Complex64>, replay_taylor_term| {
9287            degrid_operator(
9288                &self.gridder,
9289                &self.aw_projection,
9290                &self.mosaic_projectors,
9291                grid,
9292                OperatorTaps::Aw(sample),
9293                replay_taylor_term,
9294            )
9295        };
9296        let predicted = match self.basis {
9297            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => {
9298                let resident = self
9299                    .slab
9300                    .resident_index(output_channel)
9301                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9302                degrid(
9303                    &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization)],
9304                    None,
9305                )?
9306            }
9307            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(plan) => {
9308                let coefficients = plan
9309                    .weighted_coefficients(coordinates.frequency_hz, 1.0)
9310                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9311                let mut value = Complex64::default();
9312                for (term, coefficient) in coefficients.enumerate() {
9313                    value += degrid(
9314                        &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)],
9315                        Some(term),
9316                    )? * coefficient
9317                        .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9318                }
9319                value
9320            }
9321            SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(plan) => {
9322                if self.primary_beam.is_some() {
9323                    let resident = self
9324                        .slab
9325                        .resident_index(output_channel)
9326                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9327                    degrid(
9328                        &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(resident, polarization)],
9329                        None,
9330                    )?
9331                } else {
9332                    let frequency = *self
9333                        .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9334                        .get(output_channel)
9335                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9336                    let x = plan
9337                        .normalized_frequency(frequency)
9338                        .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9339                    let mut value = Complex64::default();
9340                    for term in 0..plan.coefficient_term_count() {
9341                        value += degrid(
9342                            &self.forward_grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)],
9343                            Some(term),
9344                        )? * x.powi(
9345                            i32::try_from(term)
9346                                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?,
9347                        );
9348                    }
9349                    value
9350                }
9351            }
9352            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => {
9353                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9354            }
9355        } * forward_scale;
9356        if !predicted.re.is_finite() || !predicted.im.is_finite() {
9357            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9358        }
9359        Ok(predicted)
9360    }
9361
9362    pub(crate) fn predict_gridded_block_normal(
9363        &self,
9364        taps: SampleTaps,
9365        moments: &[f64],
9366        model_values: &mut [Complex64],
9367        normal_values: &mut [Complex64],
9368    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9369        let plan = self
9370            .basis
9371            .polynomial()
9372            .filter(|plan| plan.coefficient_term_count() > 1)
9373            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9374        let terms = plan.coefficient_term_count();
9375        if moments.len() != plan.normal_moment_count()
9376            || model_values.len() != terms
9377            || normal_values.len() != terms
9378            || self.forward_grids.len() != terms
9379            || moments.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
9380        {
9381            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9382        }
9383        for (value, grid) in model_values.iter_mut().zip(&self.forward_grids) {
9384            *value = self.gridder.degrid(grid, taps)?;
9385        }
9386        for (row, output) in normal_values.iter_mut().enumerate() {
9387            let mut value = Complex64::default();
9388            for (column, model) in model_values.iter().copied().enumerate() {
9389                let moment = plan
9390                    .normal_moment_index(row, column)
9391                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9392                value += model * moments[moment];
9393            }
9394            if !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite() {
9395                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9396            }
9397            *output = value;
9398        }
9399        Ok(())
9400    }
9401
9402    pub(crate) fn grid_gridded_normal_local_polarization(
9403        &self,
9404        grids: &mut [Array2<Complex64>],
9405        compensations: &mut [Array2<Complex64>],
9406        contribution: GriddedNormalLocalContribution,
9407    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9408        let GriddedNormalLocalContribution {
9409            local_taps,
9410            output_channel,
9411            polarization,
9412            predicted,
9413            adjoint_scale,
9414        } = contribution;
9415        if polarization >= self.polarization_count {
9416            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9417        }
9418        if let SpectralBasisPlan::Joint {
9419            continuum,
9420            line_terms,
9421        } = self.basis
9422        {
9423            let terms = continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line_terms;
9424            let accumulation_terms = terms
9425                .checked_add(self.slab.total_channels())
9426                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9427            let accumulation_planes = accumulation_terms
9428                .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9429                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9430            if grids.len() != accumulation_planes || compensations.len() != accumulation_planes {
9431                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9432            }
9433            let frequency = *self
9434                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9435                .get(output_channel)
9436                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9437            let x = continuum
9438                .normalized_frequency(frequency)
9439                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9440            let gridded = predicted * adjoint_scale;
9441            for term in 0..continuum.coefficient_term_count() {
9442                let value = gridded
9443                    * x.powi(
9444                        i32::try_from(term)
9445                            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?,
9446                    );
9447                self.gridder.grid_compensated(
9448                    &mut grids[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)],
9449                    &mut compensations[self.polarization_plane(term, polarization)],
9450                    local_taps,
9451                    value,
9452                )?;
9453            }
9454            if let Some(line) = self
9455                .joint_line_term_by_channel
9456                .get(output_channel)
9457                .copied()
9458                .flatten()
9459            {
9460                let term = continuum.coefficient_term_count() + line;
9461                let term = self.polarization_plane(term, polarization);
9462                self.gridder.grid_compensated(
9463                    &mut grids[term],
9464                    &mut compensations[term],
9465                    local_taps,
9466                    gridded,
9467                )?;
9468            }
9469            let common_plane = terms
9470                .checked_add(output_channel)
9471                .map(|plane| self.polarization_plane(plane, polarization))
9472                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9473            self.gridder.grid_compensated(
9474                &mut grids[common_plane],
9475                &mut compensations[common_plane],
9476                local_taps,
9477                gridded,
9478            )?;
9479            return Ok(());
9480        }
9481        let plane = self
9482            .slab
9483            .core_index(output_channel)
9484            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9485        let plane = self.polarization_plane(plane, polarization);
9486        let expected = self
9487            .slab
9488            .core_depth()
9489            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9490            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9491        if grids.len() != expected || compensations.len() != expected {
9492            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9493        }
9494        let gridded = predicted * adjoint_scale;
9495        if !gridded.re.is_finite() || !gridded.im.is_finite() {
9496            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9497        }
9498        self.gridder.grid_compensated(
9499            &mut grids[plane],
9500            &mut compensations[plane],
9501            local_taps,
9502            gridded,
9503        )?;
9504        Ok(())
9505    }
9506
9507    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
9508    pub(crate) fn grid_gridded_normal_local_aw_polarization(
9509        &self,
9510        grids: &mut [Array2<Complex64>],
9511        compensations: &mut [Array2<Complex64>],
9512        tile_origin: [usize; 2],
9513        output_channel: usize,
9514        polarization: usize,
9515        predicted: Complex64,
9516        adjoint_scale: Complex64,
9517        imaging_weight: f64,
9518        coordinates: AwReplayCoordinates,
9519    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9520        if polarization >= self.polarization_count
9521            || matches!(self.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. })
9522        {
9523            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9524        }
9525        let expected = self
9526            .basis
9527            .major_coefficient_planes(self.slab)
9528            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9529            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9530        if grids.len() != expected || compensations.len() != expected {
9531            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9532        }
9533        let sample = self.aw_visibility_sample(coordinates, tile_origin, false)?;
9534        let shape = [grids[0].nrows(), grids[0].ncols()];
9535        let plan = self
9536            .aw_projection
9537            .as_ref()
9538            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?
9539            .lock()
9540            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?
9541            .prepare_imaging_grid(shape, sample)?;
9542        let mut grid_term = |term: usize, coefficient: f64| -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9543            let plane = self.polarization_plane(term, polarization);
9544            let gridded = predicted * (adjoint_scale * coefficient);
9545            if !gridded.re.is_finite() || !gridded.im.is_finite() {
9546                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9547            }
9548            let grid = grids[plane]
9549                .as_slice_mut()
9550                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9551            let compensation = compensations[plane]
9552                .as_slice_mut()
9553                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9554            plan.grid_compensated(grid, compensation, gridded)
9555                .map_err(Into::into)
9556        };
9557        match self.basis {
9558            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(basis) => {
9559                for (term, coefficient) in basis
9560                    .weighted_coefficients(coordinates.frequency_hz, imaging_weight)
9561                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?
9562                    .enumerate()
9563                {
9564                    grid_term(
9565                        term,
9566                        coefficient.map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?,
9567                    )?;
9568                }
9569                Ok(())
9570            }
9571            _ => {
9572                let term = self
9573                    .slab
9574                    .core_index(output_channel)
9575                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9576                grid_term(term, imaging_weight)
9577            }
9578        }
9579    }
9580
9581    pub(crate) fn grid_gridded_block_normal_local(
9582        &self,
9583        grids: &mut [Array2<Complex64>],
9584        compensations: &mut [Array2<Complex64>],
9585        local_taps: SampleTaps,
9586        normal_values: &[Complex64],
9587    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9588        let terms = self
9589            .basis
9590            .polynomial()
9591            .filter(|plan| plan.coefficient_term_count() > 1)
9592            .map(BlockNormalPlan::coefficient_term_count)
9593            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch)?;
9594        if grids.len() != terms || compensations.len() != terms || normal_values.len() != terms {
9595            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9596        }
9597        for plane in 0..terms {
9598            let value = normal_values[plane];
9599            if !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite() {
9600                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
9601            }
9602            self.gridder.grid_compensated(
9603                &mut grids[plane],
9604                &mut compensations[plane],
9605                local_taps,
9606                value,
9607            )?;
9608        }
9609        Ok(())
9610    }
9611
9612    fn fold_channel_major_values(
9613        &self,
9614        channel_values: &[Complex64],
9615        normal_moments: bool,
9616    ) -> Result<Vec<Complex64>, SpectralOperatorError> {
9617        let plan = self
9618            .basis
9619            .channel_major_taylor()
9620            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9621        let cells = checked_cells(self.geometry.image_shape)?;
9622        let channel_planes = self
9623            .slab
9624            .core_depth()
9625            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9626            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9627        if channel_values.len()
9628            != channel_planes
9629                .checked_mul(cells)
9630                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?
9631        {
9632            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
9633        }
9634        let output_terms = if normal_moments {
9635            plan.normal_moment_count()
9636        } else {
9637            plan.coefficient_term_count()
9638        };
9639        let output_len = output_terms
9640            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9641            .and_then(|planes| planes.checked_mul(cells))
9642            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9643        let mut output = vec![Complex64::default(); output_len];
9644        let mut compensation = vec![Complex64::default(); output_len];
9645        let mut powers = vec![0.0; output_terms];
9646        // CASA removes PBc/PBbar before residual Taylor folding and reapplies it
9647        // while forming the Taylor sum. The response amplitude therefore
9648        // cancels from coefficient families, but its cutoff support remains.
9649        let mut primary_beam_plane = self.primary_beam.as_ref().map(|_| vec![0.0; cells]);
9650        for (local_channel, output_channel) in self.slab.core_range().enumerate() {
9651            let frequency = *self
9652                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9653                .get(output_channel)
9654                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9655            if normal_moments {
9656                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(frequency, 1.0, &mut powers)
9657            } else {
9658                plan.fill_coefficient_basis(frequency, &mut powers)
9659            }
9660            .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
9661            if let (Some(response), Some(plane)) =
9662                (self.primary_beam.as_ref(), primary_beam_plane.as_mut())
9663            {
9664                response.fill_power_plane_into(frequency, plane)?;
9665            }
9666            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
9667                let input_start = self
9668                    .polarization_plane(local_channel, polarization)
9669                    .checked_mul(cells)
9670                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9671                for (term, power) in powers.iter().copied().enumerate() {
9672                    let output_start = self
9673                        .polarization_plane(term, polarization)
9674                        .checked_mul(cells)
9675                        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9676                    for cell in 0..cells {
9677                        let index = output_start + cell;
9678                        let response = primary_beam_plane.as_ref().map_or(1.0, |plane| {
9679                            if normal_moments {
9680                                f64::from(plane[cell])
9681                            } else {
9682                                f64::from(plane[cell] > 0.0)
9683                            }
9684                        });
9685                        let value = channel_values[input_start + cell] * (power * response);
9686                        let corrected = value - compensation[index];
9687                        let updated = output[index] + corrected;
9688                        compensation[index] = (updated - output[index]) - corrected;
9689                        output[index] = updated;
9690                    }
9691                }
9692            }
9693        }
9694        Ok(output)
9695    }
9696
9697    fn channel_major_primary_beam_weighted_sum(
9698        &self,
9699    ) -> Result<Option<Vec<f64>>, SpectralOperatorError> {
9700        let Some(response) = self.primary_beam.as_ref() else {
9701            return Ok(None);
9702        };
9703        let cells = checked_cells(self.geometry.image_shape)?;
9704        let mut output = vec![0.0; cells * self.polarization_count];
9705        let mut compensation = vec![0.0; output.len()];
9706        let mut plane = vec![0.0; cells];
9707        for (local_channel, output_channel) in self.slab.core_range().enumerate() {
9708            let frequency = *self
9709                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9710                .get(output_channel)
9711                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9712            response.fill_power_plane_into(frequency, &mut plane)?;
9713            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
9714                let channel_plane = self.polarization_plane(local_channel, polarization);
9715                let weight = *self
9716                    .channel_major_sum_weights
9717                    .get(channel_plane)
9718                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9719                let start = polarization * cells;
9720                for (cell, response_value) in plane.iter().copied().enumerate() {
9721                    let index = start + cell;
9722                    let value = weight * f64::from(response_value);
9723                    let corrected = value - compensation[index];
9724                    let updated = output[index] + corrected;
9725                    compensation[index] = (updated - output[index]) - corrected;
9726                    output[index] = updated;
9727                }
9728            }
9729        }
9730        Ok(Some(output))
9731    }
9732
9733    fn fold_channel_major_sum_weights(&mut self) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9734        let plan = self
9735            .basis
9736            .channel_major_taylor()
9737            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9738        if imaging_science_trace_enabled() {
9739            self.emit_channel_major_sum_weight_probe(plan)?;
9740        }
9741        let mut imaging_moments = vec![0.0; plan.normal_moment_count()];
9742        let mut published_moments = vec![0.0; plan.normal_moment_count()];
9743        for (local_channel, output_channel) in self.slab.core_range().enumerate() {
9744            let frequency = *self
9745                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9746                .get(output_channel)
9747                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9748            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
9749                let channel_plane = self.polarization_plane(local_channel, polarization);
9750                let imaging_weight = *self
9751                    .channel_major_sum_weights
9752                    .get(channel_plane)
9753                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9754                let published_weight = *self
9755                    .channel_major_published_sum_weights
9756                    .get(channel_plane)
9757                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9758                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(frequency, imaging_weight, &mut imaging_moments)
9759                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
9760                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(
9761                    frequency,
9762                    published_weight * published_weight,
9763                    &mut published_moments,
9764                )
9765                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
9766                for moment in 0..plan.normal_moment_count() {
9767                    let plane = self.polarization_plane(moment, polarization);
9768                    accumulate_compensated(
9769                        &mut self.sum_weights,
9770                        &mut self.sum_weight_compensations,
9771                        plane,
9772                        imaging_moments[moment],
9773                    )?;
9774                    accumulate_compensated(
9775                        &mut self.published_sum_weights,
9776                        &mut self.published_sum_weight_compensations,
9777                        plane,
9778                        published_moments[moment],
9779                    )?;
9780                }
9781            }
9782        }
9783        Ok(())
9784    }
9785
9786    fn emit_channel_major_sum_weight_probe(
9787        &self,
9788        plan: BlockNormalPlan,
9789    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
9790        let mut imaging_moments = vec![0.0; plan.normal_moment_count()];
9791        let mut published_moments = vec![0.0; plan.normal_moment_count()];
9792        for (local_channel, output_channel) in self.slab.core_range().enumerate() {
9793            let frequency = *self
9794                .output_channel_frequencies_hz
9795                .get(output_channel)
9796                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
9797            for polarization in 0..self.polarization_count {
9798                let channel_plane = self.polarization_plane(local_channel, polarization);
9799                let imaging_weight = self.channel_major_sum_weights[channel_plane];
9800                let published_weight = self.channel_major_published_sum_weights[channel_plane];
9801                eprintln!(
9802                    "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=channel_sum output_channel={} polarization={} frequency_hz={:.17e} imaging_sumwt={:.17e} published_sumwt={:.17e}",
9803                    output_channel, polarization, frequency, imaging_weight, published_weight,
9804                );
9805                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(frequency, imaging_weight, &mut imaging_moments)
9806                    .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
9807                plan.fill_normal_moment_weights(
9808                    frequency,
9809                    published_weight * published_weight,
9810                    &mut published_moments,
9811                )
9812                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample)?;
9813                for moment in 0..plan.normal_moment_count() {
9814                    eprintln!(
9815                        "imaging_science_probe_v1 boundary=taylor_fold output_channel={} polarization={} term={} imaging_increment={:.17e} published_increment={:.17e}",
9816                        output_channel,
9817                        polarization,
9818                        moment,
9819                        imaging_moments[moment],
9820                        published_moments[moment],
9821                    );
9822                }
9823            }
9824        }
9825        Ok(())
9826    }
9827
9828    pub(crate) fn finish_gridded_normal_from_grids(
9829        mut self,
9830        residual_model: ModelGenerationId,
9831        normal_grids: Vec<Array2<Complex64>>,
9832    ) -> Result<SpectralChartUpdate, SpectralOperatorError> {
9833        let expected_shape = (self.geometry.grid_shape[0], self.geometry.grid_shape[1]);
9834        let expected_planes = self
9835            .basis
9836            .major_coefficient_planes(self.slab)
9837            .checked_add(if matches!(self.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
9838                self.slab.total_channels()
9839            } else {
9840                0
9841            })
9842            .and_then(|planes| planes.checked_mul(self.polarization_count))
9843            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9844        if self.residual_grids.is_some()
9845            || normal_grids.len() != expected_planes
9846            || normal_grids.iter().any(|grid| grid.dim() != expected_shape)
9847        {
9848            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GriddedRecordMismatch);
9849        }
9850        let mut normal_grids = normal_grids;
9851        if matches!(self.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
9852            self.common_residual_grids = Some(
9853                normal_grids
9854                    .split_off(self.basis.coefficient_terms(self.slab) * self.polarization_count),
9855            );
9856        }
9857        self.residual_grids = Some(normal_grids);
9858        self.finish_chart_update(residual_model, true)
9859    }
9860
9861    fn finish_streaming_residual(
9862        self,
9863        residual_model: ModelGenerationId,
9864    ) -> Result<SpectralChartUpdate, SpectralOperatorError> {
9865        self.finish_chart_update(residual_model, false)
9866    }
9867
9868    fn finish_chart_update(
9869        mut self,
9870        residual_model: ModelGenerationId,
9871        normal: bool,
9872    ) -> Result<SpectralChartUpdate, SpectralOperatorError> {
9873        if self.workload.pass != SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh {
9874            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGriddedReplay);
9875        }
9876        let mut grids = self
9877            .residual_grids
9878            .take()
9879            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?;
9880        for grid in &mut grids {
9881            self.fft.transform(grid, true);
9882        }
9883        if let Some(common) = self.common_residual_grids.as_mut() {
9884            for grid in common {
9885                self.fft.transform(grid, true);
9886            }
9887        }
9888        let values = collect_image_planes(
9889            Some(&grids),
9890            &self.geometry,
9891            &self.gridder,
9892            self.image_correction_oversampling,
9893        )?
9894        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?;
9895        let values = if self.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
9896            self.fold_channel_major_values(&values, false)?
9897        } else {
9898            values
9899        };
9900        match (
9901            self.requires_primary_beam_replay(),
9902            self.primary_beam_replay.is_some(),
9903        ) {
9904            (true, true) | (false, false) => {}
9905            _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch),
9906        }
9907        trace_complex_values("final_replay_residual", &values);
9908        let common_values = collect_image_planes(
9909            self.common_residual_grids.as_deref(),
9910            &self.geometry,
9911            &self.gridder,
9912            self.image_correction_oversampling,
9913        )?
9914        .map(Vec::into_boxed_slice);
9915        Ok(SpectralChartUpdate {
9916            residual_model,
9917            values: values.into_boxed_slice(),
9918            common_values,
9919            normal,
9920        })
9921    }
9922
9923    /// Finish the paired inverse transforms and return unnormalized primitives.
9924    #[cfg(test)]
9925    pub fn finish(self) -> Result<SpectralOperatorPrimitives, SpectralOperatorError> {
9926        self.finish_bound(None)
9927    }
9928
9929    fn finish_bound(
9930        self,
9931        model_binding: Option<ReconstructionModelBinding>,
9932    ) -> Result<SpectralOperatorPrimitives, SpectralOperatorError> {
9933        self.finish_bound_recycled(model_binding)
9934            .map(|(primitives, _)| primitives)
9935    }
9936
9937    fn finish_bound_recycled(
9938        mut self,
9939        model_binding: Option<ReconstructionModelBinding>,
9940    ) -> Result<(SpectralOperatorPrimitives, PreparedFft), SpectralOperatorError> {
9941        let residual_model = model_binding.map(ReconstructionModelBinding::generation);
9942        let initial_empty = model_binding.is_some_and(|binding| {
9943            matches!(binding, ReconstructionModelBinding::InitialCertifiedZero(_))
9944        });
9945        if initial_empty
9946            && (self.workload.pass != SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor
9947                || self.reused_normal_state.is_some()
9948                || self.residual_grids.is_some()
9949                || self.residual_compensations.is_some())
9950        {
9951            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
9952        }
9953        let operator_path = if self.reused_normal_state.is_some() {
9954            "streaming_residual"
9955        } else {
9956            "streaming_initial"
9957        };
9958        let coefficient_terms = self
9959            .basis
9960            .coefficient_terms(self.slab)
9961            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9962            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9963        let normal_moments = self
9964            .basis
9965            .normal_moments(self.slab)
9966            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9967            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9968        let major_coefficient_planes = self
9969            .basis
9970            .major_coefficient_planes(self.slab)
9971            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9972            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9973        let major_normal_planes = self
9974            .basis
9975            .major_normal_planes(self.slab)
9976            .checked_mul(self.polarization_count)
9977            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9978        let planes = major_coefficient_planes
9979            .checked_add(major_normal_planes)
9980            .and_then(|planes| {
9981                self.aw_sensitivity_grids
9982                    .as_ref()
9983                    .map_or(Some(planes), |sensitivity| {
9984                        planes.checked_add(sensitivity.len())
9985                    })
9986            })
9987            .and_then(|planes| {
9988                self.residual_grids.as_ref().map_or(Some(planes), |_| {
9989                    planes.checked_add(major_coefficient_planes)
9990                })
9991            })
9992            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
9993        let fft_started = imaging_stage_timing_started();
9994        if let Some(dirty) = self.dirty_grids.as_mut() {
9995            for grid in dirty {
9996                self.fft.transform(grid, true);
9997                #[cfg(test)]
9998                record_measurement(&mut self.measurements.inverse_dirty_fft_planes, 1);
9999            }
10000        }
10001        if let Some(psf) = self.psf_grids.as_mut() {
10002            for grid in psf {
10003                self.fft.transform(grid, true);
10004                #[cfg(test)]
10005                record_measurement(&mut self.measurements.inverse_psf_fft_planes, 1);
10006            }
10007        }
10008        if let Some(sensitivity) = self.aw_sensitivity_grids.as_mut() {
10009            for grid in sensitivity {
10010                self.fft.transform(grid, true);
10011            }
10012        }
10013        if let Some(residual) = self.residual_grids.as_mut() {
10014            for grid in residual {
10015                self.fft.transform(grid, true);
10016                #[cfg(test)]
10017                record_measurement(&mut self.measurements.inverse_residual_fft_planes, 1);
10018            }
10019        }
10020        if let Some(residual) = self.common_residual_grids.as_mut() {
10021            for grid in residual {
10022                self.fft.transform(grid, true);
10023            }
10024        }
10025        log_imaging_stage_timing(
10026            if self.reused_normal_state.is_some() {
10027                "residual_fft"
10028            } else {
10029                "initial_fft"
10030            },
10031            operator_path,
10032            planes,
10033            fft_started,
10034        );
10035        let formation_started = imaging_stage_timing_started();
10036        let cells = self.geometry.image_shape[0] * self.geometry.image_shape[1];
10037        let output_cells = cells
10038            .checked_mul(coefficient_terms)
10039            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
10040        let normal_cells = cells
10041            .checked_mul(normal_moments)
10042            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
10043        if let Some(reused) = self.reused_normal_state.take() {
10044            if residual_model.is_none()
10045                || reused
10046                    .invariant_dirty
10047                    .as_ref()
10048                    .is_some_and(|dirty| dirty.len() != output_cells)
10049                || reused.psf.len() != normal_cells
10050                || reused.sensitivity.len() != normal_cells
10051                || reused.sum_weights.len() != normal_moments
10052                || reused.published_sum_weights.len() != normal_moments
10053                || reused.channel_sum_weights.len()
10054                    != if matches!(self.basis, SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. }) {
10055                        self.slab.total_channels() * self.polarization_count
10056                    } else {
10057                        0
10058                    }
10059                || reused.validity.len()
10060                    != self.basis.validity_entries(self.slab) * self.polarization_count
10061            {
10062                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch);
10063            }
10064            let residual_grids = self
10065                .residual_grids
10066                .as_ref()
10067                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?;
10068            let common_residual = collect_image_planes(
10069                self.common_residual_grids.as_deref(),
10070                &self.geometry,
10071                &self.gridder,
10072                self.image_correction_oversampling,
10073            )?;
10074            let residual = collect_image_planes(
10075                Some(residual_grids),
10076                &self.geometry,
10077                &self.gridder,
10078                self.image_correction_oversampling,
10079            )?
10080            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::MissingMajorCycleResidual)?;
10081            let residual = if self.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
10082                self.fold_channel_major_values(&residual, false)?
10083            } else {
10084                residual
10085            };
10086            trace_complex_values("streaming_replay_residual", &residual);
10087            if residual.len() != output_cells {
10088                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
10089            }
10090            if residual
10091                .iter()
10092                .chain(reused.psf.iter())
10093                .any(|value| !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite())
10094                || reused.sensitivity.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10095                || reused.sum_weights.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10096                || reused
10097                    .published_sum_weights
10098                    .iter()
10099                    .any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10100                || reused
10101                    .channel_sum_weights
10102                    .iter()
10103                    .any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10104            {
10105                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
10106            }
10107            let primitives = SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
10108                shape: self.geometry.image_shape,
10109                slab: self.slab,
10110                basis: self.basis,
10111                polarizations: self.polarization_count,
10112                joint_line_term_by_channel: self.joint_line_term_by_channel,
10113                dirty: residual.into_boxed_slice(),
10114                invariant_dirty: reused.invariant_dirty,
10115                common_residual: common_residual.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice),
10116                invariant_common_dirty: reused.invariant_common_dirty,
10117                psf: reused.psf,
10118                sensitivity: reused.sensitivity,
10119                primary_beam_weighted_sum: reused.primary_beam_weighted_sum,
10120                sum_weights: reused.sum_weights,
10121                published_sum_weights: reused.published_sum_weights,
10122                channel_sum_weights: reused.channel_sum_weights,
10123                validity: reused.validity,
10124                major_cycle_residual: None,
10125                major_cycle_residual_promoted: true,
10126                residual_model,
10127                #[cfg(test)]
10128                measurements: self.measurements,
10129            };
10130            log_imaging_stage_timing(
10131                "residual_formation",
10132                operator_path,
10133                planes,
10134                formation_started,
10135            );
10136            let fft = self.fft;
10137            return Ok((primitives, fft));
10138        }
10139        self.finalize_aw_sum_weights()?;
10140        let dirty_grids = self
10141            .dirty_grids
10142            .as_ref()
10143            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
10144        let psf_grids = self
10145            .psf_grids
10146            .as_ref()
10147            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
10148        let dirty = collect_image_planes(
10149            Some(dirty_grids),
10150            &self.geometry,
10151            &self.gridder,
10152            self.image_correction_oversampling,
10153        )?
10154        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
10155        let psf = collect_image_planes(
10156            Some(psf_grids),
10157            &self.geometry,
10158            &self.gridder,
10159            self.image_correction_oversampling,
10160        )?
10161        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ReusableNormalStateMismatch)?;
10162        let aw_sensitivity = match (
10163            self.aw_sensitivity_grids.as_deref(),
10164            self.aw_weight_oversampling,
10165        ) {
10166            (Some(grids), Some(oversampling)) => collect_image_planes(
10167                Some(grids),
10168                &self.geometry,
10169                &self.gridder,
10170                Some(oversampling),
10171            )?,
10172            (None, None) => None,
10173            _ => return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch),
10174        };
10175        let residual = collect_image_planes(
10176            self.residual_grids.as_deref(),
10177            &self.geometry,
10178            &self.gridder,
10179            self.image_correction_oversampling,
10180        )?;
10181        let common_residual = collect_image_planes(
10182            self.common_residual_grids.as_deref(),
10183            &self.geometry,
10184            &self.gridder,
10185            self.image_correction_oversampling,
10186        )?;
10187        let mut primary_beam_weighted_sum = None;
10188        let (dirty, mut psf, residual, aw_sensitivity) =
10189            if self.basis.channel_major_taylor().is_some() {
10190                self.fold_channel_major_sum_weights()?;
10191                primary_beam_weighted_sum = self.channel_major_primary_beam_weighted_sum()?;
10192                (
10193                    self.fold_channel_major_values(&dirty, false)?,
10194                    self.fold_channel_major_values(&psf, true)?,
10195                    residual
10196                        .as_deref()
10197                        .map(|values| self.fold_channel_major_values(values, false))
10198                        .transpose()?,
10199                    aw_sensitivity
10200                        .as_deref()
10201                        .map(|values| self.fold_channel_major_values(values, true))
10202                        .transpose()?,
10203                )
10204            } else {
10205                (dirty, psf, residual, aw_sensitivity)
10206            };
10207        if dirty.len() != output_cells || psf.len() != normal_cells {
10208            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
10209        }
10210        if self.image_correction_oversampling.is_some() {
10211            normalize_direction_dependent_psf(&mut psf, cells, &self.sum_weights)?;
10212        }
10213        let sensitivity = if let Some(values) = aw_sensitivity {
10214            aw_sensitivity_magnitude(values)
10215        } else if let Some(accumulators) = self.mosaic_normal.take() {
10216            let mut sensitivity = Vec::with_capacity(normal_cells);
10217            let response = self
10218                .primary_beam
10219                .as_ref()
10220                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10221            for accumulator in accumulators {
10222                sensitivity.extend(accumulator.gridded_sensitivity(
10223                    self.geometry.image_shape,
10224                    self.geometry.image_blc,
10225                    response,
10226                    &mut self.mosaic_projectors,
10227                    &mut self.fft,
10228                )?);
10229            }
10230            sensitivity
10231        } else {
10232            let mut sensitivity = Vec::with_capacity(normal_cells);
10233            for moment in 0..normal_moments {
10234                sensitivity.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(self.sum_weights[moment], cells));
10235            }
10236            sensitivity
10237        };
10238        if sensitivity.len() != normal_cells {
10239            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
10240        }
10241        if dirty
10242            .iter()
10243            .chain(&psf)
10244            .chain(residual.iter().flatten())
10245            .any(|value| !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite())
10246            || sensitivity.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10247            || self.sum_weights.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10248            || self
10249                .published_sum_weights
10250                .iter()
10251                .any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10252            || self
10253                .channel_sum_weights
10254                .iter()
10255                .any(|value| !value.is_finite())
10256        {
10257            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
10258        }
10259        let validity = match self.basis {
10260            SpectralBasisPlan::ChannelLocal => self
10261                .mapped_samples
10262                .iter()
10263                .zip(&self.sum_weights)
10264                .map(|(mapped, weight)| validity_from_support(*mapped, *weight))
10265                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
10266            SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(_) | SpectralBasisPlan::TaylorViaChannelMajor(_) => (0
10267                ..self.polarization_count)
10268                .map(|polarization| {
10269                    validity_from_support(
10270                        self.mapped_samples[polarization],
10271                        self.sum_weights[polarization],
10272                    )
10273                })
10274                .collect(),
10275            SpectralBasisPlan::Joint { .. } => self
10276                .mapped_samples
10277                .iter()
10278                .zip(&self.channel_sum_weights)
10279                .map(|(mapped, weight)| validity_from_support(*mapped, *weight))
10280                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
10281        };
10282        let dirty = dirty.into_boxed_slice();
10283        let invariant_dirty = Some(dirty.clone());
10284        let common_residual = common_residual.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice);
10285        let invariant_common_dirty = common_residual.clone();
10286        #[cfg(test)]
10287        if self.workload.initial_phase_residency().is_some() {
10288            self.measurements.initial_formation_buffer_bytes = (dirty.len()
10289                + invariant_dirty.as_ref().map_or(0, |values| values.len())
10290                + psf.capacity())
10291                * size_of::<Complex64>()
10292                + sensitivity.capacity() * size_of::<f64>();
10293            self.measurements.initial_sensitivity_capacity_bytes =
10294                sensitivity.capacity() * size_of::<f64>();
10295            self.measurements.initial_sensitivity_box_bytes = sensitivity.len() * size_of::<f64>();
10296        }
10297        let mut primitives = SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
10298            shape: self.geometry.image_shape,
10299            slab: self.slab,
10300            basis: self.basis,
10301            polarizations: self.polarization_count,
10302            joint_line_term_by_channel: self.joint_line_term_by_channel,
10303            invariant_dirty,
10304            dirty,
10305            common_residual,
10306            invariant_common_dirty,
10307            psf: psf.into_boxed_slice(),
10308            sensitivity: sensitivity.into_boxed_slice(),
10309            primary_beam_weighted_sum: primary_beam_weighted_sum.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice),
10310            sum_weights: self.sum_weights.into_boxed_slice(),
10311            published_sum_weights: self.published_sum_weights.into_boxed_slice(),
10312            channel_sum_weights: self.channel_sum_weights.into_boxed_slice(),
10313            validity: validity.into_boxed_slice(),
10314            major_cycle_residual: residual.map(Vec::into_boxed_slice),
10315            major_cycle_residual_promoted: initial_empty,
10316            residual_model,
10317            #[cfg(test)]
10318            measurements: self.measurements,
10319        };
10320        if self.slab.core_range() == (0..self.slab.total_channels()) {
10321            normalize_completed_primary_beam_psf_fold(&mut primitives)?;
10322        }
10323        log_imaging_stage_timing(
10324            "initial_primitive_formation",
10325            operator_path,
10326            planes,
10327            formation_started,
10328        );
10329        let fft = self.fft;
10330        Ok((primitives, fft))
10331    }
10332}
10333
10334fn accumulate_compensated(
10335    sums: &mut [f64],
10336    compensations: &mut [f64],
10337    index: usize,
10338    value: f64,
10339) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
10340    let sum = sums
10341        .get_mut(index)
10342        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10343    let compensation = compensations
10344        .get_mut(index)
10345        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10346    let corrected = value - *compensation;
10347    let updated = *sum + corrected;
10348    *compensation = (updated - *sum) - corrected;
10349    *sum = updated;
10350    Ok(())
10351}
10352
10353fn collect_image_planes(
10354    grids: Option<&[Array2<Complex64>]>,
10355    geometry: &SpectralOperatorGeometry,
10356    gridder: &ConvolutionOperator,
10357    sinc_oversampling: Option<usize>,
10358) -> Result<Option<Vec<Complex64>>, SpectralOperatorError> {
10359    let Some(grids) = grids else {
10360        return Ok(None);
10361    };
10362    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(
10363        checked_cells(geometry.image_shape)?
10364            .checked_mul(grids.len())
10365            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?,
10366    );
10367    for grid in grids {
10368        for x in 0..geometry.image_shape[0] {
10369            for y in 0..geometry.image_shape[1] {
10370                let correction = if let Some(oversampling) = sinc_oversampling {
10371                    gridder.sinc_image_correction(x, y, oversampling)
10372                } else {
10373                    gridder.image_correction(x, y)
10374                };
10375                let value = grid[(geometry.image_blc[0] + x, geometry.image_blc[1] + y)];
10376                values.push(if sinc_oversampling.is_some() {
10377                    // MosaicFT and AWProjectFT convert their post-FFT DComplex
10378                    // lattices to Complex, then apply the Float sinc correction.
10379                    let corrected =
10380                        Complex32::new(value.re as f32, value.im as f32) * correction as f32;
10381                    Complex64::new(f64::from(corrected.re), f64::from(corrected.im))
10382                } else {
10383                    value * correction
10384                });
10385            }
10386        }
10387    }
10388    if values
10389        .iter()
10390        .any(|value| !value.re.is_finite() || !value.im.is_finite())
10391    {
10392        Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite)
10393    } else {
10394        Ok(Some(values))
10395    }
10396}
10397
10398fn aw_sensitivity_magnitude(values: Vec<Complex64>) -> Vec<f64> {
10399    values
10400        .into_iter()
10401        .map(|value| f64::from(value.norm() as f32))
10402        .collect()
10403}
10404
10405fn normalize_direction_dependent_psf(
10406    psf: &mut [Complex64],
10407    cells: usize,
10408    sum_weights: &[f64],
10409) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
10410    if psf.len() != cells * sum_weights.len() {
10411        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
10412    }
10413    let Some(principal_sum_weight) = sum_weights.first().copied() else {
10414        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch);
10415    };
10416    if principal_sum_weight == 0.0 {
10417        return Ok(());
10418    }
10419    let principal = &psf[..cells];
10420    let peak = principal
10421        .iter()
10422        .max_by(|left, right| left.re.total_cmp(&right.re))
10423        .copied()
10424        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10425    if !peak.re.is_finite() || !peak.im.is_finite() || peak.re <= f64::MIN_POSITIVE {
10426        return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
10427    }
10428    let scale = principal_sum_weight / peak.re;
10429    psf.iter_mut().for_each(|value| *value *= scale);
10430    Ok(())
10431}

10469struct CompensatedGrid<'a> {
10470    values: &'a mut Array2<Complex64>,
10471    errors: &'a mut Array2<Complex64>,

10473
10474impl GridOperatorTaps {
10475    fn imaging_normalization(
10476        &self,
10477        standard: &ConvolutionOperator,
10478    ) -> Result<f64, SpectralOperatorError> {
10479        match self {
10480            Self::Standard(taps) => standard.normalization(*taps),
10481            Self::Aw { imaging, .. } => Ok(imaging.normalization()),
10482            Self::Mosaic { plan, .. } => {
10483                Ok(if MosaicProjector::contributes_to_normalization(*plan) {
10484                    1.0
10485                } else {
10486                    0.0
10487                })
10488            }
10489        }
10490    }
10491
10492    fn normal_normalization(
10493        &self,
10494        standard: &ConvolutionOperator,
10495    ) -> Result<f64, SpectralOperatorError> {
10496        match self {
10497            Self::Aw {
10498                normal: Some(normal),
10499                ..
10500            } => Ok(normal.normalization()),
10501            Self::Aw { normal: None, .. } => Ok(0.0),
10502            Self::Standard(_) | Self::Mosaic { .. } => self.imaging_normalization(standard),
10503        }
10504    }
10505}

10507#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
10508enum GridAccumulationRole {
10509    Imaging,
10510    Normal,
10511}
10512
10513fn grid_operator_compensated(
10514    standard: &ConvolutionOperator,
10515    mosaic: &BTreeMap<MosaicProjectorKey, MosaicProjector>,
10516    grid: CompensatedGrid<'_>,
10517    taps: &GridOperatorTaps,
10518    role: GridAccumulationRole,
10519    value: Complex64,
10520) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
10521    let CompensatedGrid { values, errors } = grid;
10522    match taps {
10523        GridOperatorTaps::Standard(taps) => standard.grid_compensated(values, errors, *taps, value),
10524        GridOperatorTaps::Aw {
10525            imaging, normal, ..
10526        } => {
10527            let grid = values
10528                .as_slice_mut()
10529                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10530            let compensation = errors
10531                .as_slice_mut()
10532                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10533            let plan = match role {
10534                GridAccumulationRole::Imaging => imaging,
10535                GridAccumulationRole::Normal => normal
10536                    .as_ref()
10537                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?,
10538            };
10539            plan.grid_compensated(grid, compensation, value)
10540                .map_err(Into::into)
10541        }
10542        GridOperatorTaps::Mosaic { response_key, plan } => {
10543            mosaic
10544                .get(response_key)
10545                .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?
10546                .grid_compensated(values, errors, *plan, value);
10547            Ok(())
10548        }
10549    }
10550}

10552fn degrid_operator(
10553    standard: &ConvolutionOperator,
10554    aw: &Option<Mutex<AwProjectionOperator<Box<dyn AwPreparedCellProvider + Send>>>>,
10555    mosaic: &BTreeMap<MosaicProjectorKey, MosaicProjector>,
10556    grid: &Array2<Complex64>,
10557    taps: OperatorTaps,
10558    replay_taylor_term: Option<usize>,
10559) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
10560    match taps {
10561        OperatorTaps::Standard(taps) => standard.degrid(grid, taps),
10562        OperatorTaps::Aw(sample) => {
10563            let aw = aw.as_ref().ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10564            let mut aw = aw
10565                .lock()
10566                .map_err(|_| SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?;
10567            aw.degrid_with_replay_term(
10568                grid.as_slice()
10569                    .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)?,
10570                [grid.nrows(), grid.ncols()],
10571                sample,
10572                replay_taylor_term,
10573            )
10574            .map_err(Into::into)
10575        }
10576        OperatorTaps::Mosaic { response_key, plan } => mosaic
10577            .get(&response_key)
10578            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ProblemMismatch)
10579            .map(|projector| projector.degrid(grid, plan)),
10580    }
10581}
