10626impl ConvolutionOperator {
10627    pub(crate) fn new(
10628        geometry: &SpectralOperatorGeometry,
10629        w_projection: Option<WProjectionContract>,
10630    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
10631        if let Some(contract) =
10632            w_projection.filter(|contract| contract.maximum_abs_w_lambda() > f64::MIN_POSITIVE)
10633        {
10634            Ok(Self::WProjection(WProjectionConvolution::new(
10635                geometry, contract,
10636            )?))
10637        } else {
10638            Ok(Self::Standard(StandardConvolution::new(geometry)))
10639        }
10640    }
10641
10642    pub(crate) fn taps(&self, uvw_lambda: [f64; 3]) -> Option<SampleTaps> {
10643        match self {
10644            Self::Standard(operator) => operator.taps([uvw_lambda[0], uvw_lambda[1]]),
10645            Self::WProjection(operator) => operator.taps(uvw_lambda),
10646        }
10647    }
10648
10649    pub(crate) fn maximum_support(&self) -> usize {
10650        match self {
10651            Self::Standard(_) => SUPPORT,
10652            Self::WProjection(operator) => operator.maximum_support(),
10653        }
10654    }
10655
10656    pub(crate) fn w_projection_diagnostics(&self) -> Option<WProjectionDiagnostics> {
10657        match self {
10658            Self::Standard(_) => None,
10659            Self::WProjection(operator) => Some(operator.diagnostics()),
10660        }
10661    }
10662
10663    fn normalization(&self, taps: SampleTaps) -> Result<f64, SpectralOperatorError> {
10664        self.validate_taps(taps)?;
10665        let value = match self {
10666            Self::Standard(_) => 1.0,
10667            Self::WProjection(operator) => operator.normalization(taps),
10668        };
10669        if value.is_finite() && value > f64::MIN_POSITIVE {
10670            Ok(value)
10671        } else {
10672            Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite)
10673        }
10674    }
10675
10676    pub(crate) fn grid_compensated(
10677        &self,
10678        grid: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
10679        compensation: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
10680        taps: SampleTaps,
10681        value: Complex64,
10682    ) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
10683        self.validate_taps(taps)?;
10684        match self {
10685            Self::Standard(operator) => operator.grid_compensated(grid, compensation, taps, value),
10686            Self::WProjection(operator) => {
10687                operator.grid_compensated(grid, compensation, taps, value)
10688            }
10689        }
10690        Ok(())
10691    }
10692
10693    pub(crate) fn degrid(
10694        &self,
10695        grid: &Array2<Complex64>,
10696        taps: SampleTaps,
10697    ) -> Result<Complex64, SpectralOperatorError> {
10698        self.validate_taps(taps)?;
10699        Ok(match self {
10700            Self::Standard(operator) => operator.degrid(grid, taps),
10701            Self::WProjection(operator) => operator.degrid(grid, taps),
10702        })
10703    }
10704
10705    fn model_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> f64 {
10706        match self {
10707            Self::Standard(operator) => operator.image_correction(x, y),
10708            Self::WProjection(operator) => operator.model_correction(x, y),
10709        }
10710    }
10711
10712    fn image_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> f64 {
10713        match self {
10714            Self::Standard(operator) => operator.image_correction(x, y),
10715            Self::WProjection(operator) => operator.image_correction(x, y),
10716        }
10717    }
10718
10719    fn sinc_image_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize, oversampling: usize) -> f64 {
10720        self.standard().sinc_image_correction(x, y, oversampling)
10721    }
10722
10723    fn standard(&self) -> &StandardConvolution {
10724        match self {
10725            Self::Standard(operator) => operator,
10726            Self::WProjection(operator) => &operator.standard,
10727        }
10728    }
10729
10730    fn validate_taps(&self, taps: SampleTaps) -> Result<(), SpectralOperatorError> {
10731        let (support, metadata_valid) = match self {
10732            Self::Standard(operator) => (
10733                SUPPORT,
10734                taps.x.weight_index < operator.weights.len()
10735                    && taps.y.weight_index < operator.weights.len(),
10736            ),
10737            Self::WProjection(operator) => (
10738                operator.maximum_support(),
10739                taps.x.weight_index < operator.kernels.len()
10740                    && taps.y.weight_index & 0x1f < 25
10741                    && taps.y.weight_index & !0x3f == 0,
10742            ),
10743        };
10744        let shape = self.standard().grid_shape;
10745        if !metadata_valid
10746            || taps
10747                .x
10748                .start
10749                .checked_add(2 * support)
10750                .is_none_or(|end| end >= shape[0])
10751            || taps
10752                .y
10753                .start
10754                .checked_add(2 * support)
10755                .is_none_or(|end| end >= shape[1])
10756        {
10757            Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidGriddedRecord)
10758        } else {
10759            Ok(())
10760        }
10761    }
10762}

10764pub(crate) struct StandardConvolution {
10765    grid_shape: [usize; 2],
10766    image_blc: [usize; 2],
10767    du_lambda: f64,
10768    dv_lambda: f64,
10769    weights: Box<[[f64; TAP_COUNT]]>,
10770    correction_x: Box<[f64]>,
10771    correction_y: Box<[f64]>,
10772}
10773
10774struct WProjectionKernel {
10775    support: usize,
10776    weights: Array2<Complex64>,
10777}
10778
10779pub(crate) struct WProjectionConvolution {
10780    standard: StandardConvolution,
10781    sampling: usize,
10782    w_scale: f64,
10783    kernels: Box<[WProjectionKernel]>,
10784    plane_zero_normalization: f64,
10785    kernel_identity: [u8; 32],
10786}
10787
10788impl WProjectionConvolution {
10789    fn new(
10790        geometry: &SpectralOperatorGeometry,
10791        contract: WProjectionContract,
10792    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
10793        let standard = StandardConvolution::new(geometry);
10794        let maximum_abs_w_lambda = contract.maximum_abs_w_lambda();
10795        let half_field_angle = ((geometry.image_shape[0] as f64 * geometry.increment_rad[0].abs())
10796            .max(geometry.image_shape[1] as f64 * geometry.increment_rad[1].abs()))
10797            / 2.0;
10798        let automatic_planes =
10799            (1.05 * maximum_abs_w_lambda * half_field_angle.sin().abs()) as usize;
10800        let plane_count = contract
10801            .planes()
10802            .map(std::num::NonZeroUsize::get)
10803            .unwrap_or(automatic_planes.max(1));
10804        let sampling = if plane_count > 1 { 4 } else { 1 };
10805        let effective_max_w_lambda = if contract.planes().is_some() {
10806            0.25 / geometry.increment_rad[0].abs()
10807        } else {
10808            1.05 * maximum_abs_w_lambda
10809        };
10810        let w_scale = if plane_count > 1 && effective_max_w_lambda > 0.0 {
10811            ((plane_count - 1) * (plane_count - 1)) as f64 / effective_max_w_lambda
10812        } else {
10813            1.0
10814        };
10815        let conv_size = geometry.grid_shape.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
10816        if conv_size < 4 || conv_size % 2 != 0 {
10817            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::UnsupportedGeometry);
10818        }
10819        let inner = (conv_size / sampling).max(2);
10820        let correction_x = (0..inner)
10821            .map(|index| {
10822                let centre = inner as f64 / 2.0;
10823                grdsf(((index as f64 - centre).abs() / centre).clamp(0.0, 1.0))
10824            })
10825            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
10826        let correction_y = correction_x.clone();
10827        let s0 = geometry.increment_rad[0].abs() * sampling as f64 * geometry.grid_shape[0] as f64
10828            / conv_size as f64;
10829        let s1 = geometry.increment_rad[1].abs() * sampling as f64 * geometry.grid_shape[1] as f64
10830            / conv_size as f64;
10831        let mut fft = PreparedFft::new([conv_size, conv_size], usize::MAX)?;
10832        let mut kernels = Vec::with_capacity(plane_count);
10833        let mut plane_zero_peak = None;
10834        let offset_radius = sampling.div_ceil(2);
10835        for plane in 0..plane_count {
10836            let w_lambda = if plane_count > 1 {
10837                (plane * plane) as f64 / w_scale
10838            } else {
10839                0.0
10840            };
10841            let mut screen = Array2::zeros((conv_size, conv_size));
10842            for iy in -(inner as isize / 2)..(inner as isize / 2) {
10843                let m = s1 * iy as f64;
10844                for ix in -(inner as isize / 2)..(inner as isize / 2) {
10845                    let l = s0 * ix as f64;
10846                    let radius_squared = l * l + m * m;
10847                    if radius_squared >= 1.0 {
10848                        continue;
10849                    }
10850                    let phase =
10851                        std::f64::consts::TAU * w_lambda * ((1.0 - radius_squared).sqrt() - 1.0);
10852                    let correction = correction_x[(ix + inner as isize / 2) as usize]
10853                        * correction_y[(iy + inner as isize / 2) as usize];
10854                    let x = if ix >= 0 {
10855                        ix as usize
10856                    } else {
10857                        (ix + conv_size as isize) as usize
10858                    };
10859                    let y = if iy >= 0 {
10860                        iy as usize
10861                    } else {
10862                        (iy + conv_size as isize) as usize
10863                    };
10864                    screen[(x, y)] = Complex64::from_polar(correction, phase);
10865                }
10866            }
10867            fft.transform_unshifted(&mut screen, false);
10868            let peak = *plane_zero_peak.get_or_insert_with(|| screen[(0, 0)].norm());
10869            if !(peak.is_finite() && peak > f64::MIN_POSITIVE) {
10870                return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
10871            }
10872            let quarter = conv_size / 2 - 1;
10873            let mut trial = 0;
10874            for candidate in (1..quarter).rev() {
10875                if (screen[(candidate, 0)] / peak).norm() > 1.0e-3
10876                    || (screen[(0, candidate)] / peak).norm() > 1.0e-3
10877                {
10878                    trial = candidate;
10879                    break;
10880                }
10881            }
10882            let maximum_support = (quarter / sampling).saturating_sub(1).max(1);
10883            let support = if trial == 0 {
10884                maximum_support
10885            } else {
10886                (((trial as f64 / sampling as f64) + 0.5).floor() as usize + 1).min(maximum_support)
10887            };
10888            let width = support
10889                .saturating_mul(sampling)
10890                .saturating_add(offset_radius)
10891                .saturating_add(1)
10892                .min(quarter)
10893                .max(1);
10894            let mut weights = Array2::zeros((width, width));
10895            for x in 0..width {
10896                for y in 0..width {
10897                    weights[(x, y)] = screen[(x, y)] / peak;
10898                }
10899            }
10900            kernels.push(WProjectionKernel { support, weights });
10901        }
10902        let plane_zero_sum = w_projection_kernel_sum(&kernels[0], sampling);
10903        if !(plane_zero_sum.is_finite() && plane_zero_sum > f64::MIN_POSITIVE) {
10904            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::GeneratedNonfinite);
10905        }
10906        for kernel in &mut kernels {
10907            kernel.weights.mapv_inplace(|value| value / plane_zero_sum);
10908        }
10909        let mut kernel_hasher = Sha256::new();
10910        kernel_hasher.update((sampling as u64).to_le_bytes());
10911        for kernel in &kernels {
10912            kernel_hasher.update((kernel.support as u64).to_le_bytes());
10913            for weight in &kernel.weights {
10914                kernel_hasher.update(weight.re.to_bits().to_le_bytes());
10915                kernel_hasher.update(weight.im.to_bits().to_le_bytes());
10916            }
10917        }
10918        Ok(Self {
10919            standard,
10920            sampling,
10921            w_scale,
10922            kernels: kernels.into_boxed_slice(),
10923            plane_zero_normalization: plane_zero_sum,
10924            kernel_identity: kernel_hasher.finalize().into(),
10925        })
10926    }
10927
10928    fn taps(&self, uvw_lambda: [f64; 3]) -> Option<SampleTaps> {
10929        if uvw_lambda.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite()) {
10930            return None;
10931        }
10932        let x = uvw_lambda[0] / self.standard.du_lambda + self.standard.grid_shape[0] as f64 / 2.0;
10933        let y = -uvw_lambda[1] / self.standard.dv_lambda + self.standard.grid_shape[1] as f64 / 2.0;
10934        let loc_x = x.round() as isize;
10935        let loc_y = y.round() as isize;
10936        let off_x = ((loc_x as f64 - x) * self.sampling as f64).round() as isize;
10937        let off_y = ((loc_y as f64 - y) * self.sampling as f64).round() as isize;
10938        let plane = if self.kernels.len() > 1 {
10939            (self.w_scale * uvw_lambda[2].abs())
10940                .sqrt()
10941                .round()
10942                .clamp(0.0, (self.kernels.len() - 1) as f64) as usize
10943        } else {
10944            0
10945        };
10946        let maximum_support = self.maximum_support() as isize;
10947        if loc_x - maximum_support < 0
10948            || loc_y - maximum_support < 0
10949            || loc_x + maximum_support >= self.standard.grid_shape[0] as isize
10950            || loc_y + maximum_support >= self.standard.grid_shape[1] as isize
10951        {
10952            return None;
10953        }
10954        let offset_code =
10955            ((off_x + 2) * 5 + (off_y + 2)) as usize | (usize::from(uvw_lambda[2] > 0.0) << 5);
10956        Some(SampleTaps {
10957            x: TapSpan {
10958                start: (loc_x - maximum_support) as usize,
10959                weight_index: plane,
10960            },
10961            y: TapSpan {
10962                start: (loc_y - maximum_support) as usize,
10963                weight_index: offset_code,
10964            },
10965        })
10966    }
10967
10968    fn decoded(&self, taps: SampleTaps) -> (&WProjectionKernel, isize, isize, bool) {
10969        let kernel = &self.kernels[taps.x.weight_index];
10970        let code = taps.y.weight_index;
10971        let offsets = code & 0x1f;
10972        (
10973            kernel,
10974            (offsets / 5) as isize - 2,
10975            (offsets % 5) as isize - 2,
10976            code & 0x20 != 0,
10977        )
10978    }
10979
10980    fn maximum_support(&self) -> usize {
10981        self.kernels
10982            .iter()
10983            .map(|kernel| kernel.support)
10984            .max()
10985            .unwrap_or(0)
10986    }
10987
10988    fn diagnostics(&self) -> WProjectionDiagnostics {
10989        WProjectionDiagnostics {
10990            plane_count: self.kernels.len(),
10991            sampling: self.sampling,
10992            maximum_support: self.maximum_support(),
10993            plane_zero_normalization: self.plane_zero_normalization,
10994            kernel_identity: self.kernel_identity,
10995        }
10996    }
10997
10998    fn normalization(&self, taps: SampleTaps) -> f64 {
10999        let (kernel, off_x, off_y, conjugate) = self.decoded(taps);
11000        let support = kernel.support as isize;
11001        let mut sum = 0.0;
11002        for ix in -support..=support {
11003            let kernel_x = (ix * self.sampling as isize + off_x).unsigned_abs();
11004            for iy in -support..=support {
11005                let kernel_y = (iy * self.sampling as isize + off_y).unsigned_abs();
11006                let mut weight = kernel.weights[(kernel_x, kernel_y)];
11007                if conjugate {
11008                    weight = weight.conj();
11009                }
11010                sum += weight.re;
11011            }
11012        }
11013        sum
11014    }
11015
11016    fn grid_compensated(
11017        &self,
11018        grid: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
11019        compensation: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
11020        taps: SampleTaps,
11021        value: Complex64,
11022    ) {
11023        let (kernel, off_x, off_y, conjugate) = self.decoded(taps);
11024        let support = kernel.support as isize;
11025        let maximum_support = self.maximum_support() as isize;
11026        for ix in -support..=support {
11027            let kernel_x = (ix * self.sampling as isize + off_x).unsigned_abs();
11028            for iy in -support..=support {
11029                let kernel_y = (iy * self.sampling as isize + off_y).unsigned_abs();
11030                let mut weight = kernel.weights[(kernel_x, kernel_y)];
11031                if conjugate {
11032                    weight = weight.conj();
11033                }
11034                let cell = (
11035                    (taps.x.start as isize + maximum_support + ix) as usize,
11036                    (taps.y.start as isize + maximum_support + iy) as usize,
11037                );
11038                let contribution = value * weight - compensation[cell];
11039                let updated = grid[cell] + contribution;
11040                compensation[cell] = (updated - grid[cell]) - contribution;
11041                grid[cell] = updated;
11042            }
11043        }
11044    }
11045
11046    fn degrid(&self, grid: &Array2<Complex64>, taps: SampleTaps) -> Complex64 {
11047        let (kernel, off_x, off_y, conjugate) = self.decoded(taps);
11048        let support = kernel.support as isize;
11049        let maximum_support = self.maximum_support() as isize;
11050        let mut value = Complex64::default();
11051        for ix in -support..=support {
11052            let kernel_x = (ix * self.sampling as isize + off_x).unsigned_abs();
11053            for iy in -support..=support {
11054                let kernel_y = (iy * self.sampling as isize + off_y).unsigned_abs();
11055                let mut weight = kernel.weights[(kernel_x, kernel_y)];
11056                if conjugate {
11057                    weight = weight.conj();
11058                }
11059                value += weight.conj()
11060                    * grid[(
11061                        (taps.x.start as isize + maximum_support + ix) as usize,
11062                        (taps.y.start as isize + maximum_support + iy) as usize,
11063                    )];
11064            }
11065        }
11066        value
11067    }
11068
11069    fn sinc(&self, index: usize, axis: usize) -> f64 {
11070        let size = self.standard.grid_shape[axis];
11071        if index == size / 2 {
11072            return 1.0;
11073        }
11074        let argument = std::f64::consts::PI * (index as isize - size as isize / 2) as f64
11075            / (size * self.sampling) as f64;
11076        argument.sin() / argument
11077    }
11078
11079    fn model_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> f64 {
11080        let grid_x = self.standard.image_blc[0] + x;
11081        let grid_y = self.standard.image_blc[1] + y;
11082        self.standard.image_correction(x, y) * self.sinc(grid_x, 0) * self.sinc(grid_y, 1)
11083    }
11084
11085    fn image_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> f64 {
11086        let grid_x = self.standard.image_blc[0] + x;
11087        let grid_y = self.standard.image_blc[1] + y;
11088        let sinc = self.sinc(grid_x, 0) * self.sinc(grid_y, 1);
11089        if sinc.abs() > 1.0e-12 {
11090            self.standard.image_correction(x, y) / sinc
11091        } else {
11092            0.0
11093        }
11094    }
11095}
11096
11097fn w_projection_kernel_sum(kernel: &WProjectionKernel, sampling: usize) -> f64 {
11098    let support = kernel.support as isize;
11099    let mut sum = 0.0;
11100    for ix in -support..=support {
11101        for iy in -support..=support {
11102            sum += kernel.weights[(
11103                (ix * sampling as isize).unsigned_abs(),
11104                (iy * sampling as isize).unsigned_abs(),
11105            )]
11106                .re;
11107        }
11108    }
11109    sum
11110}
11111
11112impl StandardConvolution {
11113    pub(crate) fn new(geometry: &SpectralOperatorGeometry) -> Self {
11114        Self {
11115            grid_shape: geometry.grid_shape,
11116            image_blc: geometry.image_blc,
11117            du_lambda: 1.0 / (geometry.grid_shape[0] as f64 * geometry.increment_rad[0].abs()),
11118            dv_lambda: 1.0 / (geometry.grid_shape[1] as f64 * geometry.increment_rad[1].abs()),
11119            weights: build_normalized_tap_weights(),
11120            correction_x: build_correction_axis(geometry.grid_shape[0]),
11121            correction_y: build_correction_axis(geometry.grid_shape[1]),
11122        }
11123    }
11124
11125    pub(crate) fn taps(&self, uv: [f64; 2]) -> Option<SampleTaps> {
11126        Some(SampleTaps {
11127            x: self.tap_span(
11128                uv[0] / self.du_lambda + self.grid_shape[0] as f64 / 2.0,
11129                self.grid_shape[0],
11130            )?,
11131            y: self.tap_span(
11132                -uv[1] / self.dv_lambda + self.grid_shape[1] as f64 / 2.0,
11133                self.grid_shape[1],
11134            )?,
11135        })
11136    }
11137
11138    fn tap_span(&self, coordinate: f64, size: usize) -> Option<TapSpan> {
11139        if !coordinate.is_finite() {
11140            return None;
11141        }
11142        let anchor = coordinate.round() as isize;
11143        let offset = ((anchor as f64 - coordinate) * OVERSAMPLING as f64).round() as isize;
11144        let start = anchor - SUPPORT as isize;
11145        let end = anchor + SUPPORT as isize;
11146        let index = offset + OVERSAMPLING as isize / 2;
11147        (start >= 0 && end < size as isize && index >= 0 && index < self.weights.len() as isize)
11148            .then_some(TapSpan {
11149                start: start as usize,
11150                weight_index: index as usize,
11151            })
11152    }
11153
11154    pub(crate) fn grid_compensated(
11155        &self,
11156        grid: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
11157        compensation: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
11158        taps: SampleTaps,
11159        value: Complex64,
11160    ) {
11161        debug_assert_eq!(grid.dim(), compensation.dim());
11162        let row_stride = grid.ncols();
11163        let grid = grid
11164            .as_slice_mut()
11165            .expect("spectral grids use standard contiguous layout");
11166        let compensation = compensation
11167            .as_slice_mut()
11168            .expect("spectral compensation uses standard contiguous layout");
11169        let x_weights = self.weights[taps.x.weight_index];
11170        let y_weights = self.weights[taps.y.weight_index];
11171        for (x, x_weight) in x_weights.into_iter().enumerate() {
11172            let start = (taps.x.start + x) * row_stride + taps.y.start;
11173            let grid_row = &mut grid[start..start + y_weights.len()];
11174            let compensation_row = &mut compensation[start..start + y_weights.len()];
11175            for ((grid_cell, compensation_cell), y_weight) in
11176                grid_row.iter_mut().zip(compensation_row).zip(y_weights)
11177            {
11178                let contribution = value * x_weight * y_weight - *compensation_cell;
11179                let updated = *grid_cell + contribution;
11180                *compensation_cell = (updated - *grid_cell) - contribution;
11181                *grid_cell = updated;
11182            }
11183        }
11184    }
11185
11186    pub(crate) fn degrid(&self, grid: &Array2<Complex64>, taps: SampleTaps) -> Complex64 {
11187        let x_weights = self.weights[taps.x.weight_index];
11188        let y_weights = self.weights[taps.y.weight_index];
11189        let mut value = Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0);
11190        for (x, x_weight) in x_weights.into_iter().enumerate() {
11191            for (y, y_weight) in y_weights.into_iter().enumerate() {
11192                value += grid[(taps.x.start + x, taps.y.start + y)] * x_weight * y_weight;
11193            }
11194        }
11195        value
11196    }
11197
11198    fn image_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> f64 {
11199        self.correction_x[self.image_blc[0] + x] * self.correction_y[self.image_blc[1] + y]
11200    }
11201
11202    fn sinc_image_correction(&self, x: usize, y: usize, oversampling: usize) -> f64 {
11203        let size = self.grid_shape.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
11204        let grid_x = self.image_blc[0] + x;
11205        let grid_y = self.image_blc[1] + y;
11206        1.0 / (convolution_sinc(grid_x, size, oversampling)
11207            * convolution_sinc(grid_y, size, oversampling))
11208    }
11209}
11210
11211fn convolution_sinc(index: usize, size: usize, oversampling: usize) -> f64 {
11212    if index == size / 2 {
11213        return 1.0;
11214    }
11215    let offset = (index as isize - size as isize / 2) as f32;
11216    let denominator = size as f32 * oversampling as f32;
11217    let argument = (std::f64::consts::PI * f64::from(offset) / f64::from(denominator)) as f32;
11218    f64::from(argument.sin() / argument)
11219}
11220
11221pub(crate) struct PreparedFft {
11222    forward: [Arc<dyn Fft<f64>>; 2],
11223    inverse: [Arc<dyn Fft<f64>>; 2],
11224    lane: Vec<Complex64>,
11225    scratch: Vec<Complex64>,
11226}
11227
11228impl PreparedFft {
11229    pub(crate) fn new(
11230        shape: [usize; 2],
11231        reserved_complex_values: usize,
11232    ) -> Result<Self, SpectralOperatorError> {
11233        let mut planner = FftPlanner::<f64>::new();
11234        let forward = [
11235            planner.plan_fft_forward(shape[0]),
11236            planner.plan_fft_forward(shape[1]),
11237        ];
11238        let inverse = [
11239            planner.plan_fft_inverse(shape[0]),
11240            planner.plan_fft_inverse(shape[1]),
11241        ];
11242        let lane_values = shape.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
11243        let scratch_values = forward
11244            .iter()
11245            .chain(&inverse)
11246            .map(|fft| fft.get_inplace_scratch_len())
11247            .max()
11248            .unwrap_or(0);
11249        let opaque_plan_values = shape
11250            .into_iter()
11251            .try_fold(0_usize, |total, length| {
11252                length
11253                    .checked_mul(FFT_PLAN_COMPLEX_BOUND_PER_AXIS)
11254                    .and_then(|values| total.checked_add(values))
11255            })
11256            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
11257        let required = lane_values
11258            .checked_add(scratch_values)
11259            .and_then(|values| values.checked_add(opaque_plan_values))
11260            .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)?;
11261        if required > reserved_complex_values {
11262            return Err(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow);
11263        }
11264        Ok(Self {
11265            forward,
11266            inverse,
11267            lane: vec![Complex64::default(); lane_values],
11268            scratch: vec![Complex64::default(); scratch_values],
11269        })
11270    }
11271
11272    pub(crate) fn transform(&mut self, data: &mut Array2<Complex64>, inverse: bool) {
11273        shift_even(data);
11274        self.transform_unshifted(data, inverse);
11275        shift_even(data);
11276    }
11277
11278    fn transform_unshifted(&mut self, data: &mut Array2<Complex64>, inverse: bool) {
11279        for axis in 0..2 {
11280            let fft = if inverse {
11281                &self.inverse[axis]
11282            } else {
11283                &self.forward[axis]
11284            };
11285            transform_axis(data, Axis(axis), fft, &mut self.lane, &mut self.scratch);
11286        }
11287    }
11288}
11289
11290impl fmt::Debug for PreparedFft {
11291    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
11292        formatter.write_str("PreparedFft")
11293    }
11294}
11295
11296fn transform_axis(
11297    data: &mut Array2<Complex64>,
11298    axis: Axis,
11299    fft: &Arc<dyn Fft<f64>>,
11300    lane_workspace: &mut [Complex64],
11301    scratch_workspace: &mut [Complex64],
11302) {
11303    let length = data.len_of(axis);
11304    let values = &mut lane_workspace[..length];
11305    let scratch = &mut scratch_workspace[..fft.get_inplace_scratch_len()];
11306    for mut lane in data.lanes_mut(axis) {
11307        for (target, value) in values.iter_mut().zip(lane.iter()) {
11308            *target = *value;
11309        }
11310        fft.process_with_scratch(values, scratch);
11311        for (target, value) in lane.iter_mut().zip(values.iter()) {
11312            *target = *value;
11313        }
11314    }
11315}
11316
11317fn shift_even(data: &mut Array2<Complex64>) {
11318    let [width, height] = [data.shape()[0], data.shape()[1]];
11319    debug_assert_eq!(width % 2, 0);
11320    debug_assert_eq!(height % 2, 0);
11321    for x in 0..width / 2 {
11322        for y in 0..height / 2 {
11323            data.swap((x, y), (x + width / 2, y + height / 2));
11324            data.swap((x + width / 2, y), (x, y + height / 2));
11325        }
11326    }
11327}
11328
11329fn build_normalized_tap_weights() -> Box<[[f64; TAP_COUNT]]> {
11330    let half = OVERSAMPLING as isize / 2;
11331    (-half..=half)
11332        .map(|offset| {
11333            let mut weights = [0.0; TAP_COUNT];
11334            let mut sum = 0.0;
11335            for (tap, delta) in (-(SUPPORT as isize)..=SUPPORT as isize).enumerate() {
11336                let lookup = (delta * OVERSAMPLING as isize + offset).unsigned_abs();
11337                let value = if lookup < OVERSAMPLING * SUPPORT {
11338                    spheroidal_kernel(lookup as f64 / OVERSAMPLING as f64, SUPPORT as f64)
11339                } else {
11340                    0.0
11341                };
11342                weights[tap] = value;
11343                sum += value;
11344            }
11345            if sum > 0.0 {
11346                for value in &mut weights {
11347                    *value /= sum;
11348                }
11349            }
11350            weights
11351        })
11352        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
11353        .into_boxed_slice()
11354}
11355
11356fn build_correction_axis(size: usize) -> Box<[f64]> {
11357    let center = size as f64 / 2.0;
11358    (0..size)
11359        .map(|index| {
11360            let nu = ((index as f64 - center).abs() / center).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
11361            let value = grdsf(nu);
11362            if value > 1.0e-6 {
11363                // casacore's ConvolveGridder correction vector is the raw
11364                // spheroidal response in each axis; image correction divides
11365                // by the product of those two vectors.  Do not renormalize to
11366                // the centre sample: grdsf(0) is close to, but not exactly,
11367                // one, and that changes the paired A/A* operator.
11368                1.0 / value
11369            } else {
11370                0.0
11371            }
11372        })
11373        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
11374        .into_boxed_slice()
11375}
11376
11377fn spheroidal_kernel(distance: f64, support: f64) -> f64 {
11378    if !(distance.is_finite() && distance <= support) {
11379        return 0.0;
11380    }
11381    let nu = distance / support;
11382    (1.0 - nu * nu) * grdsf(nu)
11383}
11384
11385fn grdsf(nu: f64) -> f64 {
11386    const P0: [f64; 5] = [
11387        8.203_343e-2,
11388        -3.644_705e-1,
11389        6.278_660e-1,
11390        -5.335_581e-1,
11391        2.312_756e-1,
11392    ];
11393    const P1: [f64; 5] = [
11394        4.028_559e-3,
11395        -3.697_768e-2,
11396        1.021_332e-1,
11397        -1.201_436e-1,
11398        6.412_774e-2,
11399    ];
11400    const Q0: [f64; 3] = [1.0, 8.212_018e-1, 2.078_043e-1];
11401    const Q1: [f64; 3] = [1.0, 9.599_102e-1, 2.918_724e-1];
11402    if !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&nu) {
11403        return 0.0;
11404    }
11405    let (p, q, end) = if nu < 0.75 {
11406        (&P0, &Q0, 0.75)
11407    } else {
11408        (&P1, &Q1, 1.0)
11409    };
11410    let delta = nu * nu - end * end;
11411    let numerator = p
11412        .iter()
11413        .enumerate()
11414        .map(|(order, value)| value * delta.powi(order as i32))
11415        .sum::<f64>();
11416    let denominator = q
11417        .iter()
11418        .enumerate()
11419        .map(|(order, value)| value * delta.powi(order as i32))
11420        .sum::<f64>();
11421    if denominator == 0.0 {
11422        0.0
11423    } else {
11424        numerator / denominator
11425    }
11426}
11427
11428fn casa_composite_padded_len(image_len: usize, factor: f64) -> usize {
11429    let mut padded = ((factor * image_len as f64 - 0.5).floor() as usize).max(image_len);
11430    if padded % 2 != 0 {
11431        padded += 1;
11432    }
11433    while !is_casa_composite_len(padded) {
11434        padded += 2;
11435    }
11436    padded
11437}
11438
11439fn is_casa_composite_len(mut value: usize) -> bool {
11440    for factor in [2, 3, 5] {
11441        while value > 1 && value % factor == 0 {
11442            value /= factor;
11443        }
11444    }
11445    value == 1
11446}
11447
11448fn checked_cells(shape: [usize; 2]) -> Result<usize, SpectralOperatorError> {
11449    shape[0]
11450        .checked_mul(shape[1])
11451        .ok_or(SpectralOperatorError::ResidencyOverflow)
11452}

11454/// Exact reason the spectral operator plan or operator rejected its input.
11455#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Error)]
11456pub enum SpectralOperatorError {
11457    /// An opt-in diagnostic requested an invalid or unbounded source-group capture.
11458    #[error(
11459        "invalid CASA_RS_TRACE_AW_GROUP: expected bounded start:end:ddid:spw:channels:4:accepted_hands"
11460    )]
11461    DiagnosticConfiguration,
11462    /// The complete requested diagnostic was emitted; no scientific completion is minted.
11463    #[error(
11464        "diagnostic stop: requested AW source group captured before FFT; not an acceptance run"
11465    )]
11466    DiagnosticStop,
11467    /// Diagnostic records expose missing, repeated, or differently admitted source samples.
11468    #[error(
11469        "diagnostic source coverage or accepted hand count differs; emitted records are diagnostic evidence, not acceptance"
11470    )]
11471    DiagnosticCoverageMismatch,
11472    /// The prepared paired AW operator rejected its cache or row-local input.
11473    #[error("AW projection failed: {0}")]
11474    AwProjection(#[from] crate::AwOperatorError),
11475    /// Runtime supplied science or weighting state for another compiled problem.
11476    #[error("spectral operator science and weighting state do not match the compiled problem")]
11477    ProblemMismatch,
11478    /// The problem is outside the supported scalar-response Stokes-I bases.
11479    #[error("spectral operator requires a supported scalar-response Stokes-I reconstruction basis")]
11480    UnsupportedProblem,
11481    /// Multi-domain execution is currently the constant-basis standard operator only.
11482    #[error("multi-domain spectral execution requires constant-basis standard imaging")]
11483    UnsupportedMultiDomainProblem,
11484    /// A requested output slab is empty or outside the compiled spectral axis.
11485    #[error("spectral operator slab is empty or outside the output spectral axis")]
11486    InvalidSlab,
11487    /// A sparse stencil contributing to the core escaped its sampler-derived halo.
11488    #[error("spectral operator slab lacks the complete paired spectral stencil halo")]
11489    IncompleteSpectralHalo,
11490    /// The current serial operator supports only centered identity-PC SIN geometry.
11491    #[error("spectral operator does not support this direction-coordinate geometry")]
11492    UnsupportedGeometry,
11493    /// The current serial operator requires permitted f64 compensated arithmetic.
11494    #[error("spectral operator requires f64 compensated numerical semantics")]
11495    UnsupportedNumerics,
11496    /// A resident-byte calculation overflowed.
11497    #[error("spectral operator residency cannot be represented")]
11498    ResidencyOverflow,
11499    /// A weighted contribution contains an invalid numerical value.
11500    #[error("spectral operator sample is non-finite or outside its numerical domain")]
11501    InvalidSample,
11502    /// Selected row geometry did not provide one canonical projection per image domain.
11503    #[error("selected row image-domain projections do not match the compiled geometry")]
11504    DomainProjectionMismatch,
11505    /// The operator generated a non-finite value under a rejecting numerics contract.
11506    #[error("spectral operator generated a non-finite value")]
11507    GeneratedNonfinite,
11508    /// Weighted blocks arrived out of canonical replay order.
11509    #[error("spectral operator weighted block sequence is not canonical")]
11510    BlockSequence,
11511    /// Weighted blocks or completion carry different frozen W generations.
11512    #[error("spectral operator weighting generation changed during replay")]
11513    WeightingGeneration,
11514    /// A replay count could not be represented.
11515    #[error("spectral operator replay coverage overflowed")]
11516    CoverageOverflow,
11517    /// Terminal T18 evidence does not cover every consumed weighted block.
11518    #[error("spectral operator replay completion does not match consumed coverage")]
11519    IncompleteCoverage,
11520    /// A prediction model does not match the planned image shape.
11521    #[error("spectral operator model does not match the planned image shape")]
11522    ModelShape,
11523    /// A different model was named after residual replay was prepared.
11524    #[error("spectral operator residual belongs to another final model generation")]
11525    ModelMismatch,
11526    /// Residual replay was bound more than once or after samples were consumed.
11527    #[error("spectral operator major-cycle model must be bound exactly once before replay")]
11528    MajorCycleAlreadyBound,
11529    /// A diagnostic prediction attempted to replace the bound final-model grid.
11530    #[error("spectral operator prediction is unavailable after major-cycle model binding")]
11531    PredictionAfterMajorCycleBinding,
11532    /// T20 attempted to finalize T19 output that never accumulated an exact residual.
11533    #[error("spectral operator output lacks an exhaustive paired-operator residual")]
11534    MissingMajorCycleResidual,
11535    /// A later major pass did not carry the exact prior invariant normal state.
11536    #[error("spectral operator reusable normal state does not match the residual refresh")]
11537    ReusableNormalStateMismatch,
11538    /// Gridded replay cannot represent the compiled basis and kernel combination.
11539    #[error(
11540        "gridded normal-operator replay does not support the compiled basis/kernel combination"
11541    )]
11542    UnsupportedGriddedReplay,
11543    /// An opaque record, block, program, or invariant belongs to another replay.
11544    #[error("gridded normal-operator record does not match the sealed replay")]
11545    GriddedRecordMismatch,
11546    /// An opaque record has an unsupported, truncated, or invalid fixed encoding.
11547    #[error("gridded normal-operator record encoding is invalid")]
11548    InvalidGriddedRecord,
11549    /// A worker panicked while mutating one exclusive gridded-normal sector.
11550    #[error("gridded normal-operator sector state was poisoned")]
11551    GriddedSectorPoisoned,
11552}

11615    #[test]
11616    fn t51_aw_prediction_retains_original_w_and_transformed_grid_placement() {
11617        let slab = operator();
11618        let frequency_hz = 1.0e9;
11619        let transformed = [2.0, -3.0, 100.0];
11620        let selected =
11621            SpectralOperatorSample::new(0, transformed, frequency_hz, 0.0, [0.0; 2], 1.0, 1.0)
11622                .unwrap();
11623        assert_eq!(
11624            super::AwReplayCoordinates::from_sample(selected),
11625            Err(SpectralOperatorError::InvalidSample),
11626            "missing original W cannot enter AW replay"
11627        );
11628        for original_w_m in [-125.0, 0.0, 75.0] {
11629            let sample = selected
11630                .with_aw_coordinates([0.0; 2], [0.0; 2], 0, original_w_m)
11631                .unwrap();
11632            let coordinates = super::AwReplayCoordinates::from_sample(sample).unwrap();
11633            assert_eq!(coordinates.uvw_m, transformed);
11634            assert_eq!(coordinates.prediction_w_m, original_w_m);
11635            let scale = frequency_hz / super::SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S;
11636            let position = [2.0 * scale * 0.02 + 4.0, 3.0 * scale * 0.02 + 3.0];
11637            let expected = |w_m| {
11638                AwVisibilitySample::new(frequency_hz, 1.0, w_m * scale, 0, 0.0, position, [0.0; 2])
11639                    .unwrap()
11640            };
11641            assert_eq!(
11642                slab.aw_visibility_sample(coordinates, [1, 2], false)
11643                    .unwrap(),
11644                expected(transformed[2]),
11645                "gridding retains the transformed W selector"
11646            );
11647            assert_eq!(
11648                slab.aw_visibility_sample(coordinates, [1, 2], true)
11649                    .unwrap(),
11650                expected(original_w_m),
11651                "prediction uses source W without changing transformed UV placement"
11652            );
11653        }
11654        assert!(
11655            selected
11656                .with_aw_coordinates([0.0; 2], [0.0; 2], 0, f64::NAN)
11657                .is_err()
11658        );
11659    }

11707    #[test]
11708    fn t51_aw_gridding_binds_asymmetric_parallel_hands_after_mueller_selection() {
11709        use CorrelationType::{CircularLl, CircularLr, CircularRl, CircularRr};
11710
11711        let correlations = [CircularLl, CircularRl, CircularRr, CircularLr];
11712        let observed = [
11713            Complex64::new(-5.0, 7.0),
11714            Complex64::new(99.0, 99.0),
11715            Complex64::new(2.0, 3.0),
11716            Complex64::new(99.0, 99.0),
11717        ];
11718        let predicted = [
11719            Complex64::new(-2.0, 1.0),
11720            Complex64::default(),
11721            Complex64::new(0.5, -0.25),
11722            Complex64::default(),
11723        ];
11724        let kernels = [Complex64::new(2.0, 1.0), Complex64::new(3.0, -2.0)];
11725        for w_m in [1.0, -1.0, 0.0, -0.0] {
11726            let mut dirty = Complex64::default();
11727            let mut residual = Complex64::default();
11728            let mut psf = Complex64::default();
11729            for (hand, row) in [2, 0].into_iter().enumerate() {
11730                let input = super::aw_gridding_input_index(&correlations, row, w_m).unwrap();
11731                let selected = if w_m > 0.0 { hand } else { 1 - hand };
11732                let kernel = if w_m > 0.0 {
11733                    kernels[selected].conj()
11734                } else {
11735                    kernels[selected]
11736                };
11737                dirty += kernel * observed[input];
11738                residual += kernel * (observed[input] - predicted[input]);
11739                psf += kernel;
11740            }
11741            let [rr_kernel, ll_kernel] = if w_m > 0.0 {
11742                kernels.map(|value| value.conj())
11743            } else {
11744                kernels
11745            };
11746            assert_eq!(
11747                dirty,
11748                rr_kernel * observed[2] + ll_kernel * observed[0],
11749                "W={w_m}"
11750            );
11751            assert_eq!(
11752                residual,
11753                rr_kernel * (observed[2] - predicted[2]) + ll_kernel * (observed[0] - predicted[0]),
11754                "W={w_m}",
11755            );
11756            assert_eq!(psf, rr_kernel + ll_kernel, "PSF is visibility independent");
11757        }
11758    }

11778        assert_eq!(sensitivity[0], expected_corner);
11779        assert_ne!(sensitivity[0], sensitivity[centre]);

11818    #[test]
11819    fn t49_w_projection_grid_and_degrid_are_adjoint() {
11820        let mut geometry = geometry();
11821        geometry.image_shape = [48, 48];
11822        geometry.grid_shape = [64, 64];
11823        geometry.image_blc = [8, 8];
11824        let operator = ConvolutionOperator::new(
11825            &geometry,
11826            Some(
11827                casa_imaging_model::WProjectionContract::new(
11828                    10_000.0,
11829                    std::num::NonZeroUsize::new(9),
11830                )
11831                .unwrap(),
11832            ),
11833        )
11834        .unwrap();
11835        let taps = operator
11836            .taps([12.25, -7.5, 4_000.0])
11837            .expect("sample fits W kernel support");
11838        let value = Complex64::new(0.75, -0.4);
11839        let shape = (geometry.grid_shape[0], geometry.grid_shape[1]);
11840        let mut gridded = Array2::zeros(shape);
11841        let mut compensation = Array2::zeros(shape);
11842        operator
11843            .grid_compensated(&mut gridded, &mut compensation, taps, value)
11844            .unwrap();
11845        let data = Array2::from_shape_fn(shape, |(x, y)| {
11846            Complex64::new((x * 3 + y) as f64 / 97.0, (x + y * 2) as f64 / 113.0)
11847        });
11848        let left = gridded
11849            .iter()
11850            .zip(data.iter())
11851            .map(|(x, y)| x.conj() * y)
11852            .sum::<Complex64>();
11853        let right = value.conj() * operator.degrid(&data, taps).unwrap();
11854        assert!((left - right).norm() < 1.0e-11, "{left:?} != {right:?}");
11855    }

11857    #[test]
11858    fn t49_w_projection_kernel_diagnostics_are_explicit_and_finite() {
11859        let mut geometry = geometry();
11860        geometry.image_shape = [48, 48];
11861        geometry.grid_shape = [64, 64];
11862        geometry.image_blc = [8, 8];
11863        let operator = ConvolutionOperator::new(
11864            &geometry,
11865            Some(
11866                casa_imaging_model::WProjectionContract::new(
11867                    10_000.0,
11868                    std::num::NonZeroUsize::new(9),
11869                )
11870                .unwrap(),
11871            ),
11872        )
11873        .unwrap();
11874        let ConvolutionOperator::WProjection(w_projection) = &operator else {
11875            panic!("nonzero W must compile the W-projection operator");
11876        };
11877        let diagnostics = operator.w_projection_diagnostics().expect("W diagnostics");
11878        assert_eq!(diagnostics.plane_count(), 9);
11879        assert_eq!(diagnostics.sampling(), 4);
11880        assert_eq!(
11881            diagnostics.maximum_support(),
11882            w_projection.maximum_support()
11883        );
11884        assert!(diagnostics.plane_zero_normalization().is_finite());
11885        assert_ne!(diagnostics.kernel_identity(), [0; 32]);
11886        assert_eq!(w_projection.sampling, 4);
11887        assert_eq!(w_projection.kernels.len(), 9);
11888        assert!(w_projection.w_scale.is_finite() && w_projection.w_scale > 0.0);
11889        assert!(w_projection.kernels.iter().all(|kernel| {
11890            kernel.support > 0
11891                && kernel
11892                    .weights
11893                    .iter()
11894                    .all(|weight| weight.re.is_finite() && weight.im.is_finite())
11895        }));
11896        assert!(
11897            (super::w_projection_kernel_sum(&w_projection.kernels[0], w_projection.sampling) - 1.0)
11898                .abs()
11899                < 1.0e-12
11900        );
11901        assert!(
11902            w_projection
11903                .kernels
11904                .last()
11905                .unwrap()
11906                .weights
11907                .iter()
11908                .any(|weight| weight.im.abs() > 1.0e-12),
11909            "a nonzero-W plane must carry a complex phase screen"
11910        );
11911        assert_eq!(operator.taps([0.0, 0.0, f64::NAN]), None);
11912    }

11914    #[test]
11915    #[ignore = "requires retained native 512-square AW grid and completion traces"]
11916    fn t51_native_aw_completion_matches_production_fft_and_normalization() {
11917        let grid_path = std::env::var("CASA_RS_T51_NATIVE_GRID").expect("native grid trace");
11918        let completion_path =
11919            std::env::var("CASA_RS_T51_NATIVE_COMPLETION").expect("native completion trace");
11920        let mut grid = Array2::zeros((512, 512));
11921        let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
11922        for line in std::fs::read_to_string(grid_path).unwrap().lines() {
11923            let fields = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
11924            if fields.first() != Some(&"actual_psf_grid") {
11925                continue;
11926            }
11927            let x = fields[1].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
11928            let y = fields[2].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
11929            assert!(seen.insert((x, y)), "duplicate grid coordinate");
11930            grid[(x, y)] = Complex64::new(fields[3].parse().unwrap(), fields[4].parse().unwrap());
11931        }
11932        assert!(!seen.is_empty());
11933        let mut geometry = geometry();
11934        geometry.image_shape = [512, 512];
11935        geometry.grid_shape = [512, 512];
11936        geometry.image_blc = [0, 0];
11937        let reserved = super::fft_resident_complex_values_for_shape([512, 512]).unwrap();
11938        PreparedFft::new([512, 512], reserved)
11939            .unwrap()
11940            .transform(&mut grid, true);
11941        let gridder = ConvolutionOperator::new(&geometry, None).unwrap();
11942        let mut image = collect_image_planes(Some(&[grid]), &geometry, &gridder, Some(20))
11943            .unwrap()
11944            .unwrap();
11945        normalize_direction_dependent_psf(&mut image, 512 * 512, &[1.0]).unwrap();
11946        let mut squared_error = 0.0;
11947        let mut squared_reference = 0.0;
11948        seen.clear();
11949        for line in std::fs::read_to_string(completion_path).unwrap().lines() {
11950            let fields = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
11951            if fields.first() != Some(&"completed_psf") {
11952                continue;
11953            }
11954            let x = fields[1].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
11955            let y = fields[2].parse::<usize>().unwrap();
11956            assert!(x < 512 && y < 512 && seen.insert((x, y)));
11957            let reference = fields[5].parse::<f64>().unwrap();
11958            squared_error += (image[x * 512 + y].re - reference).powi(2);
11959            squared_reference += reference.powi(2);
11960        }
11961        assert_eq!(seen.len(), 512 * 512);
11962        let nrms = (squared_error / squared_reference).sqrt();
11963        eprintln!("native AW completion NRMS: {nrms:.12e}");
11964        assert!(nrms <= 1.0e-3);
11965    }

12059    #[test]
12060    fn mosaic_response_routes_use_full_nonuniform_spw_and_ignore_replay_partitions() {
12061        let measurement_set = MeasurementSetIdentity::new(LogicalIdentity::from_sha256([47; 32]));
12062        let full_spw = [
12063            230.0e9,
12064            230.000_4e9,
12065            230.007e9,
12066            230.025e9,
12067            230.08e9,
12068            400.0e9,
12069        ];
12070        let selected = [1_u32, 3, 4];
12071        let first_width_hz = 1.0e6;
12072        let selections = [MosaicResponseSelection {
12073            measurement_set,
12074            spectral_window_id: 3,
12075            channel_indices: selected.into(),
12076            coordinate_catalog: SpectralWindowCoordinateCatalog::new(full_spw, first_width_hz)
12077                .expect("valid physical SPW catalog"),
12078        }];
12079        let frame_scale = 0.999_95;
12080        let frequencies = selected.map(|channel| full_spw[channel as usize] * frame_scale);
12081        let run = |chunks: &[&[u32]]| {
12082            let mut plan = MosaicResponsePlan::with_capacity(selected.len() * 3);
12083            let mut responses = Vec::new();
12084            let antenna_responses = SelectedAntennaResponses {
12085                antenna1: casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass::CasaAlma12m,
12086                antenna2: casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass::CasaAca7m,
12087                family_envelope: casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass::CasaAlma12m,
12088            };
12089            for channel in chunks.iter().flat_map(|chunk| chunk.iter().copied()) {
12090                let selected_ordinal = selected
12091                    .iter()
12092                    .position(|candidate| *candidate == channel)
12093                    .expect("selected channel");
12094                responses.push(
12095                    plan.response(
12096                        &selections,
12097                        mosaic_address(
12098                            measurement_set,
12099                            7,
12100                            channel,
12101                            full_spw[channel as usize],
12102                            first_width_hz,
12103                        ),
12104                        frequencies[selected_ordinal],
12105                        Some(antenna_responses),
12106                    )
12107                    .expect("selected channel has a bounded mosaic route")
12108                    .expect("mosaic response is active"),
12109                );
12110            }
12111            (responses, plan.responses)
12112        };
12113
12114        let whole_row = run(&[&selected]);
12115        let split_every_channel = run(&[&[1], &[3], &[4]]);
12116        assert_eq!(split_every_channel, whole_row);
12117        assert_eq!(
12118            whole_row.1.len(),
12119            selected.len(),
12120            "one bounded route per selected channel"
12121        );
12122        assert!(
12123            whole_row
12124                .0
12125                .windows(2)
12126                .all(|pair| pair[0].key == pair[1].key),
12127            "a narrow spectral window reuses one CASA-scale response bin"
12128        );
12129        let (_, expected) =
12130            casa_useful_mosaic_channels(&full_spw, first_width_hz, &selected, &frequencies)
12131                .unwrap();
12132        assert!(
12133            whole_row
12134                .0
12135                .iter()
12136                .all(|response| response.frequency_hz == expected[0])
12137        );
12138        let inferred_selected =
12139            selected.map(|channel| full_spw[1] + f64::from(channel - 1) * first_width_hz);
12140        let inferred_indices = [0, 1, 2];
12141        let (_, inferred) = casa_useful_mosaic_channels(
12142            &inferred_selected,
12143            first_width_hz,
12144            &inferred_indices,
12145            &frequencies,
12146        )
12147        .unwrap();
12148        assert_ne!(
12149            expected, inferred,
12150            "unselected nonuniform coordinates must affect CASA response placement"
12151        );
12152
12153        let mut reversal_plan = MosaicResponsePlan::with_capacity(selected.len() * 4);
12154        let address = mosaic_address(
12155            measurement_set,
12156            7,
12157            selected[0],
12158            full_spw[selected[0] as usize],
12159            first_width_hz,
12160        );
12161        let forward = SelectedAntennaResponses {
12162            antenna1: casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass::CasaAlma12m,
12163            antenna2: casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass::CasaAca7m,
12164            family_envelope: casa_imaging_model::AntennaResponseClass::CasaAlma12m,
12165        };
12166        let reverse = SelectedAntennaResponses {
12167            antenna1: forward.antenna2,
12168            antenna2: forward.antenna1,
12169            family_envelope: forward.family_envelope,
12170        };
12171        let forward_response = reversal_plan
12172            .response(&selections, address, frequencies[0], Some(forward))
12173            .unwrap()
12174            .unwrap();
12175        let reverse_response = reversal_plan
12176            .response(&selections, address, frequencies[0], Some(reverse))
12177            .unwrap()
12178            .unwrap();
12179        assert_eq!(forward_response.key, reverse_response.key);
12180        assert_eq!(forward_response.antenna_responses, forward);
12181        assert_eq!(reverse_response.antenna_responses, reverse);
12182        assert_eq!(reversal_plan.responses.len(), selected.len() * 2);
12183    }

12185    fn workload() -> SpectralOperatorWorkload {
12186        let grid_cells = 10 * 10;
12187        let image_cells = 8 * 8;
12188        let coefficient_terms = 1;
12189        let normal_moments = 1;
12190        let resident_model_terms = 1;
12191        let total_model_terms = 1;

12193            pass: SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor,
12194            slab: SpectralSlabPlan {
12195                total_channels: 1,
12196                core_start: 0,
12197                core_end: 1,
12198                resident_start: 0,
12199                resident_end: 1,
12200            },
12201            grid_shape: [10, 10],
12202            grid_complex_values: grid_cells * (4 * coefficient_terms + 2 * normal_moments),
12203            convolution_f64_values: 727,
12204            fft_resident_complex_values: 7_690,
12205            fft_planning_words: 320,
12206            forward_complex_values: grid_cells * resident_model_terms + 3,
12207            primitive_complex_values: image_cells * (3 * coefficient_terms + normal_moments),
12208            primitive_f64_values: image_cells * normal_moments + 2 * normal_moments,
12209            fold_accumulator_complex_values: image_cells * (3 * coefficient_terms + normal_moments),
12210            fold_accumulator_f64_values: image_cells * normal_moments + 2 * normal_moments,
12211            response_f32_values: 0,
12212            mosaic_state_bytes: 0,
12213            mosaic_workspace_bytes: 0,
12214            primitive_validity_values: 1,
12215            fold_accumulator_validity_values: 1,
12216            coefficient_terms,
12217            normal_moments,
12218            resident_model_terms,
12219            total_model_terms,
12220            max_replay_block_samples: 3,
12221            initial_phase_residency: None,
12222        }
12223    }

12258    impl AwPreparedCellProvider for ObserverAwProvider {
12259        fn load(
12260            &mut self,
12261            metadata: &AwPreparedCellMetadata,
12262            resident_byte_ceiling: usize,
12263        ) -> Result<AwPreparedCellLease, AwOperatorError> {
12264            let cell = &self
12265                .cells
12266                .iter()
12267                .find(|(identity, _)| *identity == metadata.identity())
12268                .ok_or(AwOperatorError::InvalidCatalogLayout)?
12269                .1;
12270            if cell.resident_bytes() > resident_byte_ceiling {
12271                return Err(AwOperatorError::ResidencyCeilingExceeded);
12272            }
12273            Ok(AwPreparedCellLease::new(
12274                cell.clone(),
12275                AwPreparedCellDisposition::Loaded,
12276                0,
12277                0,
12278            ))
12279        }
12280    }

12340    #[test]
12341    fn t51_direct_taylor_aw_replay_matches_source_action_with_signed_weights_and_hands() {
12342        let layout = AwKernelLayout::new([0, 0], 1, [3, 3], [1, 1]).unwrap();
12343        let mut metadata = Vec::new();
12344        let mut cells = Vec::new();
12345        for (mueller, kernel) in [
12346            (0, Complex64::new(3.0, 4.0)),
12347            (15, Complex64::new(7.0, -2.0)),
12348        ] {
12349            let identity = PreparedArtifactScientificIdentity::convolution_function(
12350                PreparedArtifactCellSemantics::new(
12351                    1.0e9,
12352                    1.0,
12353                    mueller,
12354                    mueller,
12355                    0.0,
12356                    1.0e9,
12357                    15 - mueller,
12358                    "EVLA",
12359                    "L",
12360                    25.0,
12361                    1.0,
12362                    PreparedArtifactAwInterpretation::Wavelength,
12363                    false,
12364                    "discrete-complex-sum",
12365                )
12366                .unwrap(),
12367            )
12368            .unwrap();
12369            metadata.push(
12370                AwPreparedCellMetadata::new(
12371                    identity, 1.0e9, 1.0, 1.0, mueller, 0.0, layout, layout,
12372                )
12373                .unwrap(),
12374            );
12375            let mut values = vec![Complex64::default(); 9];
12376            values[4] = kernel;
12377            let convolution = AwConvolutionKernel::new(layout, values).unwrap();
12378            cells.push((
12379                identity,
12380                Arc::new(
12381                    AwConvolutionCell::new(identity, convolution.clone(), convolution).unwrap(),
12382                ),
12383            ));
12384        }
12385        let prepared = crate::PreparedAwProjection::new(
12386            AwPreparedCatalog::new(metadata).unwrap(),
12387            ObserverAwProvider { cells },
12388            false,
12389            64 * 1024,
12390        )
12391        .unwrap();
12392        let workload = workload();
12393        let mut source = SpectralSlabOperator::new_inner(
12394            super::SpectralSlabDefinition {
12395                specification: None,
12396                chart_ordinal: 0,
12397                domain_ordinal: 0,
12398                facet_ordinal: 0,
12399                window: None,
12400                geometry: geometry(),
12401                slab: workload.slab,
12402                basis: SpectralBasisPlan::Polynomial(BlockNormalPlan::taylor(1.0e9, 2).unwrap()),
12403                polarization_count: 1,
12404                joint_line_term_by_channel: vec![None].into_boxed_slice(),
12405                output_channel_frequencies_hz: vec![1.0e9].into_boxed_slice(),
12406                instrument_model: None,
12407                w_projection: None,
12408                mosaic: false,
12409                primary_beam_cutoff: 0.0,
12410                aw_projection: Some(prepared),
12411            },
12412            workload,
12413            PreparedFft::new([10, 10], workload.fft_resident_complex_values).unwrap(),
12414            3,
12415        )
12416        .unwrap();
12417        for (term, grid) in source.forward_grids.iter_mut().enumerate() {
12418            for ((x, y), value) in grid.indexed_iter_mut() {
12419                *value = Complex64::new(
12420                    (x + 3 * y + 5 * term) as f64 / 31.0,
12421                    (2 * x + y + term) as f64 / 23.0,
12422                );
12423            }
12424        }
12425        let mut replay_grids = vec![Array2::zeros((10, 10)); 2];
12426        let mut replay_errors = replay_grids.clone();
12427        let correlations = [CorrelationType::CircularRr, CorrelationType::CircularLl];
12428        for frequency_hz in [0.91e9, 1.19e9] {
12429            for w_m in [2.0, -2.0] {
12430                for (hand, mueller) in [0, 15].into_iter().enumerate() {
12431                    let weight = if hand == 0 { 0.1 } else { 0.31 };
12432                    let sample = SpectralOperatorSample::new(
12433                        0,
12434                        [0.25, -0.4, w_m],
12435                        frequency_hz,
12436                        0.012,
12437                        [0.0; 2],
12438                        weight,
12439                        1.0,
12440                    )
12441                    .unwrap()
12442                    .with_aw_coordinates([0.0; 2], [0.0; 2], mueller, -1.5 * w_m)
12443                    .unwrap();
12444                    let selected_hand =
12445                        super::aw_gridding_input_index(&correlations, hand, w_m).unwrap();
12446                    let mut input_sample = sample;
12447                    input_sample.mueller_element = [0, 15][selected_hand];
12448                    let source_prediction =
12449                        source.predict_one_polarization(input_sample, 0).unwrap();
12450                    let coordinates = super::AwReplayCoordinates::from_sample(sample).unwrap();
12451                    let forward_scale = sample.phase().conj();
12452                    let replay_prediction = source
12453                        .predict_gridded_normal_aw_polarization(0, 0, coordinates, forward_scale)
12454                        .unwrap();
12455                    assert!(
12456                        (source_prediction - replay_prediction).norm()
12457                            <= 1.0e-6 * source_prediction.norm().max(1.0)
12458                    );
12459                    let mut gridding_sample = sample;
12460                    gridding_sample.visibility = source_prediction;
12461                    for _ in 0..3 {
12462                        source.push(gridding_sample).unwrap();
12463                    }
12464                    let psf_before = source.psf_grids.clone();
12465                    source
12466                        .grid_gridded_normal_local_aw_polarization(
12467                            &mut replay_grids,
12468                            &mut replay_errors,
12469                            [0, 0],
12470                            0,
12471                            0,
12472                            replay_prediction,
12473                            forward_scale.conj(),
12474                            weight * 3.0,
12475                            coordinates,
12476                        )
12477                        .unwrap();
12478                    assert_eq!(
12479                        source.psf_grids, psf_before,
12480                        "replay cannot mutate frozen normal moments"
12481                    );
12482                }
12483            }
12484        }
12485        let source_grids = source.dirty_grids.unwrap();
12486        let squared_error: f64 = source_grids
12487            .iter()
12488            .flatten()
12489            .zip(replay_grids.iter().flatten())
12490            .map(|(left, right)| (*left - *right).norm_sqr())
12491            .sum();
12492        let squared_signal: f64 = source_grids.iter().flatten().map(Complex64::norm_sqr).sum();
12493        let nrms = (squared_error / squared_signal).sqrt();
12494        eprintln!("t51_direct_taylor_aw_source_replay_nrms={nrms:.17e}");
12495        assert!(nrms <= 0.001, "coordinate-backed Taylor replay NRMS {nrms}");
12496    }

12498    fn inner(left: &[Complex64], right: &[Complex64]) -> Complex64 {
12499        left.iter()
12500            .zip(right)
12501            .map(|(left, right)| left.conj() * right)
12502            .sum()
12503    }

12505    fn legacy_v1_normal_content_identity(
12506        primitives: &SpectralOperatorPrimitives,
12507    ) -> casa_imaging_model::LogicalIdentity {
12508        let mut encoder = crate::Encoder::new(super::NORMAL_STATE_CONTENT_DOMAIN, 1);
12509        encoder.usize(primitives.shape()[0]);
12510        encoder.usize(primitives.shape()[1]);
12511        encoder.usize(primitives.slab().total_channels());
12512        encoder.usize(primitives.slab().core_range().start);
12513        encoder.usize(primitives.slab().core_range().end);
12514        for value in primitives.dirty() {
12515            encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
12516            encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
12517        }
12518        for value in primitives.psf() {
12519            encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
12520            encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
12521        }
12522        for value in primitives.sensitivity() {
12523            encoder.u64(crate::canonical_f64_bits(*value));
12524        }
12525        for value in primitives.sum_weights() {
12526            encoder.u64(crate::canonical_f64_bits(*value));
12527        }
12528        for validity in primitives.channel_validity() {
12529            encoder.u8(match validity {
12530                SpectralChannelValidity::Valid => 0,
12531                SpectralChannelValidity::Blank => 1,
12532                SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped => 2,
12533            });
12534        }
12535        casa_imaging_model::LogicalIdentity::from_sha256(encoder.finish())
12536    }
12537
12538    fn t42_v2_normal_content_identity_with_metadata(
12539        primitives: &SpectralOperatorPrimitives,
12540        reference_frequency_hz: f64,
12541        coefficient_terms: usize,
12542        normal_moments: usize,
12543    ) -> casa_imaging_model::LogicalIdentity {
12544        let mut encoder = crate::Encoder::new(super::NORMAL_STATE_CONTENT_DOMAIN, 2);
12545        encoder.usize(primitives.shape()[0]);
12546        encoder.usize(primitives.shape()[1]);
12547        encoder.usize(primitives.slab().total_channels());
12548        encoder.usize(primitives.slab().core_range().start);
12549        encoder.usize(primitives.slab().core_range().end);
12550        encoder.u64(crate::canonical_f64_bits(reference_frequency_hz));
12551        encoder.usize(coefficient_terms);
12552        encoder.usize(normal_moments);
12553        for value in primitives.dirty() {
12554            encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
12555            encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
12556        }
12557        for value in primitives.psf() {
12558            encoder.u64(value.re.to_bits());
12559            encoder.u64(value.im.to_bits());
12560        }
12561        for value in primitives.sensitivity() {
12562            encoder.u64(crate::canonical_f64_bits(*value));
12563        }
12564        for value in primitives.sum_weights() {
12565            encoder.u64(crate::canonical_f64_bits(*value));
12566        }
12567        for validity in primitives.channel_validity() {
12568            encoder.u8(match validity {
12569                SpectralChannelValidity::Valid => 0,
12570                SpectralChannelValidity::Blank => 1,
12571                SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped => 2,
12572            });
12573        }
12574        casa_imaging_model::LogicalIdentity::from_sha256(encoder.finish())
12575    }

12577    fn cube_slab(core_start: usize, core_depth: usize) -> SpectralSlabPlan {
12578        SpectralSlabPlan::compile(4, core_start, core_depth, SpectralKernel::Linear)
12579            .expect("valid cube slab")
12580    }
12581
12582    fn cube_operator(slab: SpectralSlabPlan) -> SpectralSlabOperator {
12583        cube_operator_with_geometry(slab, geometry())
12584    }
12585
12586    fn cube_operator_with_geometry(
12587        slab: SpectralSlabPlan,
12588        geometry: SpectralOperatorGeometry,
12589    ) -> SpectralSlabOperator {
12590        let cells = 10 * 10;
12591        let image_cells = 8 * 8;
12592        let coefficient_terms = slab.core_depth();
12593        let normal_moments = slab.core_depth();
12594        let resident_model_terms = slab.resident_depth();
12595        let total_model_terms = slab.total_channels();
12596        let workload = SpectralOperatorWorkload {
12597            pass: SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor,
12598            slab,
12599            grid_shape: [10, 10],
12600            grid_complex_values: cells * (4 * coefficient_terms + 2 * normal_moments),
12601            convolution_f64_values: 727,
12602            fft_resident_complex_values: 7_690,
12603            fft_planning_words: 320,
12604            forward_complex_values: cells * resident_model_terms + 4,
12605            primitive_complex_values: image_cells * (3 * coefficient_terms + normal_moments),
12606            primitive_f64_values: image_cells * normal_moments + 2 * normal_moments,
12607            fold_accumulator_complex_values: image_cells * 4 * slab.total_channels(),
12608            fold_accumulator_f64_values: image_cells * slab.total_channels()
12609                + 2 * slab.total_channels(),
12610            response_f32_values: 0,
12611            mosaic_state_bytes: 0,
12612            mosaic_workspace_bytes: 0,
12613            primitive_validity_values: slab.core_depth(),
12614            fold_accumulator_validity_values: slab.total_channels(),
12615            coefficient_terms,
12616            normal_moments,
12617            resident_model_terms,
12618            total_model_terms,
12619            max_replay_block_samples: 4,
12620            initial_phase_residency: None,
12621        };
12622        let fft = PreparedFft::new([10, 10], workload.fft_resident_complex_values)
12623            .expect("reserved FFT workspace");
12624        SpectralSlabOperator::new_with_geometry(geometry, slab, workload, fft)
12625    }
12626
12627    fn cube_model() -> Vec<Complex64> {
12628        let cells = checked_cells(geometry().image_shape).expect("shape");
12629        (0..4)
12630            .flat_map(|channel| {
12631                (0..cells).map(move |pixel| {
12632                    Complex64::new(
12633                        channel as f64 * 0.2 + pixel as f64 * 0.003,
12634                        channel as f64 * -0.04 + pixel as f64 * 0.001,
12635                    )
12636                })
12637            })
12638            .collect()
12639    }
12640
12641    fn cube_stencils() -> Vec<Vec<SpectralOperatorSample>> {
12642        let stencil = |terms: &[(usize, f64)], uvw, visibility, weight, frequency_hz| {
12643            terms
12644                .iter()
12645                .map(|(channel, factor)| {
12646                    SpectralOperatorSample::new(
12647                        *channel,
12648                        uvw,
12649                        frequency_hz,
12650                        0.017,
12651                        visibility,
12652                        weight,
12653                        *factor,
12654                    )
12655                    .expect("valid cube contribution")
12656                })
12657                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
12658        };
12659        vec![
12660            stencil(
12661                &[(0, 0.5), (1, 0.5)],
12662                [7.0, -3.0, 0.0],
12663                [1.0, -0.2],
12664                2.0,
12665                1.01e9,
12666            ),
12667            stencil(
12668                &[(1, 1.25), (2, -0.25)],
12669                [-5.0, 9.0, 0.0],
12670                [-0.3, 0.8],
12671                0.75,
12672                1.02e9,
12673            ),
12674            stencil(&[(2, 1.0)], [2.0, 4.0, 0.0], [0.4, 0.1], 0.0, 1.03e9),
12675        ]
12676    }
12677
12678    fn cube_primitives(core_start: usize, core_depth: usize) -> SpectralOperatorPrimitives {
12679        let mut operator = cube_operator(cube_slab(core_start, core_depth));
12680        for stencil in cube_stencils() {
12681            for sample in stencil {
12682                operator.push(sample).expect("cube adjoint");
12683            }
12684        }
12685        operator.finish().expect("cube primitives")
12686    }

12688    #[test]
12689    fn forward_and_weighted_adjoint_share_one_operator() {
12690        let sample_values = samples(&[[0.4, -0.7], [-1.2, 0.3], [0.8, 1.1]]);
12691        let model = (0..checked_cells(geometry().image_shape).expect("shape"))
12692            .map(|index| Complex64::new(index as f64 * 0.01 - 0.2, index as f64 * -0.003))
12693            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
12694        let prediction = operator()
12695            .predict(&model, &sample_values)
12696            .expect("prediction");
12697        let visibility = sample_values
12698            .iter()
12699            .map(|sample| sample.visibility)
12700            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
12701        let weighted_visibility = sample_values
12702            .iter()
12703            .map(|sample| sample.visibility * sample.imaging_weight)
12704            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
12705        let mut adjoint = operator();
12706        for sample in &sample_values {
12707            adjoint.push(*sample).expect("adjoint sample");
12708        }
12709        let dirty = adjoint.finish().expect("finite primitives");
12710        let left = inner(&prediction, &weighted_visibility);
12711        let right = inner(&model, dirty.dirty());
12712        assert!((left - right).norm() <= 1.0e-9 * left.norm().max(right.norm()).max(1.0));
12713        assert_eq!(visibility.len(), prediction.len());
12714    }
