12789    #[test]
12790    fn terminal_grid_support_remains_part_of_the_paired_operator() {
12791        let geometry = geometry();
12792        let gridder = StandardConvolution::new(&geometry);
12793        let uv_lambda = [1.25 * gridder.du_lambda, -1.25 * gridder.dv_lambda];
12794        let taps = gridder
12795            .taps(uv_lambda)
12796            .expect("support ending on the terminal grid cells is valid");
12797        assert_eq!(taps.x.start + 2 * SUPPORT, geometry.grid_shape[0] - 1);
12798        assert_eq!(taps.y.start + 2 * SUPPORT, geometry.grid_shape[1] - 1);
12799
12800        let shape = (geometry.grid_shape[0], geometry.grid_shape[1]);
12801        let mut model = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12802        for x in taps.x.start..=taps.x.start + 2 * SUPPORT {
12803            for y in taps.y.start..=taps.y.start + 2 * SUPPORT {
12804                model[(x, y)] = Complex64::new(
12805                    0.13 * x as f64 - 0.07 * y as f64,
12806                    0.05 * x as f64 + 0.11 * y as f64,
12807                );
12808            }
12809        }
12810        let visibility = Complex64::new(1.25, -0.75);
12811        let prediction = gridder.degrid(&model, taps);
12812        let mut adjoint = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12813        let mut compensation = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12814        gridder.grid_compensated(&mut adjoint, &mut compensation, taps, visibility);
12815
12816        assert_ne!(
12817            adjoint[(geometry.grid_shape[0] - 1, geometry.grid_shape[1] - 1)],
12818            Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0),
12819            "the terminal row and column must not be clipped from the convolution footprint"
12820        );
12821        let left = prediction.conj() * visibility;
12822        let right = model
12823            .iter()
12824            .zip(adjoint.iter())
12825            .map(|(model, adjoint)| model.conj() * adjoint)
12826            .sum::<Complex64>();
12827        assert!(
12828            (left - right).norm() <= 1.0e-13 * left.norm().max(right.norm()).max(1.0),
12829            "terminal-support A/A* mismatch: left={left:?} right={right:?}"
12830        );
12831    }

12833    #[test]
12834    fn deterministic_block_gridded_records_preserve_the_normal_operator() {
12835        let geometry = geometry();
12836        let gridder = StandardConvolution::new(&geometry);
12837        let shape = (geometry.grid_shape[0], geometry.grid_shape[1]);
12838        let mut model_grid = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12839        for ((x, y), value) in model_grid.indexed_iter_mut() {
12840            *value = Complex64::new(
12841                (x * shape.1 + y) as f64 * 0.013 - 0.4,
12842                x as f64 * -0.017 + y as f64 * 0.009,
12843            );
12844        }
12845        let first = gridder.taps([0.0, 0.0]).expect("central taps");
12846        let second = gridder
12847            .taps([0.41 * gridder.du_lambda, -0.27 * gridder.dv_lambda])
12848            .expect("offset taps");
12849        let scalar_records = [
12850            (first, 0.75),
12851            (first, 1.25),
12852            (second, 0.4),
12853            (second, 0.6),
12854            (first, 0.125),
12855            (first, 0.375),
12856        ];
12857
12858        let mut direct = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12859        let mut direct_compensation = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12860        for (taps, coefficient) in scalar_records {
12861            let predicted = gridder.degrid(&model_grid, taps);
12862            gridder.grid_compensated(
12863                &mut direct,
12864                &mut direct_compensation,
12865                taps,
12866                predicted * coefficient,
12867            );
12868        }
12869
12870        let mut grouped = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12871        let mut grouped_compensation = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12872        let mut block_records = BTreeMap::<SampleTaps, f64>::new();
12873        for (taps, coefficient) in scalar_records {
12874            *block_records.entry(taps).or_default() += coefficient;
12875        }
12876        for (taps, coefficient) in &block_records {
12877            let predicted = gridder.degrid(&model_grid, *taps);
12878            gridder.grid_compensated(
12879                &mut grouped,
12880                &mut grouped_compensation,
12881                *taps,
12882                predicted * *coefficient,
12883            );
12884        }
12885
12886        let squared_error = direct
12887            .iter()
12888            .zip(&grouped)
12889            .map(|(expected, actual)| (*actual - *expected).norm_sqr())
12890            .sum::<f64>();
12891        let squared_reference = direct.iter().map(Complex64::norm_sqr).sum::<f64>();
12892        let normalized_rms = (squared_error / squared_reference.max(f64::MIN_POSITIVE)).sqrt();
12893        assert!(normalized_rms <= 1.0e-15, "normalized RMS {normalized_rms}");
12894        assert_eq!(block_records.len(), 2);
12895        assert_eq!(scalar_records.len() / block_records.len(), 3);
12896    }

12898    #[test]
12899    #[ignore = "requires CASA_RS_IMPERF_REPLAY_ARTIFACT from the mounted replay discriminator"]
12900    fn mounted_gridded_replay_artifact_streams_through_the_normal_operator() {
12901        let path = std::env::var_os("CASA_RS_IMPERF_REPLAY_ARTIFACT")
12902            .expect("CASA_RS_IMPERF_REPLAY_ARTIFACT must name the discriminator artifact");
12903        let file = File::open(path).expect("open gridded replay artifact");
12904        let bytes = file.metadata().expect("read artifact metadata").len();
12905        assert_eq!(
12906            bytes % 16,
12907            0,
12908            "gridded replay artifact has a partial record"
12909        );
12910        let records = bytes / 16;
12911
12912        let cell = 0.25 * std::f64::consts::PI / (180.0 * 3600.0);
12913        let geometry = SpectralOperatorGeometry {
12914            image_shape: [1024, 1024],
12915            grid_shape: [1024, 1024],
12916            image_blc: [0, 0],
12917            reference_pixel: [512.0, 512.0],
12918            increment_rad: [-cell, cell],
12919            direction: casa_imaging_model::DirectionCoordinateSpec::new(
12920                casa_imaging_model::Projection::Sin,
12921                casa_imaging_model::SkyDirection::new(
12922                    casa_imaging_model::DirectionFrame::J2000,
12923                    1.0,
12924                    -0.5,
12925                ),
12926                [512.0, 512.0],
12927                [-cell, cell],
12928                [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]],
12929                [180.0, 0.0],
12930            ),
12931        };
12932        let gridder = StandardConvolution::new(&geometry);
12933        let shape = (geometry.grid_shape[0], geometry.grid_shape[1]);
12934        let mut model_grid = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12935        for ((x, y), value) in model_grid.indexed_iter_mut() {
12936            *value = Complex64::new(
12937                ((x * shape.1 + y) % 997) as f64 * 1.0e-4 - 0.05,
12938                (x as f64 - y as f64) * 2.0e-5,
12939            );
12940        }
12941        let mut output = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12942        let mut compensation = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(shape);
12943        let mut reader = BufReader::with_capacity(8 << 20, file);
12944        let mut record = [0_u8; 16];
12945        let started = Instant::now();
12946        for _ in 0..records {
12947            reader
12948                .read_exact(&mut record)
12949                .expect("read complete gridded replay record");
12950            let key = u64::from_le_bytes(record[..8].try_into().expect("tap key width"));
12951            let coefficient =
12952                f64::from_le_bytes(record[8..].try_into().expect("coefficient width"));
12953            assert!(coefficient.is_finite() && coefficient >= 0.0);
12954            let taps = SampleTaps {
12955                x: TapSpan {
12956                    start: (key & 0x0fff) as usize,
12957                    weight_index: ((key >> 24) & 0x7f) as usize,
12958                },
12959                y: TapSpan {
12960                    start: ((key >> 12) & 0x0fff) as usize,
12961                    weight_index: ((key >> 31) & 0x7f) as usize,
12962                },
12963            };
12964            let predicted = gridder.degrid(&model_grid, taps);
12965            gridder.grid_compensated(
12966                &mut output,
12967                &mut compensation,
12968                taps,
12969                predicted * coefficient,
12970            );
12971        }
12972        let elapsed = started.elapsed();
12973        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
12974        for value in &output {
12975            hasher.update(value.re.to_le_bytes());
12976            hasher.update(value.im.to_le_bytes());
12977        }
12978        println!(
12979            "gridded_replay_apply records={records} bytes={bytes} wall_ms={:.6} sha256={:x}",
12980            elapsed.as_secs_f64() * 1_000.0,
12981            hasher.finalize()
12982        );
12983    }

13020    fn t37_slab_depths_one_two_and_full_are_bitwise_identical() {
13021        let full = cube_primitives(0, 4);
13022        let run_partition = |depth: usize| {
13023            let mut dirty = Vec::new();
13024            let mut psf = Vec::new();
13025            let mut sensitivity = Vec::new();
13026            let mut sum_weights = Vec::new();
13027            let mut validity = Vec::new();
13028            for start in (0..4).step_by(depth) {
13029                let slab = cube_primitives(start, depth.min(4 - start));
13030                dirty.extend_from_slice(slab.dirty());
13031                psf.extend_from_slice(slab.psf());
13032                sensitivity.extend_from_slice(slab.sensitivity());
13033                sum_weights.extend_from_slice(slab.sum_weights());
13034                validity.extend_from_slice(slab.channel_validity());
13035            }
13036            (dirty, psf, sensitivity, sum_weights, validity)
13037        };
13038        for depth in [1, 2] {
13039            let (dirty, psf, sensitivity, sum_weights, validity) = run_partition(depth);
13040            assert_eq!(dirty, full.dirty(), "dirty changed at slab depth {depth}");
13041            assert_eq!(psf, full.psf(), "PSF changed at slab depth {depth}");
13042            assert_eq!(
13043                sensitivity,
13044                full.sensitivity(),
13045                "sensitivity changed at slab depth {depth}"
13046            );

13048                sum_weights,
13049                full.sum_weights(),
13050                "sum weight changed at slab depth {depth}"
13051            );
13052            assert_eq!(
13053                validity,
13054                full.channel_validity(),
13055                "validity changed at slab depth {depth}"
13056            );
13057        }
13058        assert_eq!(
13059            full.channel_validity(),
13060            &[
13061                SpectralChannelValidity::Valid,

13096            .map(|stencil| full.predict_stencil(stencil).expect("full prediction"))
13097            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
13098        for start in 0..4 {
13099            let slab = cube_slab(start, 1);
13100            let mut operator = cube_operator(slab);
13101            operator
13102                .prepare_prediction_grid(&model)
13103                .expect("slab model");
13104            for (stencil, expected) in stencils.iter().zip(&expected) {
13105                if stencil
13106                    .iter()
13107                    .any(|sample| slab.owns(sample.output_channel))
13108                {
13109                    assert_eq!(
13110                        operator.predict_stencil(stencil).expect("slab prediction"),
13111                        *expected
13112                    );
13113                }
13114            }
13115        }
13116    }

13118    #[cfg(feature = "cpp-interop-tests")]
13119    #[test]
13120    fn t37_casacore_cube_dirty_psf_sum_weight_and_normal_state_match() {
13121        const CHANNELS: usize = 4;
13122        const CELLS: usize = 8 * 8;
13123        const OUTPUT_FREQUENCIES_HZ: [f64; CHANNELS] = [1.03e9, 1.02e9, 1.01e9, 1.00e9];
13124        const SELECTED_OUTPUT_CHANNELS: [usize; 3] = [2, 0, 1];
13125        type OracleSample = ([f64; 3], [f64; 2], f64);
13126
13127        let oracle_geometry = SpectralOperatorGeometry {
13128            image_blc: [1, 1],
13129            ..geometry()
13130        };
13131        let mut rust = cube_operator_with_geometry(cube_slab(0, CHANNELS), oracle_geometry);
13132        let mut per_channel: Vec<Vec<OracleSample>> = vec![Vec::new(); CHANNELS];
13133        let mut selected_sample_identities = Vec::new();
13134        for channel in SELECTED_OUTPUT_CHANNELS {
13135            let channel_samples = if channel == 1 {
13136                vec![([4.0, -6.0, 0.0], [9.0, -7.0], 0.0)]
13137            } else {
13138                vec![
13139                    (
13140                        [7.0 + channel as f64, -3.0 + channel as f64, 0.0],
13141                        [1.0 + channel as f64 * 0.25, -0.2],
13142                        0.75 + channel as f64 * 0.25,
13143                    ),
13144                    (
13145                        [-5.0 - channel as f64, 9.0 - channel as f64, 0.0],
13146                        [-0.3, 0.8 + channel as f64 * 0.125],
13147                        1.25 + channel as f64 * 0.5,
13148                    ),
13149                ]
13150            };
13151            for &(uvw, visibility, weight) in &channel_samples {
13152                let sample = SpectralOperatorSample::new(
13153                    channel,
13154                    uvw,
13155                    OUTPUT_FREQUENCIES_HZ[channel],
13156                    0.0,
13157                    visibility,
13158                    weight,
13159                    1.0,
13160                )
13161                .expect("valid CASA comparison sample");
13162                selected_sample_identities
13163                    .push((sample.output_channel, sample.frequency_hz.to_bits()));
13164                rust.push(sample).expect("grid CASA comparison sample");
13165            }
13166            per_channel[channel] = channel_samples;
13167        }
13168        let operator_dirty_grids = rust
13169            .dirty_grids
13170            .clone()
13171            .expect("initial pass owns dirty grids");
13172        let operator_psf_grids = rust.psf_grids.clone().expect("initial pass owns PSF grids");
13173        let primitives = rust.finish().expect("cube normal state");
13174        assert_eq!(primitives.slab(), cube_slab(0, CHANNELS));
13175        assert_eq!(
13176            OUTPUT_FREQUENCIES_HZ.map(f64::to_bits),
13177            [
13178                1.03e9_f64.to_bits(),
13179                1.02e9_f64.to_bits(),
13180                1.01e9_f64.to_bits(),
13181                1.00e9_f64.to_bits(),
13182            ],
13183            "logical output-channel identities must retain descending frequency order"
13184        );
13185        assert_eq!(
13186            selected_sample_identities,
13187            [
13188                (2, 1.01e9_f64.to_bits()),
13189                (2, 1.01e9_f64.to_bits()),
13190                (0, 1.03e9_f64.to_bits()),
13191                (0, 1.03e9_f64.to_bits()),
13192                (1, 1.02e9_f64.to_bits()),
13193            ],
13194            "selected source-sample identities must retain contribution order"
13195        );
13196        assert_eq!(
13197            primitives.channel_validity(),
13198            &[
13199                SpectralChannelValidity::Valid,
13200                SpectralChannelValidity::Blank,
13201                SpectralChannelValidity::Valid,
13202                SpectralChannelValidity::Unmapped,
13203            ]
13204        );
13205
13206        let grid_shape = oracle_geometry.grid_shape;
13207        let image_shape = oracle_geometry.image_shape;
13208        let scale = [
13209            grid_shape[0] as f64 * oracle_geometry.increment_rad[0].abs(),
13210            grid_shape[1] as f64 * oracle_geometry.increment_rad[1].abs(),
13211        ];
13212        let offset = [grid_shape[0] as f64 / 2.0, grid_shape[1] as f64 / 2.0];
13213        let grid_array_shape = (grid_shape[0], grid_shape[1]);
13214        let rust_gridder = StandardConvolution::new(&oracle_geometry);
13215        let mut casa_grids = (0..CHANNELS)
13216            .map(|_| {
13217                (
13218                    Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(grid_array_shape),
13219                    Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(grid_array_shape),
13220                    Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(grid_array_shape),
13221                    Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(grid_array_shape),
13222                    0.0_f64,
13223                )
13224            })
13225            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
13226        for (channel, (samples, (dirty, psf, rust_dirty, rust_psf, sum_weight))) in
13227            per_channel.iter().zip(&mut casa_grids).enumerate()
13228        {
13229            let mut dirty_compensation = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(grid_array_shape);
13230            let mut psf_compensation = Array2::<Complex64>::zeros(grid_array_shape);
13231            for (uvw, visibility, weight) in samples {
13232                let frequency_hz = OUTPUT_FREQUENCIES_HZ[channel];
13233                let uv_lambda = [
13234                    uvw[0] * frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S,
13235                    uvw[1] * frequency_hz / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_M_PER_S,
13236                ];
13237                let patch = GridderOracle::grid_unit_sample_2d(
13238                    grid_shape,
13239                    scale,
13240                    offset,
13241                    [uv_lambda[0], -uv_lambda[1]],
13242                )
13243                .expect("casacore convolution patch");
13244                assert_eq!(patch.support, SUPPORT as i32);
13245                assert_eq!(patch.sampling, OVERSAMPLING as i32);
13246                let weighted_visibility = Complex64::new(visibility[0], visibility[1]) * *weight;
13247                let taps = rust_gridder.taps(uv_lambda).expect("Rust convolution taps");
13248                rust_gridder.grid_compensated(
13249                    rust_dirty,
13250                    &mut dirty_compensation,
13251                    taps,
13252                    weighted_visibility,
13253                );
13254                rust_gridder.grid_compensated(
13255                    rust_psf,
13256                    &mut psf_compensation,
13257                    taps,
13258                    Complex64::new(*weight, 0.0),
13259                );
13260                for cell in patch.cells {
13261                    let tap = Complex64::new(f64::from(cell.re), f64::from(cell.im));
13262                    dirty[(cell.x, cell.y)] += weighted_visibility * tap;
13263                    psf[(cell.x, cell.y)] += *weight * tap;
13264                }
13265                *sum_weight += *weight;
13266            }
13267        }
13268        let mut casa_fft = PreparedFft::new(grid_shape, 7_690).expect("CASA comparison FFT");
13269        for (channel, (casa_dirty, casa_psf, rust_dirty_grid, rust_psf_grid, casa_sum_weight)) in
13270            casa_grids.iter_mut().enumerate()
13271        {
13272            let expected_validity = primitives.channel_validity()[channel];
13273            let rust_sum_weight = primitives.sum_weights()[channel];
13274            assert_eq!(*casa_sum_weight, rust_sum_weight);
13275            assert!(
13276                primitives.sensitivity()[channel * CELLS..(channel + 1) * CELLS]
13277                    .iter()
13278                    .all(|sensitivity| *sensitivity == rust_sum_weight)
13279            );
13280            if expected_validity != SpectralChannelValidity::Valid {
13281                assert_eq!(rust_sum_weight, 0.0);
13282                assert!(
13283                    operator_dirty_grids[channel]
13284                        .iter()
13285                        .chain(&operator_psf_grids[channel])
13286                        .chain(rust_dirty_grid.iter())
13287                        .chain(rust_psf_grid.iter())
13288                        .chain(casa_dirty.iter())
13289                        .chain(casa_psf.iter())
13290                        .all(|value| *value == Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0))
13291                );
13292                assert!(
13293                    primitives.dirty()[channel * CELLS..(channel + 1) * CELLS]
13294                        .iter()
13295                        .chain(&primitives.psf()[channel * CELLS..(channel + 1) * CELLS])
13296                        .all(|value| *value == Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0))
13297                );
13298                continue;
13299            }
13300            let operator_dirty_nrmse = operator_dirty_grids[channel]
13301                .iter()
13302                .zip(rust_dirty_grid.iter())
13303                .map(|(operator, reconstructed)| (*operator - *reconstructed).norm_sqr())
13304                .sum::<f64>()
13305                / rust_dirty_grid
13306                    .iter()
13307                    .map(|value| value.norm_sqr())
13308                    .sum::<f64>();
13309            let operator_psf_nrmse = operator_psf_grids[channel]
13310                .iter()
13311                .zip(rust_psf_grid.iter())
13312                .map(|(operator, reconstructed)| (*operator - *reconstructed).norm_sqr())
13313                .sum::<f64>()
13314                / rust_psf_grid
13315                    .iter()
13316                    .map(|value| value.norm_sqr())
13317                    .sum::<f64>();
13318            assert!(
13319                operator_dirty_nrmse.sqrt() <= 1.0e-12,
13320                "operator dirty grid must use the same metre-to-wavelength coordinates: {}",
13321                operator_dirty_nrmse.sqrt()
13322            );
13323            assert!(
13324                operator_psf_nrmse.sqrt() <= 1.0e-12,
13325                "operator PSF grid must use the same metre-to-wavelength coordinates: {}",
13326                operator_psf_nrmse.sqrt()
13327            );
13328            let grid_dirty_nrmse = rust_dirty_grid
13329                .iter()
13330                .zip(casa_dirty.iter())
13331                .map(|(rust, casa)| (*rust - *casa).norm_sqr())
13332                .sum::<f64>()
13333                / casa_dirty.iter().map(|value| value.norm_sqr()).sum::<f64>();
13334            let grid_psf_nrmse = rust_psf_grid
13335                .iter()
13336                .zip(casa_psf.iter())
13337                .map(|(rust, casa)| (*rust - *casa).norm_sqr())
13338                .sum::<f64>()
13339                / casa_psf.iter().map(|value| value.norm_sqr()).sum::<f64>();
13340            assert!(
13341                grid_dirty_nrmse.sqrt() <= 1.0e-3,
13342                "dirty convolution grid mismatch: {}",
13343                grid_dirty_nrmse.sqrt()
13344            );
13345            assert!(
13346                grid_psf_nrmse.sqrt() <= 1.0e-3,
13347                "PSF convolution grid mismatch: {}",
13348                grid_psf_nrmse.sqrt()
13349            );
13350            casa_fft.transform(casa_dirty, true);
13351            casa_fft.transform(casa_psf, true);
13352            let mut dirty_difference_energy = 0.0;
13353            let mut dirty_casa_energy = 0.0;
13354            let mut psf_difference_energy = 0.0;
13355            let mut psf_casa_energy = 0.0;
13356            for y in 0..image_shape[1] {
13357                let grid_y = oracle_geometry.image_blc[1] + y;
13358                let correction =
13359                    GridderOracle::correction_row_2d(grid_shape, scale, offset, grid_y)
13360                        .expect("casacore correction row");
13361                for x in 0..image_shape[0] {
13362                    let grid_x = oracle_geometry.image_blc[0] + x;
13363                    let inverse_correction = if correction[grid_x].abs() > 1.0e-6 {
13364                        1.0 / f64::from(correction[grid_x])
13365                    } else {
13366                        0.0
13367                    };
13368                    let pixel = x * image_shape[1] + y;
13369                    let casa_dirty = casa_dirty[(grid_x, grid_y)] * inverse_correction;
13370                    let casa_psf = casa_psf[(grid_x, grid_y)] * inverse_correction;
13371                    let rust_dirty = primitives.dirty()[channel * CELLS + pixel];
13372                    let rust_psf = primitives.psf()[channel * CELLS + pixel];
13373                    dirty_difference_energy += (rust_dirty - casa_dirty).norm_sqr();
13374                    dirty_casa_energy += casa_dirty.norm_sqr();
13375                    psf_difference_energy += (rust_psf - casa_psf).norm_sqr();
13376                    psf_casa_energy += casa_psf.norm_sqr();
13377                }
13378            }
13379            let dirty_normalized_rms = (dirty_difference_energy / dirty_casa_energy).sqrt();
13380            let psf_normalized_rms = (psf_difference_energy / psf_casa_energy).sqrt();
13381            assert!(
13382                dirty_normalized_rms <= 1.0e-3,
13383                "dirty channel {channel} exceeds CASA normalized-RMS contract: {dirty_normalized_rms}"
13384            );
13385            assert!(
13386                psf_normalized_rms <= 1.0e-3,
13387                "PSF channel {channel} exceeds CASA normalized-RMS contract: {psf_normalized_rms}"
13388            );
13389        }
13390    }

13392    #[test]
13393    fn evaluated_spectral_frame_is_shared_by_forward_and_adjoint() {
13394        let cells = checked_cells(geometry().image_shape).expect("shape");
13395        let mut model = vec![Complex64::default(); cells];
13396        model[2 * geometry().image_shape[1] + 5] = Complex64::new(0.75, -0.2);
13397        let sample_at = |frequency_hz| {
13398            SpectralOperatorSample::new(
13399                0,
13400                [18.0, -7.0, 0.0],
13401                frequency_hz,
13402                0.37,
13403                [0.4, -0.7],
13404                1.25,
13405                0.8,
13406            )
13407            .expect("valid frame-evaluated sample")
13408        };
13409        let native = sample_at(1.0e9);
13410        let shifted = sample_at(1.006e9);
13411        let native_prediction = operator()
13412            .predict(&model, &[native])
13413            .expect("native-frame prediction")[0];
13414        let shifted_prediction = operator()
13415            .predict(&model, &[shifted])
13416            .expect("shifted-frame prediction")[0];
13417        assert_ne!(
13418            native_prediction, shifted_prediction,
13419            "the evaluated operator frequency must affect A"
13420        );
13421
13422        for (sample, prediction) in [(native, native_prediction), (shifted, shifted_prediction)] {
13423            let weighted_visibility = sample.visibility * sample.imaging_weight;
13424            let mut adjoint = operator();
13425            adjoint.push(sample).expect("adjoint sample");
13426            let dirty = adjoint.finish().expect("finite primitives");
13427            let left = prediction.conj() * weighted_visibility;
13428            let right = inner(&model, dirty.dirty());
13429            assert!(
13430                (left - right).norm() <= 1.0e-9 * left.norm().max(right.norm()).max(1.0),
13431                "A and A* must use the same owner-evaluated frequency"
13432            );
13433        }
13434    }

13436    #[test]
13437    fn forward_is_linear_and_a_unit_centre_source_is_constant() {
13438        let sample_values = samples(&[[0.0, 0.0]; 3]);
13439        let cells = checked_cells(geometry().image_shape).expect("shape");
13440        let centre = [3, 3];
13441        let mut first = vec![Complex64::new(0.0, 0.0); cells];
13442        let mut second = first.clone();
13443        first[centre[0] * 8 + centre[1]] = Complex64::new(1.0, 0.0);
13444        second[3 * 8 + 5] = Complex64::new(-0.25, 0.5);
13445        let sum = first
13446            .iter()
13447            .zip(&second)
13448            .map(|(first, second)| first + second)
13449            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
13450        let mut operator = operator();
13451        // casacore's raw spheroidal centre response is close to, but not
13452        // exactly, one. The unit source remains constant at that gridder-owned
13453        // correction rather than at an independently renormalized amplitude.
13454        let centre_correction = operator.gridder.model_correction(centre[0], centre[1]);
13455        let first_prediction = operator.predict(&first, &sample_values).expect("first");
13456        let second_prediction = operator.predict(&second, &sample_values).expect("second");
13457        let sum_prediction = operator.predict(&sum, &sample_values).expect("sum");
13458        for ((sum, first), second) in sum_prediction
13459            .iter()
13460            .zip(&first_prediction)
13461            .zip(&second_prediction)
13462        {
13463            assert!((*sum - *first - *second).norm() <= 1.0e-12);
13464        }
13465        for (prediction, sample) in first_prediction.iter().zip(&sample_values) {
13466            let expected = sample.phase().conj() * sample.spectral_factor * centre_correction;
13467            assert!(
13468                (*prediction - expected).norm() <= 1.0e-12,
13469                "unit source mismatch: predicted={prediction:?} expected={expected:?}"
13470            );
13471        }
13472    }

13616            });

13636    #[test]
13637    fn t51_aw_block_progress_snapshot_preserves_operator_counters_and_grid_bits() {
13638        let (mut plain, mut observed, sample) = observed_aw_operators();
13639        let mut observer = Some(super::AwBlockProgress::new());
13640        observer.as_mut().unwrap().begin();
13641        let mut plain_grids = [
13642            vec![Complex64::default(); 100],
13643            vec![Complex64::default(); 100],
13644        ];
13645        let mut observed_grids = plain_grids.clone();
13646        let mut plain_errors = plain_grids.clone();
13647        let mut observed_errors = plain_grids.clone();
13648        let mut snapshots = 0;
13649        for (index, value) in [Complex64::new(0.4, -0.7), Complex64::new(-1.2, 0.3)]
13650            .into_iter()
13651            .enumerate()
13652        {
13653            let (imaging, normal) = plain
13654                .prepare_imaging_and_normal_grid([10, 10], sample)
13655                .unwrap();
13656            imaging
13657                .grid_compensated(&mut plain_grids[0], &mut plain_errors[0], value)
13658                .unwrap();
13659            normal
13660                .grid_compensated(&mut plain_grids[1], &mut plain_errors[1], value)
13661                .unwrap();
13662            let (imaging, normal) = observed
13663                .prepare_imaging_and_normal_grid([10, 10], sample)
13664                .unwrap();
13665            imaging
13666                .grid_compensated(&mut observed_grids[0], &mut observed_errors[0], value)
13667                .unwrap();
13668            normal
13669                .grid_compensated(&mut observed_grids[1], &mut observed_errors[1], value)
13670                .unwrap();
13671            let before = observed.diagnostics();
13672            super::AwBlockProgress::observe(&mut observer, index == 1, index as u64 + 1, |_, _| {
13673                let snapshot = observed.diagnostics();
13674                assert_eq!(snapshot, before);
13675                assert_eq!(snapshot.imaging_taps, index as u64 + 1);
13676                assert_eq!(snapshot.weight_taps, index as u64 + 1);
13677                assert_eq!(snapshot.provider_loads, index as u64 + 1);
13678                snapshots += 1;
13679            });
13680            assert_eq!(observed.diagnostics(), plain.diagnostics());
13681        }
13682        assert_eq!(snapshots, 2);
13683        for (plain, observed) in plain_grids
13684            .iter()
13685            .flatten()
13686            .chain(plain_errors.iter().flatten())
13687            .zip(
13688                observed_grids
13689                    .iter()
13690                    .flatten()
13691                    .chain(observed_errors.iter().flatten()),
13692            )
13693        {
13694            assert_eq!(
13695                [plain.re.to_bits(), plain.im.to_bits()],
13696                [observed.re.to_bits(), observed.im.to_bits()]
13697            );
13698        }
13699    }

13729    fn t51_cumulative_aw_probe_requires_exact_coverage_before_diagnostic_stop() {
13730        let config = super::CumulativeAwProbeConfig::parse("10:12:0:3:2:4:6").unwrap();
13731        let ms = MeasurementSetIdentity::new(LogicalIdentity::from_sha256([93; 32]));
13732        let address = |row, channel| mosaic_address(ms, row, channel, 1.0e9, 1.0e6);
13733        let mut probe = super::CumulativeAwScienceProbe::new(config);
13734        assert!(probe.record_group(address(10, 0), 15).unwrap());

13739        );

13741            probe.record_group(address(10, 0), 15),

13746            Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)
13747        );
13748        assert_eq!(
13749            probe.record_group(address(10, 2), 15),
13750            Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch)
13751        );
13752        for (row, channel) in [(11, 1), (10, 1), (11, 0)] {
13753            assert!(probe.record_group(address(row, channel), 15).unwrap());

13757            probe.stop_reason(),
13758            SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticCoverageMismatch
13759        );

13761        probe.channels[1].accepted = [3, 3];
13762        assert_eq!(probe.stop_reason(), SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticStop);
13763        let observer = SpectralScienceProbe {
13764            cumulative: Some(probe),
13765            ..SpectralScienceProbe::default()
13766        };
13767        assert_eq!(
13768            observer.finish(),
13769            Err(SpectralOperatorError::DiagnosticStop)

13801    #[test]
13802    fn t51_polynomial_aw_observation_preserves_normal_state_bits() {
13803        let plan = BlockNormalPlan::taylor(1.0e9, 2).expect("two-term Taylor plan");
13804        let sample_values = samples(&[[0.4, -0.7], [-1.2, 0.3], [0.8, 1.1]])
13805            .into_iter()
13806            .enumerate()
13807            .map(|(index, sample)| {
13808                sample
13809                    .with_published_weight(0.25 + index as f64)
13810                    .expect("finite published weight")
13811            })
13812            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
13813        let run = |observe: bool| {
13814            let mut operator = operator();
13815            let mut probe = SpectralScienceProbe::default();
13816            for (index, sample) in sample_values.iter().copied().enumerate() {
13817                if observe {
13818                    probe
13819                        .observe_polynomial_aw(
13820                            3,
13821                            plan,
13822                            sample,
13823                            1.5 + index as f64,
13824                            1.5 + index as f64,
13825                        )
13826                        .expect("finite observer aggregate");
13827                }
13828                operator.push(sample).expect("accepted sample");
13829            }
13830            (operator.finish().expect("finite primitives"), probe)
13831        };
13832
13833        let (unobserved, _) = run(false);
13834        let (observed, probe) = run(true);
13835        let complex_bits = |values: &[Complex64]| {
13836            values
13837                .iter()
13838                .map(|value| [value.re.to_bits(), value.im.to_bits()])
13839                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
13840        };
13841        let real_bits = |values: &[f64]| {
13842            values
13843                .iter()
13844                .map(|value| value.to_bits())
13845                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
13846        };
13847        assert_eq!(
13848            complex_bits(unobserved.dirty()),
13849            complex_bits(observed.dirty())
13850        );
13851        assert_eq!(complex_bits(unobserved.psf()), complex_bits(observed.psf()));
13852        assert_eq!(
13853            real_bits(unobserved.sensitivity()),
13854            real_bits(observed.sensitivity())
13855        );
13856        assert_eq!(
13857            real_bits(unobserved.sum_weights()),
13858            real_bits(observed.sum_weights())
13859        );
13860        assert_eq!(
13861            real_bits(unobserved.published_sum_weights()),
13862            real_bits(observed.published_sum_weights())
13863        );
13864        assert_eq!(
13865            unobserved.normal_state_content_identity(),
13866            observed.normal_state_content_identity()
13867        );
13868
13869        assert_eq!(probe.polynomial_aw.len(), plan.normal_moment_count());
13870        assert!(
13871            probe
13872                .polynomial_aw
13873                .values()
13874                .all(|value| value.accepted_count == 3)
13875        );
13876        for moment in 0..plan.normal_moment_count() {
13877            let mut expected = super::PolynomialAwScienceAggregate::default();
13878            for (index, sample) in sample_values.iter().copied().enumerate() {
13879                let normalization = 1.5 + index as f64;
13880                let x = plan.normalized_frequency(sample.frequency_hz).unwrap();
13881                let taylor = x.powi(moment as i32);
13882                let factor_squared = sample.spectral_factor * sample.spectral_factor;
13883                let imaging = sample.imaging_weight * factor_squared * taylor;
13884                let published = sample.published_weight * factor_squared * taylor;
13885                expected.accepted_count += 1;
13886                expected.post_briggs_imaging_weight_sum += sample.imaging_weight;
13887                expected.published_polarization_weight_sum += sample.published_weight;
13888                expected.taylor_x_moment_sum += taylor;
13889                expected.pre_cf_imaging_moment_sum += imaging;
13890                expected.pre_cf_published_moment_sum += published;
13891                expected.selected_imaging_cf_normalization_sum += normalization;
13892                expected.selected_normal_cf_normalization_sum += normalization;
13893                expected.accumulate_sumwt(imaging * normalization, published * normalization);
13894            }
13895            let actual = probe
13896                .polynomial_aw
13897                .get(&(3, moment))
13898                .expect("normal moment aggregate");
13899            assert_eq!(actual, &expected);
13900        }
13901    }

13903    #[test]
13904    fn t51_polynomial_aw_observation_uses_measured_wtcf_normalization() {
13905        let (mut ordinary, mut observed, aw_sample) = observed_aw_operators();
13906        let (imaging_plan, normal_plan) = ordinary
13907            .prepare_imaging_and_normal_grid([10, 10], aw_sample)
13908            .expect("ordinary paired AW plans");
13909        let (_, observed_normal_plan, probes) = observed
13910            .prepare_imaging_and_normal_grid_observed([10, 10], aw_sample)
13911            .expect("observed paired AW plans");
13912        let imaging_normalization = probes.imaging.raw_tap_sum.norm();
13913        let normal_normalization = probes.normal.raw_tap_sum.norm();
13914        assert_eq!(
13915            imaging_normalization.to_bits(),
13916            imaging_plan.normalization().to_bits()
13917        );
13918        assert_eq!(
13919            normal_normalization.to_bits(),
13920            normal_plan.normalization().to_bits()
13921        );
13922        assert_eq!(
13923            normal_normalization.to_bits(),
13924            observed_normal_plan.normalization().to_bits()
13925        );
13926        assert_ne!(
13927            imaging_normalization.to_bits(),
13928            normal_normalization.to_bits()
13929        );
13930
13931        let plan = BlockNormalPlan::taylor(1.0e9, 2).expect("two-term Taylor plan");
13932        let sample =
13933            SpectralOperatorSample::new(0, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], 1.1e9, 0.0, [0.5, -0.25], 2.0, 1.25)
13934                .expect("valid polynomial sample")
13935                .with_published_weight(3.0)
13936                .expect("finite published weight");
13937        let mut probe = SpectralScienceProbe::default();
13938        probe
13939            .observe_polynomial_aw(3, plan, sample, imaging_normalization, normal_normalization)
13940            .expect("finite observer aggregate");
13941
13942        for moment in 0..plan.normal_moment_count() {
13943            let x = plan.normalized_frequency(sample.frequency_hz).unwrap();
13944            let taylor = x.powi(moment as i32);
13945            let factor_squared = sample.spectral_factor * sample.spectral_factor;
13946            let imaging = sample.imaging_weight * factor_squared * taylor;
13947            let published = sample.published_weight * factor_squared * taylor;
13948            let mut expected = PolynomialAwScienceAggregate {
13949                accepted_count: 1,
13950                post_briggs_imaging_weight_sum: sample.imaging_weight,
13951                published_polarization_weight_sum: sample.published_weight,
13952                taylor_x_moment_sum: taylor,
13953                pre_cf_imaging_moment_sum: imaging,
13954                pre_cf_published_moment_sum: published,
13955                selected_imaging_cf_normalization_sum: imaging_normalization,
13956                selected_normal_cf_normalization_sum: normal_normalization,
13957                ..PolynomialAwScienceAggregate::default()
13958            };
13959            expected.accumulate_sumwt(
13960                imaging * normal_normalization,
13961                published * imaging_normalization,
13962            );
13963            let actual = probe
13964                .polynomial_aw
13965                .get(&(3, moment))
13966                .expect("normal moment aggregate");
13967            assert_eq!(actual, &expected);
13968        }
13969    }

14069    #[test]
14070    fn empty_initial_binding_matches_the_explicit_zero_operator_with_less_work() {
14071        let values = samples(&[[1.0, 0.0], [2.0, -1.0], [0.5, 0.25]]);
14072        let zero_model = vec![Complex64::default(); checked_cells(geometry().image_shape).unwrap()];
14073        let model = ModelGenerationId(LogicalIdentity::from_sha256([0; 32]));
14074
14075        let mut explicit = operator();
14076        let predicted = explicit
14077            .predict(&zero_model, &values)
14078            .expect("explicit zero forward prediction");
14079        let shape = (geometry().grid_shape[0], geometry().grid_shape[1]);
14080        explicit.residual_grids = Some(vec![Array2::zeros(shape)]);
14081        explicit.residual_compensations = Some(vec![Array2::zeros(shape)]);
14082        for (sample, prediction) in values.iter().copied().zip(predicted) {
14083            explicit
14084                .push_with_residual(sample, prediction)
14085                .expect("explicit zero residual");
14086        }
14087        let explicit = explicit
14088            .finish_bound(Some(ReconstructionModelBinding::Evaluated(model)))
14089            .expect("explicit primitives");
14090
14091        let mut optimized = operator();
14092        for sample in values {
14093            optimized.push(sample).expect("initial data and PSF");
14094        }
14095        let optimized = optimized
14096            .finish_bound(Some(ReconstructionModelBinding::InitialCertifiedZero(
14097                model,
14098            )))
14099            .expect("optimized primitives");
14100
14101        assert_eq!(
14102            optimized.measurements,
14103            super::SpectralOperatorMeasurements {
14104                dirty_grid_tap_visits: 3 * 49,
14105                psf_grid_tap_visits: 3 * 49,
14106                inverse_dirty_fft_planes: 1,
14107                inverse_psf_fft_planes: 1,
14108                ..super::SpectralOperatorMeasurements::default()
14109            },
14110            "empty initial binding must perform only one dirty and one PSF adjoint"
14111        );
14112        assert_eq!(
14113            explicit.measurements,
14114            super::SpectralOperatorMeasurements {
14115                forward_fft_planes: 1,
14116                prediction_degrid_tap_visits: 3 * 49,
14117                dirty_grid_tap_visits: 3 * 49,
14118                residual_grid_tap_visits: 3 * 49,
14119                psf_grid_tap_visits: 3 * 49,
14120                inverse_dirty_fft_planes: 1,
14121                inverse_residual_fft_planes: 1,
14122                inverse_psf_fft_planes: 1,
14123                ..super::SpectralOperatorMeasurements::default()
14124            },
14125            "explicit zero evaluation is the independent work-count reference"
14126        );
14127        assert!(optimized.major_cycle_residual_promoted);
14128        assert!(optimized.major_cycle_residual.is_none());
14129        assert_eq!(optimized.residual_model, Some(model));
14130        assert_eq!(explicit.residual_model, Some(model));
14131
14132        let explicit = explicit
14133            .promote_major_cycle_residual(model)
14134            .expect("promote explicit zero residual");
14135        let optimized = optimized
14136            .promote_major_cycle_residual(model)
14137            .expect("empty residual is already the dirty plane");
14138        assert_eq!(optimized.dirty(), explicit.dirty());
14139        assert_eq!(optimized.psf(), explicit.psf());
14140        assert_eq!(optimized.sensitivity(), explicit.sensitivity());
14141        assert_eq!(optimized.sum_weights(), explicit.sum_weights());
14142        assert_eq!(optimized.channel_validity(), explicit.channel_validity());
14143        assert_eq!(
14144            optimized.normal_state_content_identity(),
14145            explicit.normal_state_content_identity()
14146        );
14147    }

14166                ModelGenerationOrigin::Ingested {
14167                    source,
14168                    reprojection: None,
14169                },
14170            ),
14171            (
14172                SpectralOperatorPass::InitialMajor,
14173                ModelGenerationOrigin::Delta {
14174                    base: generation,
14175                    delta,
14176                },
14177            ),
14178            (
14179                SpectralOperatorPass::ResidualRefresh,
14180                ModelGenerationOrigin::Empty,
14181            ),
14182        ] {
14183            assert_eq!(
14184                reconstruction_model_binding(pass, generation, origin),
14185                ReconstructionModelBinding::Evaluated(generation)
14186            );
14187        }
14188    }

14190    #[test]
14191    fn residual_matches_explicit_paired_forward_then_weighted_adjoint() {
14192        let values = samples(&[[1.0, 0.0], [2.0, -1.0], [0.5, 0.25]]);
14193        let mut model = vec![Complex64::default(); checked_cells(geometry().image_shape).unwrap()];
14194        model[3 * geometry().image_shape[1] + 5] = Complex64::new(1.0, 0.0);
14195
14196        let predicted = operator()
14197            .predict(&model, &values)
14198            .expect("paired forward prediction");
14199        let mut explicit = operator();
14200        for (mut sample, prediction) in values.iter().copied().zip(predicted.iter().copied()) {
14201            sample.visibility -= prediction;
14202            explicit.push(sample).expect("explicit residual adjoint");
14203        }
14204        let expected = explicit.finish().expect("explicit normal residual");
14205
14206        let mut fused = operator();
14207        fused
14208            .prepare_prediction_grid(&model)
14209            .expect("prepare model");
14210        let shape = (geometry().grid_shape[0], geometry().grid_shape[1]);
14211        fused.residual_grids = Some(vec![Array2::zeros(shape)]);
14212        fused.residual_compensations = Some(vec![Array2::zeros(shape)]);
14213        for (sample, prediction) in values.into_iter().zip(predicted) {
14214            fused
14215                .push_with_residual(sample, prediction)
14216                .expect("fused residual");
14217        }
14218        let actual = fused.finish_bound(None).expect("fused normal residual");
14219        assert_eq!(
14220            actual.major_cycle_residual.as_deref(),
14221            Some(expected.dirty()),
14222            "T20 must equal the declared paired A*W(d-Ax) evaluation"
14223        );
14224    }

14226    #[test]
14227    fn final_visibility_publication_uses_the_exact_casa_complex32_value() {
14228        let native = Complex64::new(1.0 + f64::from(f32::EPSILON) / 3.0, -0.1_f64);
14229        let published = casa_persistent_complex(native);
14230        let observed = Complex64::new(4.0, -2.0);
14231
14232        assert_eq!(published.re, f64::from(native.re as f32));
14233        assert_eq!(published.im, f64::from(native.im as f32));
14234        assert_ne!(
14235            published, native,
14236            "fixture must exercise f64 to f32 quantization"
14237        );
14238        assert_eq!(
14239            observed - published,
14240            Complex64::new(
14241                f64::from(observed.re as f32) - f64::from(native.re as f32),
14242                f64::from(observed.im as f32) - f64::from(native.im as f32),
14243            ),
14244            "published residual is derived from the exact persisted prediction"
14245        );
14246    }

14248    #[test]
14249    fn facet_core_scatter_preserves_realistic_parent_geometry_and_plane_order() {
14250        let parent_shape = [256, 256];
14251        let chart_shape = [128, 128];
14252        let chart_cells = checked_cells(chart_shape).unwrap();
14253        let parent_cells = checked_cells(parent_shape).unwrap();
14254        let source = (0..2 * chart_cells)
14255            .map(|index| index as f64)
14256            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
14257        let mut destination = vec![-1.0; 2 * parent_cells];
14258
14259        scatter_chart_planes(
14260            &mut destination,
14261            parent_shape,
14262            &source,
14263            chart_shape,
14264            [128, 128],
14265        )
14266        .expect("scatter one realistic 2x2 facet core");
14267
14268        for plane in 0..2 {
14269            assert_eq!(
14270                destination[plane * parent_cells + 128 * parent_shape[1] + 128],
14271                source[plane * chart_cells]
14272            );
14273            assert_eq!(
14274                destination[plane * parent_cells + 255 * parent_shape[1] + 255],
14275                source[(plane + 1) * chart_cells - 1]
14276            );
14277            assert_eq!(destination[plane * parent_cells], -1.0);
14278        }
14279    }
14280}
